title: PESSOA OPERADORA DE PRODUCAO
description:
Hello, candidate! At Air Liquide, we value inclusion and diversity, so we are pleased to inform you that you are participating in an anonymous selection process, meaning that no personal information will be available. Your assessment will be based on your technical skills and, later, in your behavioral interview. Please fill out all fields of your application with as much detail as possible, remembering that this is essential for your assessment in the anonymous selection process.

About Air Liquide

Through the passion and diversity of its people, Air Liquide leverages the energy and environmental transition, healthcare changes and digitalization, and delivers greater value to all its shareholders.

Join us for a stimulating experience: you will find a world of learning and development opportunities where creativity is at the heart of what we do, in an open, collaborative and respectful environment.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Organize o enchimento de cilindros para aprimorar o fluxo e o manejo de cilindros. Antes do esgotamento do estoque (out-of-stock), encha os cilindros para estoque. Após o esgotamento, encha os cilindros para suportar as demandas e a satisfação dos clientes.

Inspeção de Cilindros: Inclui a inspeção física de cilindros e cestas (bundles) novos e devolvidos, verificando itens como: ano do teste de pressão/tubo, acessórios, pintura, válvulas, capacetes, etc. Verificar as condições da estrutura das cestas e do manifold, e organizar a separação dos cilindros e cestas prontos para enchimento daqueles que devem ir para a área de manutenção.

Manutenção de Cilindros: Inspecionar os equipamentos de tratamento de cilindros, como máquina de teste hidrostático, secador, equipamento de pintura e estufa/forno antes da operação, zelando para que estejam seguros e funcionando corretamente. Realizar teste de vazamento no cilindro ou válvula com água e sabão antes da instalação. Pintar os cilindros de acordo com os padrões e normas governamentais. Realizar testes hidrostáticos em cilindros de acordo com as regulamentações governamentais. Executar a montagem e desmontagem de válvulas nos cilindros (valving/devalving) de acordo com os padrões de segurança da AL. Realizar a secagem e o tratamento térmico/vácuo (vacuum bake oven) dos cilindros. Acompanhar a conformidade dos cilindros quanto à cor e ao gás correspondente. Zelar para que o processo de entrega dos cilindros para a área de enchimento ocorra com precisão e inicializar o código de barras GTS no cilindro após o processo de manutenção.

Acessórios de Cilindros: Realizar a substituição de acessórios com defeito. Instalar o capacete e o tipo de válvula adequados de acordo com a alocação do gás e do cilindro. Aplicar os adesivos (labels) de acordo com as especificações do produto e seus graus de pureza.

Manutenção do Controle de Qualidade: Realizar a verificação de qualidade do ponto de orvalho (dew point) por lote de cilindros tratados em estufa a vácuo (VBO), conforme exigido pelas especificações do produto. Promover a integridade e a constante qualidade de todos os produtos. Estar preparado(a) para realizar testes funcionais em analisadores.

______________________________

Do you have these requirements?

Technical Degree (2 years) 1 to 3 years experience

Your differences drive our performance

At Air Liquide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, which means that, regardless of your gender identity, sexual orientation, color, age, religion, nationality or disability, we value a work environment made up of true stories, built by true people.
Our processes reflect this, being diverse and free from any prejudice, therefore, we do not collect information such as date of birth, gender, marital status or full address in our selection stages. If this information is sent, it will be disregarded.

We strongly believe that a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively, and helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.
Here you can be you!!

title: Rivare/Farsta/Extra
description:
Räddningspatrullen hos aleja söker nu nya rekryter.

Vår patrulls funktion är att hoppa in när vi behöver akut hjälp ute hos kund – det vid t ex sjukdomar hos vår egen eller kundens personal, oförutsedda arbetstoppar eller andra akuta uppdrag.

Viktigt är dock att du kan avsätta minst två hela vardagar i veckan, alltså ej helger eller håltimmar – allt för att vi ska ha möjlighet att erbjuda dig arbetstillfällen.

Vi ser gärna att du som studerar och söker denna tjänst är inskriven på längre studier och att du minst har ett år kvar av dina studier.

Om oss

aleja ab är ett bemanningsföretag verksamt främst i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder dygnet runt-jour till våra kunder, vilket innebär att vi har uppdrag under alla timmar på dygnet.

Vi bemannar inom en mängd olika branscher – bland annat inom transport och lager, bygg och rivning, sanering och renhållning samt andra tunga arbeten utan krav på större förkunskaper eller utbildning.

Vad vi kan erbjuda dig

Att arbeta hos oss innebär att du erbjuds möjligheter att dels kunna arbeta fast hos en och samma kund över en längre period, alternativt att på en kort tid få en bredare arbetslivserfarenhet genom många olika korta, intensiva uppdrag.

Vad vi söker hos dig


Vi söker dig som är morgonpigg, flexibel och inte rädd för att prova nya saker eller möta nya människor. Hos oss finns det även möjlighet att prova på olika typer av arbeten, bl a inom lager, sanering, montering, grovarbete och rivning.

För att du skall kunna bli anställd som extra personal hos oss måste du vara studerande, och kunna visa upp ett giltigt studieintyg, alt försörja dig på annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, tex ett annat deltidsarbete.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Just nu har vi en kund som behöver hjälp med renoveringar av balkonger.

I arbetet ingår bland annat rivning av väggar och golv samt grovstädning.

Our focus is on enabling faster, simpler, and more resilient technology outcomes that directly support business objectives, while contributing to helping the Australian community grow and thrive.

Working across multiple squads, you’ll connect the dots across systems, guide architectural decisions, and ensure we’re building scalable, secure, and resilient solutions that meet long-term needs.

Partnering with senior engineering leaders, architects, product leaders, and engineering managers, you’ll align technical direction to strategy; while staying close enough to delivery to influence outcomes where it matters most.

You won’t just influence a single team, you’ll shape how engineering is done across the organisation.

title: Senior Engineer, Agency Planning and Implementation
description:
DCAS's mission is to make city government work for all New Yorkers. From managing New York City’s most iconic courthouses and municipal buildings, to purchasing over $1 billion annually in goods and services for more than 80 City agencies what we do ensures that all agencies can deliver on their mission. Our reach touches every facet of city government and is instrumental to the successful day-to-day operations of the City of New York.

Our commitment to equity, effectiveness and sustainability guides our work providing City agencies with the critical resources and support needed to succeed, including:
- Recruiting, hiring, and training City employees.
- Managing 56 public buildings.
- Acquiring, selling, and leasing City property.
- Purchasing over $1 billion in goods and services for City agencies.
- Overseeing the greenest municipal vehicle fleet in the country.
- Leading the City's efforts to reduce carbon emissions from government operations.

When you work at DCAS, you're not just working for one agency, but in service of them all. It's an opportunity to provide impactful support, quality customer service, and help protect the future of New York City for generations to come. Visit our website at nyc.gov/dcas to learn more about the work we do.

The Department of Citywide Administrative Services’ (DCAS) Division of Energy Management (DEM) serves as the hub for emissions reduction and energy management for the City government portfolio. DEM develops the City’s annual utility energy budget; manages the City’s utility accounts; helps our agency partners identify and pursue energy-saving opportunities at their facilities; leads energy efficiency and distributed generation projects across the City’s portfolio; and helps implement operations and maintenance best practices.

DEM is tasked with leading the City’s efforts to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from City government operations 40 percent by 2025 (40x25), 50 percent by 2030 (50x30), and 80 percent by 2050 (80x50). Beyond 40x25, 50x30, and 80x50, the City has also made other energy-related commitments, such as pledging to install 100 MW of solar photovoltaics on City buildings by 2025. DEM works closely with our agency partners to help them reduce emissions and improve energy management in their facilities, including providing them with project funding, project delivery vehicles, technical expertise, staff resources, strategic planning support, and data analytics.

The Senior Engineer, Agency Planning and Implementation (API) will work within DEM’s Operations Unit, under the guidance of the Senior Director, API, but in extremely close coordination with DEM’s other units.

The Senior Engineer, API will be charged with responsibilities including, but not limited to, the following:

1. Oversee Energy Efficiency Project Development: The candidate will work with agency personnel, DEM programs and other technical entities to identify and develop energy efficiency projects through the review of Energy Efficiency Reports (EERs), Energy Master Plans, electrification feasibilities, local laws, energy codes, and previously funded and completed projects. Candidates may also develop scopes for decarbonization plans and electrification feasibilities to inform project development. Candidates will synthesize data from these sources to resolve project scopes and objectives.

2. Support Agency Energy Master Planning and Project Prioritization: The candidate will oversee the portfolio planning for city agencies and aligned stakeholders. Tasks include the creation of prioritization protocols and engagement procedures for city agencies based on various energy metrics and standing portfolio data. The candidate will support in defining early project objectives, analyzing building data, developing emissions reduction trajectories, and identifying implementation pathways. The candidate is to assist program directors and senior project managers with vetting, upkeep, dissemination, and organization of the information that results from these efforts.

3. Support internal process improvements: The candidate will work collaboratively to build training and knowledge management within API, including supporting training and exchange of information and building proficiency in energy efficiency technologies.

4. Oversee Perform Technical Calculations and Analysis: The candidate will oversee the (1) review of funding applications by agencies, including vetting energy savings calculators and reviewing supporting audits, as needed; (2) utilization and review of existing tools, such as energy calculators, energy models (table and computer aided), cost estimators, equipment sizing tools and other engineering tools; and (3) development of additional methods and performance enhancements to existing processes.

5. Support Upkeep and Integrity of Internal Databases and Processes: The candidate will be responsible for managing, tracking, and organizing project development data and files. The candidate may be required to generate, review, and validate various technical details across various platforms. In coordination with the Deputy Director, the position may require input and support in developing databases to aggregate project development and portfolio planning resources.

6. Liaise With Relevant Stakeholders: The candidate will regularly liaise, correspond, and meet with all relevant entities. This may include, but not be limited to, agency partners, DEM program staff, facility managers, consultants, contractors, and research and technical support entities and staff representing various city governing bodies.

7. Support Strategic Planning initiatives and External Communications: The candidate may be required to provide technical assistance and content and be a subject matter specialist to support senior staff at hearings and public-facing events. In addition, the candidate will be expected to support other DEM programs and agency personnel with information or other services as managed by the candidate or the aspects of DEM they influence, such as reviewing the development of various energy assessments, calculator creation or review of applications or vetting of other technical information created both internally and externally.

8. Oversees and manages Associate Engineer: Manages day-to-day work of staff, including successful execution of energy audits, reviewing and providing guidance on energy analyses, including coordination with consultants, site visits, and advising DEM staff. Provides training, professional growth and development, and technical expertise.

title: Market Analyst & Strategic Growth Specialist (Chinese speaking)
location: Vietnam, Hồ Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh City, 71100
description:
To act as the bridge between Chinese customers and Maersk’s local Mekong teams. This role captures and interprets Chinese customer requirements, translates them into clear, actionable briefs for local functions (Sales, Operations, CX, Product), and ensures that customer needs are properly understood and addressed internally. Additionally, the role gathers available market intelligence from public sources and direct customer interactions to support business decisions.

Who We Are

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and has been an industry pioneer for over a century. Through innovation and transformation we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organization reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

What We Offer

Maersk is the global leader in the industry, You’ll have the opportunity to work for a large global organization and get exposure to excellent processes and systems. You will join an organization that offers a challenging and rewarding career where everyone’s contribution is valued and rewarded.

On leadership and mentoring, Maersk has a nurturing management culture. Throughout their career, your leaders will support your ideas and provide necessary advice and training. You’ll be given the opportunity to prove yourself, as well as challenging work that develops your abilities.

On career development, there are wide range of roles in Maersk and Maersk has a very good career mobility program that establishes a culture of priority consideration to internal candidates and encourages employees to take responsibility for managing their careers whether to move laterally or vertically.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Understand & Translate Chinese Customer Requirements

  • Engage with Chinese customers (existing and potential) to deeply understand their logistics needs, pain points, expectations, and decision-making processes.

  • Translate customer requirements (language, business culture, operational expectations) into structured briefs for Mekong internal teams (Sales, Product, Operations, CX).

  • Act as the primary interpreter during cross-functional meetings where Chinese customer needs are discussed.

  • Proactively identify gaps between what Chinese customers expect and what local teams typically deliver.

2 Internal Coordination & Requirement Communication

  • Work closely with local Sales, Products and CX to ensure customer needs are accurately reflected in service proposals and SLAs.

  • Support the development of customer requirement summaries for each strategic Chinese account, highlighting specific expectations on responsiveness, flexibility, reporting, and escalation.

  • Facilitate internal workshops to educate local teams on Chinese business culture and common expectations.

  • Follow up with internal functions to ensure that customer requirements are being actioned and met.

3 Market Intelligence

  • Monitor publicly available information on Chinese investment trends in Mekong (news, government announcements, basic industry reports) – depth is secondary to relevance.

  • Gather customer feedback and competitor intelligence during client conversations.

  • Share relevant market updates with the team in a simple, actionable format (e.g., bulletins or quick summaries).

4 Support Ecosystem Building

  • Participate in selected chamber events as a participant (not as a lead generator) to stay informed.

  • Help identify potential partner needs based on customer feedback (e.g., “customer often asks for X service we don’t have”).

  • Support the PMO with customer-related input for SLA design and partner discussions

Who Are We Looking For

  • Language Fluent Chinese (Mandarin) – written and spoken – is mandatory (HSK6 or equivalent proficiency).

  • Work Experience Minimum 2–3 years in a customer-facing role, preferably in logistics, freight forwarding, or a related service industry. Experience working with Chinese clients is a strong plus.

  • Communication Strong ability to listen, summarize, and rephrase customer needs in a way that local colleagues can easily understand.

  • Interpersonal Skills Comfortable working with multiple departments; can bridge cultural and communication gaps.

  • Analytical Skills Basic data handling (Excel, simple pivot tables) is sufficient. Advanced analytics is not required.

  • Proactiveness Able to ask customers the right questions to uncover true needs, not just surface requests.

  • Cultural Awareness Deep understanding of Chinese business etiquette and communication style

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Out of the successful launch of Chase in 2021, we’re a new team, with a new mission. We’re creating products that solve real world problems and put customers at the center - all in an environment that nurtures skills and helps you realize your potential. While we’re looking for professional skills, culture is just as important to us. We understand that everyone's unique – and that diversity of thought, experience and background is what makes a good team, great.   • Able to take the initiative and shape their own path.

  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.

title: College Intern, Bureau of Public Health Clinics
description:
The College Aide will support the BPHC Advisory Group Coordinator in the planning, coordination, and facilitation of BPHC's quarterly Patient Advisory Group meetings, along with related work supporting BPHC's advisory groups more broadly. Each quarter, a newly recruited cohort of patients from a designated DOHMH clinic meets to provide structured feedback on clinic services, proposed programs, and communication materials. This role offers hands-on experience in community engagement, public health administration, and stakeholder communication within a NYC government setting. This role will require up to 25 hours per week, depending on the meeting cycle and Advisory Group Coordinator needs. The College Aid must be currently enrolled as a Graduate student.

Duties will include but are not limited to:
- Support meeting planning and coordination, including scheduling, logistics, and preparation of agenda and materials for quarterly advisory group meetings
- Assist in managing email communication with advisory group participants, including invitations, reminders, and follow-up correspondence
- Support virtual or in-person meeting facilitation, including meeting set up and break down
- Take comprehensive, detailed notes during meeting sessions
- Synthesize meeting notes and key meeting themes for approval by Advisory Group Coordinator and larger review by BPHC leadership, as well as dissemination to other relevant DOHMH teams and stakeholders
- Support other work related to BPHC's advisory groups as assigned by the Advisory Group Coordinator (e.g., recruitment support, data tracking, or related administrative tasks)
- Ability to report to in-person meetings at any of the City’s clinic locations

Preferred Skills:
- Experience and comfort communicating professionally with community members and patients
- Ability to maintain confidentiality when engaging with advisory group members and sensitive discussion topics
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Experience with basic data analysis (qualitative and/or quantitative)
- Extensive experience with Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.)

Why you should work for us:

- Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
- Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:
o a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
o a tax-deferred savings program and
o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
- Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.
- Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

title: Sjuksköterska/ambulanssjuksköterska till Ambulansen i Årjäng
description:
Vi söker nu legitimerade sjuksköterskor till ambulansstationen i Årjäng. Att arbeta inom ambulansverksamheten är meningsfullt och stimulerande där du hjälper människor i olika oförutsedda akuta situationer. Om du är ansvarsfull, stresstålig och trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter, är detta ett jobb för dig!

Din arbetsplats

Ambulanssjukvården i Värmland är länsövergripande med ambulanser placerade på tolv orter. Ambulanssjukvården utmanas av det akuta omhändertagandet av sjuka och skadade i alla åldrar och miljöer. Genom bedömning och hänvisning medverkar vi till att omhändertagandet sker på rätt vårdnivå med ett tydligt patientfokus.

Vi arbetar för en god arbetsmiljö med stimulerande arbetsuppgifter och en individuellt anpassad inskolning. Alla nyanställda genomför en individanpassad introduktions- och befattningsutbildning.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Arbetet som sjuksköterska inom ambulanssjukvården innebär att bedöma, hänvisa, vårda och transportera patienter prehospitalt, alltid med patientens bästa i fokus. Arbetet innefattar sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter för sjuksköterska inom ambulanssjukvård. Tjänstgöring både dag och natt.

Hälso- och sjukvård utgår från våra patienters behov och medarbetarnas kompetens. Vi vill driva hälso- och sjukvården framåt tillsammans med våra medarbetare.

Dina kunskaper och kompetenser

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska eller ambulanssjuksköterska med minst 1 års klinisk erfarenhet som sjuksköterska. Tidigare erfarenhet av akutsjukvård är meriterande. B-körkort med minst 3 års körvana är ett krav. C1/C-körkort är meriterande.

Vi ser att du är en ansvarsfull och flexibel person med god samarbetsförmåga. För att passa för tjänsten behöver du också vara stresstålig, strukturerad och tillmötesgående i ditt bemötande.

Uppfyller du grundkraven och vill hospitera ett arbetspass är du välkommen att kontakta Eila Autio, se kontaktuppgifter nedan.

Innan eventuell anställning ska du genomföra arbetstester samt genomgå en godkänd hälsokontroll som sker i regionens regi. Region Värmland verkar för en drogfri arbetsmiljö och tillämpar obligatoriskt drogtest vid nyanställning av personal.

Om Region Värmland

Vi är till för att alla som bor här ska må bra och för att vår region ska vara attraktiv och konkurrenskraftig. Vi gör skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och kultur och bildning. Vi möter människor i livets största stunder och i alla de där vardagsögonblicken där emellan. Vår vision är livskvalitet i världsklass. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss och våra förmåner och följ oss på sociala medier.

Vill du också jobba för alla i Värmland? Välkommen med din ansökan.

Övrigt

Från 7 juni 2026 gäller EU:s lönetransparensdirektiv - för ökad öppenhet och rättvisa löner. Information om kollektivavtal finns på SKR:s webbplats, Kollektivavtal -SKR

I samband med eventuell anställning kan vi komma att be dig som sökande att lämna ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Inför anställning inom psykiatrisk vård, vård av funktionshindrade, vård av barn eller ungdomar gör arbetsgivaren en kontroll i polisens misstanke och belastningsregister. Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning.

Har du skyddad identitet och vill göra en ansökan ber vi dig att kontakta Kompetensförsörjningsenhet HR via Regionens växel 010-831 50 00. Då får du hjälp att lämna in din ansökan utan att den hanteras i Varbi. Tänk på att endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Region Värmland tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: Sjuksköterska till Medicinenheten
description:
Välkommen till oss på Medicinenheten!

Vi på Medicinenheten är specialister inom mag-, tarm-, njur- , blod- och lungsjukdomar. Detta innebär att som sjuksköterska får man stora möjligheter att utveckla en bred kompetens inom ett brett område. Ett av enhetens mål är att arbeta strukturerat och ständigt se till förbättringar och IT-tekniska hjälpmedel.

På Medicinenheten har vi som ambition att alltid att arbeta med kompetensutveckling. För att du smidigt och tryggt ska komma in i jobbet erbjuds du en personlig mentor samt regelbundna avstämningar i en mentorsgrupp med syftet att ge möjlighet till reflektion över såväl yrkesrollen och din egen utveckling. Vi är måna om att du ska ha möjlighet att uppnå din fulla potential och känna tillit till Region Jämtland Härjedalen som arbetsgivare.

Här finns även möjligheten att få vidareutbildning inom medicin samt onkologi utan kostnad, samt bedriva eget utvecklingsarbete inom ramen för tjänsten. Poängkurser inom magtarmsjukdomar, blod och njurmedicin erbjuds när tillfälle ges.

Vill du bli en del av Region Jämtland Härjedalen – en region att längta till och växa i? Hos oss bidrar du till utveckling och tillväxt i hela länet och arbetar för att erbjuda bästa möjliga service, vård och stöd för alla som bor i eller besöker regionen.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsmiljö präglad av samarbete, delaktighet och engagemang, där både bredd och spetskompetens tas till vara. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas i din roll, oavsett om du är ny i yrket eller har lång erfarenhet.

Söker du ett utmanande och utvecklande jobb?

5 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
På Medicinenheten träffar du patienter med sjukdomar inom blod, mage, -tarm, njure och lunga. Tjänsten innebär rotationsarbete under dagar, kvällar och nätter. Vi erbjuder även möjligheten att enbart jobba som nattsjuksköterska.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska. Som person är du nyfiken, framåt och ser det som en självklarhet att arbeta tillsammans med andra i ett team, och att bidra till hela Medicinenheten. Du arbetar för att säkerställa en trygg och säker vård, tror på utveckling och ser möjligheter i det dagliga arbetet såväl som inom hela vården.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.

I Region Jämtland Härjedalen genomsyras vårt arbete av våra kärnvärden: vi skapar värde för de vi är till för, agerar med handlingskraft och strävar efter att alltid upplevas som pålitliga. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en organisation där dessa värden präglar vardagen och där ditt arbete verkligen gör skillnad.

Som medarbetare får du tillgång till ett brett utbud av förmåner via vår förmånsportal. Vi värnar om din hälsa och erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag eller friskvårdstimme. På Östersunds sjukhus kan du dessutom träna gratis på gymmet Zefyren och delta i ledarledda pass.

Urval och tillsättning kan ske löpande under annonseringstiden, så vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vi har ett etablerat medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför vänligt men bestämt kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

title: Mid-Level Python Developer (Backend)
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize high-concurrency backend systems for client projects. You will own features end-to-end, taking them from technical design to deployment. You will leverage modern async Python, strict type-safety, and AI-assisted workflows to ship resilient code fast.

What You Will Do:

  • Feature Delivery: Own backend features end-to-end from schema design and API endpoints to production deployment.
  • API & Core Development: Write clean, well-tested async Python code (e.g., FastAPI) and apply modern type-safety practices.
  • Data & System Integration: Integrate backend services with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy/SQLModel), caching layers, and asynchronous message queues.
  • Smart Engineering: Integrate AI-assisted workflows (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot) across your daily lifecycle to rapidly prototype, write boilerplate, expand test coverage, and debug faster.
  • Quality & Reliability: Write comprehensive automated tests, optimize query performance, and ensure feature reliability in production.
  • Team Collaboration: Work alongside cross-functional squads and client teams to refine technical specs, conduct code reviews, and ship software iteratively.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Modern Python: Strong hands-on experience with Python 3.11+, including async programming (asyncio), typing, and REST API frameworks (e.g., FastAPI).
  • Database & Data Modeling: Practical experience working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and writing efficient SQL/ORM queries.
  • Engineering Practices: Proven habits around automated testing (pytest), code quality, structured logging, and git-based workflows.
  • Production Delivery: Experience shipping code to production, working with containers (Docker), and understanding basic deployment processes.
  • Communication: Professional English fluency; ability to explain technical decisions clearly to teammates.

Nice to Have:

  • Practical experience with AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor), or openness to integrating them into your development habits.
  • Knowledge of integrating AI/LLM components into backend workflows (e.g., LangChain, vector databases).
  • Experience with message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka) or key-value stores (Redis).
  • Familiarity with modern package managers, linters, and formatters (e.g., uv, Poetry, Ruff).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • German language skills (B2+).

Why Join Sopra Steria Bulgaria:

  • Global project experience with meaningful impact
  • Continuous professional and personal development opportunities
  • Approachable leadership and open communication
  • Empowered teams driving #OneTeam success

Benefits:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Food vouchers
  • 26 days of annual paid leave
  • Comprehensive health, life, and travel insurance
  • Extensive professional training programmes
  • Multisport cards
  • Modern office facilities are conveniently located at Metro Station G.M. Dimitrov Blvd.

Selection Process:

We carefully review every application and will contact you within the following week if we identify a potential match. As we dedicate time to assessing each application thoroughly, we appreciate your patience throughout the process.

Equal Opportunity

At Sopra Steria Bulgaria, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

Transparent & Fair Assessment

As part of our interview process, you may be asked to complete a job-related case study or practical assessment. Candidates are evaluated using standardized, role-specific criteria (Functional Expertise, Analytical Capability, Accountability, Stakeholder Interaction, and Collaboration) to ensure an objective, fair, and transparent selection process.

Candidate Data Privacy

Please read Sopra Steria's Candidate Data Protection Notice for more information about how we collect, process, and protect your personal data throughout the recruitment process.

At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: Hankintapäällikkö (sijaisuus)
description:
Sinituote on vahvalla kasvu-uralla ja etsimme osto- ja hankintatiimiimme vahvistusta. Olemme kotimainen perheyritys, jossa vastuullisuus ja ympäristöasiat ovat kaiken tekemisen ytimessä. Missiomme on helpottaa ihmisten arkea laadukkailla siivousvälineillä, kodinhoitotuotteilla ja autonhoitotarvikkeilla.

Etsimme nyt Kokemäen tehtaalle ratkaisukeskeistä ja neuvottelutaitoista Hankintapäällikköä reilun vuoden mittaiseen sijaisuuteen.

Työtehtävät

  • Vastaat omasta hankintakategoriastasi sekä strategisesti että operatiivisten ostojen osalta

  • Hoidat itsenäisesti hintaneuvotteluja omassa kategoriassasi ja vastaat toimittajayhteistyön sujuvuudesta sekä teet kilpailutuksia esimerkiksi nykyisille tuotteillemme.

  • Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä niin sisäisten kuin ulkoistenkin sidosryhmien kanssa.

  • Vastaat hankintaan ja ostoon liittyvästä raportoinnista.

  • Käsittelet mahdolliset reklamaatiot ja viet niitä yhdessä toimittajien kanssa ratkaisukeskeisesti eteenpäin.

Odotamme sinulta

  • Vahvaa kokemusta hankinnan tai oston tehtävistä

  • Kyvykkyyttä ja osaamista hintaneuvotteluista.

  • Ymmärrystä tuonnin ja logistiikan prosesseista – vaikka käytössämme on ulkopuolinen huolitsija, kansainvälisen toimitusketjun perusperiaatteiden hallinta on tehtävässä tärkeää.

  • Aiempaa kokemusta ERP-järjestelmien käytöstä.

  • Itsenäistä, omatoimista ja jämäkkää työskentelyotetta. Pystyt pitämään langat käsissäsi ja edistämään asioita proaktiivisesti nopeatempoisessakin arjessa.

  • Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa

SINI:llä tarjoamme

  • Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin, jossa pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti hankinnan ja oston parissa.

  • Työpaikan aidosti vastuullisessa yrityksessä. Taistelemme kertakäyttökulttuuria ja muoviroskaa vastaan. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että jo yli puolet tehtaillamme käytetystä muoviraaka-aineesta on kierrätettyä, ja tuotteemme on suunniteltu kestämään aikaa.

  • Panostusta hyvinvointiisi. Tavoitteenamme on tyytyväinen ja hyvinvoiva henkilöstö. Arkeamme ohjaavat mutkaton yrityskulttuuri sekä konkreettiset teot, kuten yhteiset, päivittäiset keppijumppahetket!

Kuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta työpaikaltasi?

Lähetä hakemuksesi meille viimeistään 8.9.! Jos sinulla heräsi kysyttävää tehtävästä, hankintapäällikkö Laura Mäkivirta juttelee mielellään kanssasi lisää. Tavoitat Lauran arkisin klo 13–15 numerosta 044 291 3663 tai sähköpostitse osoitteesta laura.makivirta@sinituote.fi.

title: Lead Logistics - Planning Process Expert
location: Vietnam, Hồ Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh City, 71100
description:
Job Purpose

As a Planning Agent at Maersk VNGSC, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional service to customers throughout their journey with Maersk SCM. You will act as a key liaison among shippers, carriers, internal teams and customers, ensuring smooth communication, timely resolution of cases, and compliance with operational standards as well driving service quality alongside related stakeholders. The candidate is expected to have a passion for logistics, strong decision-making skills, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to pursue continuous improvement.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • Ocean booking management: Own the end-to-end booking process for FCL and LCL shipments. Monitor POs and shippers’ bookings. Secure vessel space, manage cut-off dates, and handle booking confirmations directly with ocean carriers and shippers.
  • Customer relationship management: Act as the primary, high-touch contact for assigned accounts, providing proactive communication, shipment status updates, and expert advice to shippers and consignees.
  • Shipper/carrier performance management: Actively monitor the operational performance of shippers (timeliness of cargo ready and SI/VGM submission) and ocean carriers (schedule adherence, documentation accuracy). Identify performance gaps and collaborate with related stakeholders to implement corrective actions.
  • Process compliance and standardization: Oversee the accurate and timely performance of downstream processes, including system update, carrier bills and shipper documents, and invoices to ensure strict compliance with customers’ SOP and international regulations. During account migration from other teams, find opportunities for automation and process standardization to reduce workload and enhance efficiency.
  • Internal coordination & Quality control: Take ownership of the service quality delivered. Coordinate seamlessly with overseas agents, customs brokerage, and downstream teams to prevent bottlenecks and resolve operational escalations swiftly.
  • Problem resolution: Investigate and take ownership of service deviations, container rollovers, and transit delays, providing clients with immediate and structured resolution plans.
  • Strategic reporting & KPI management: Manage monthly performance reports for clients and internal stakeholders, analyzing shipping volumes, transit times, and service exceptions. Monitor and report on team and individual KPIs (e.g., booking acceptance rate, on-time documentation), providing data-driven insights for service improvement.
  • Rate card management: Verify and audit all internal and external rate cards, ensuring rates and surcharges are accurately reflected and applied prior to quoting and invoicing. Perform basic revenue analysis per shipment/account. Identify and report on discrepancies, low-margin shipments, and opportunities for cost optimization.
  • System implementation: Lead the migration of client accounts from the old system (MODS) to the new platform (SCP), including initial configuration, dry-run testing, feedback for enhancements and final deployment to ensure data integrity and seamless transition.

🧠 Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 6 months – 3 years of experience in customer service, logistics, or administrative support (internships accepted).
  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work under supervision with limited scope.
  • Ability to escalate issues appropriately and collaborate across teams.
  • Familiarity with case management systems or CRM tools is an advantage.

title: Portfolio Associate I
description:
ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES


The candidate will be part of a cross functional team whose objective is to support management of client’s renewable energy assets and fulfillment of contractual compliance obligations associated with those assets. You will support optimization of all portfolios and execute completion of tasks that have been assigned to you.


Responsibilities include:

  • Gain expertise in the commercial, contractual, regulatory, and reporting obligations of an operating portfolio of renewable energy assets (solar, wind, BESS), and execute tasks to ensure portfolio compliance with all project agreements
  • Assist Portfolio Managers and other team members in tracking and fulfilling on-going tasks and deliverables; use Radian Digital software to drive workflow by managing tasks, tracking operations, administering contracts, ensuring regulatory compliance, and financial reporting.
  • Create and prepare performance and analytical reports for the operating projects.
  • Support ad-hoc technical and financial analysis and reporting.
  • Coordinate with the Technical Asset Management team and Operations and Maintenance (O&M) personnel on the performance and operations of the projects
  • Track project performance, weather, and operational data for operating projects through event tickets and O & M work orders. Understand and make use of the data in the context of supporting the optimization of projects and portfolios. Create templates for tracking and analysis as needed.
  • Manage document administration and data rooms for project specific documents.
  • Coordinate, compile and submit FERC, EIA and other regulatory compliance obligations with support of internal team members and 3rd parties.
  • Coordinate with the Financial Asset Management team and assist in billing and revenue tracking, invoice tracking, SREC administration, settlements and other financial deliverables.
  • Effectively participate in the creation of new SOP's and manage the updating of existing SOP's.
  • Support the management of relationships with key project stakeholders, including project owner & investors, power offtakers, O&M providers, internal cross functional team members and multiple external 3rd parties.
  • Organize meeting agendas, both internal and with clients; potentially lead meetings with O & M providers or other counter parties.
  • Provide excellent customer service internally and externally.
  • Lead small projects and activities.
  • Train and assist newer team members with standard tasks.
  • Drive Resolution of straight forward problems.


REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES


Renewable Energy Industry knowledge in the following areas:

  • Project performance data analysis, cost benefit analyses, project reporting and presentation
  • Able to liaise with clients on routine matters in a professional manner
  • Team player, effective at using interpersonal connections and customer service skills to achieve team goals. Proactive in supporting the PM and the team.
  • Able to listen carefully and speak clearly and professionally in all situations. Possesses business interpersonal skills and customer service skills. Able to read, interpret and extract critical information from various types of contracts.
  • Able to take ownership of tasks and pursue to completion, plan and organize meetings and communicate with clients and other key external stakeholders.
  • Able to adapt to changes in the work environment, manage competing demands and deal with frequent interruptions, changes, delays or unexpected events.
  • Able to analyze data and create reports
  • Demonstrates passion to learn in a rapidly growing often unstructured environment. Always looking to learn, grow and expand their knowledge.
  • Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner. Gather, review and asses information appropriately.
  • Ability to analyze complex data and create reports.
  • Working Knowledge of basic accounting and budget management.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATION & EDUCATION

  • Experience in renewable energy industry asset management or operations, plus some educational experience in renewable energy. Experience with PV, wind or BESS equipment and system design.
  • Experience in working with C & I and utility scale renewable energy projects. Familiarity with Community Solar management.
  • Proven documentation, presentation, and communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Customer service experience
  • B.E or B.Tech from a reputed college / university
  • Work-related experience in renewable energy / power generation preferred


REQUIRED SOFTWARE KNOWLEDGE

  • Expertise in MS Office MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Project) and Adobe PDF toolsets
  • Familiarity with asset management software systems & third-party monitoring platforms


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • At least 2+ years working with operating renewable energy assets: solar, wind or BESS
  • Business writing experience
  • Experience in a service provider environment
  • Experience with commercial renewable energy contracts
  • Experience with data analysis, reporting and presentation
  • Experience with a U.S. based company


PREFERRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Working knowledge of solar PV, wind or BESS equipment and system design
  • Working knowledge of C & I and utility-scale renewable energy projects and Community Solar management
  • Root cause analysis and problem solving skills
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Familiarity with asset management software systems & third-party monitoring platforms

title: Associate Director, Structured Finance
description:
Now, about this opportunity…

This is a relationship focused role where you'll play a key role in Judo’s Structured Finance team, supporting the ongoing growth and management of our securitisation lending business.

Working alongside a team of Directors and Structured Finance professionals, you'll manage a portfolio of existing customer relationships while supporting new customer origination activities and the structuring and execution of tailored securitisation financing solutions. Judo specialises in a range of asset classes that support the SME economy and require strong analytical capability, commercial acumen and attention to detail.

Internally, you'll work closely with Credit, Risk, Finance, Legal and other key stakeholders, contributing to transaction execution, portfolio management and customer outcomes across Judo’s Structured Finance portfolio. This role offers the opportunity to combine relationship management, credit analysis and securitisation expertise while making a meaningful impact on Australia's SME economy.

If that excites you, this just might be your dream job:

  • Managing a portfolio of existing securitisation customer relationships, including ongoing transaction management, performance monitoring and relationship development.
  • Supporting new customer origination activities through market research, due diligence and transaction execution across a range of securitisation asset classes.
  • Leading credit analysis activities, including preparing and presenting credit papers, undertaking cash flow modelling and assessing portfolio performance.
  • Reviewing investor reporting, transaction documentation and compliance obligations to ensure transactions perform as expected and remain compliant with agreed terms.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers and key internal stakeholders, including Credit, Risk, Finance and Legal, to deliver positive customer and portfolio outcomes.
  • Identifying, escalating and managing transaction, portfolio and operational risks while contributing to the continual improvement of systems, processes and customer outcomes.

You’ll likely bring:

  • Demonstrated experience within Financial Services, Securitisation, Treasury, Rating Agencies or Non Bank Financial Institutions.
  • Strong understanding of Credit Analysis, Structured Finance and Securitisation concepts, with experience assessing complex transactions and portfolio performance.
  • Experience managing customer relationships and working collaboratively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical capability, including financial modelling, cash flow analysis and data interpretation skills.
  • Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present information and recommendations clearly and concisely.
  • Strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and problem solving capability, with the confidence to identify issues, challenge thinking and drive positive outcomes.

Why you’ll love working at Judo:

  • Two Weeks of Additional Leave Every Year
  • Paid Volunteer Leave
  • Our signature Judo induction experience
  • Big Life Event Leave
  • Holistic Health & Wellbeing Offerings designed to support your best life, including access to GPs, nutritionists, coaches and psychologists via our partner, CU Health
  • Working from Home Setup Allowance
  • Flare Benefits & Discounts - access to a wide range of everyday savings and perks
  • Freedom to work flexibly with flexible work options including hybrid working
  • Equal access to Company Paid Parental Leave – up to 20 weeks
  • Education Assistance

title: FOREX söker säljare i norra Stockholm
description:
Är du en engagerad person med intresse för försäljning och valuta? Vill du ha ett spännande jobb inom service och försäljning?

Då kan detta vara det perfekta jobbet för dig!

Om jobbet

Vi söker nu Säljare och du kommer att jobba i våra butiker i norra Stockholm samt vara en del av ett team som hjälper kunder med valutaväxling och våra andra tjänster. Tjänsten gäller arbete i våra butiker i MoS, Vällingby och Kista.

Tjänsten är visstid på heltid, med start enligt överenskommelse.

FOREX har öppettider som passar våra kunder, därför krävs det att du är flexibel när det kommer till arbetstid. För att vara aktuell för denna tjänst behöver du kunna jobba kvällar och helger enligt vårt schema.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Sälja valuta och andra FOREX-tjänster
  • Ge kundservice och säkerställa en bra kundupplevelse
  • Hålla ordning i butiken och följa interna rutiner
  • Bidra till en god arbetsmiljö

Förväntningar på dig:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning eller kundservice, gärna inom detaljhandel och kundservice.
  • Du kan svenska språket tydligt, både i tal och i skrift. Du kan kommunicera och läsa på engelska, ytterligare språkkunskaper är meriterade.
  • Teknisk vana och erfarenhet av att använda datorer och kassasystem
  • Förmåga att jobba i team och mot försäljningsmål

Vad vi erbjuder

Ett utvecklande och omväxlande jobb med möjlighet att växa inom försäljning. Vi erbjuder utbildning och stöd för att du ska bli en expert på våra produkter.

Skicka din ansökan senast den 13 september. Urval sker löpande och tjänsterna kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

I vår rekryteringsprocess gör vi bakgrundskontroll bl.a. kreditkontroll och utdrag ur belastningsregistret före anställning.

Frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta Affärschef Shadi Hashemi på shadi.hashemi@forex.se. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mejl.

Frågor till fackliga företrädare (Unionen) kan ställas till unionen@forex.se

FOREX är ett familjeägt företag och Nordens marknadsledare inom resevaluta. Vi erbjuder även reseförsäkringar, kreditkort och internationella pengaröverföringar. Våra butiker finns centralt i Sverige, Norge, Finland och Danmark.

title: Barnvakt sökes i Göteborg - sporadiskt
description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!


Om uppdraget / About the assignment

Familj i Göteborg som söker sporadisk hjälp till deras 3 barn som är 2, 8 och 10 år gamla. Hjälpen behövs några enstaka tillfällen i månaden, cirka 1-3 gånger. Passen är varierande och kan vara från kl 15 på en vardag, ibland under helger eller någon enstaka övernattning.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

  • Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
  • Kurs i barn-HLR
  • Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
  • Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
  • Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
  • Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
  • Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen


Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.

title: Senior Specialist - Data Analyst
description:
Forma zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę

Lokalizacja: Sokolska 34, Katowice (praca hybrydowa 2 dni w biurze, 3 dni w domu tygodniowo)

O roli:

Stanowisko jest częścią zespołu Reporting Support, Data Modeling and Analytics Team, który jest odpowiedzialny za wsparcie procesów i środowisk raportowych w Pionie Finansów. W naszym zespole stawiamy na współpracę, odpowiedzialność, innowacyjność i ciągłe doskonalenie. Jako starszy specjalista - data analyst będziesz odpowiadać za przekrojowe analizy danych, projektowanie oraz algorytmizację procesów w zakresie danych finansowych i zarządczych. Twoje zadania będą polegały na budowie rozwiązań E2E (od budowy data setu po wizualizację w postaci raportu) oraz współpracy z biznesem, developerami oraz data scientistami w ramach automatyzacji AI.

Twoje zadania

  • współpracujesz z interesariuszami i zbierasz wymagania biznesowe

  • tworzysz algorytmy pozwalające efektywnie raportować dane i odpowiadasz za budowę POC

  • modelujesz i wizualizujesz dane na potrzeby analiz biznesowych

  • odpowiadasz za raportowanie danych finansowych oraz zarządczych

  • budujesz standard kontrolny pozwalający monitorować jakość danych (m.in. progi akceptacji, statystyki, prognozy, trendy)

  • opracowujesz i przedstawiasz rekomendacje zmian/usprawnień w zakresie modelu danych

  • przeprowadzasz testy akceptacyjne w ramach rozwoju środowiska produkcyjnego (data martów)

  • przygotowujesz oceny wpływu zmian na istniejący model danych

  • wspierasz linie biznesowe i analityków finansowych w zakresie algorytmizowanych i raportowanych danych

  • wspierasz rozwój rozwiązań AI automatyzujących analizę danych finansowych

  • przygotowujesz dokumentacje wspierającą zarządzanie

Nasze oczekiwania:

  • masz doświadczenie w analizie danych (min.3 lata)

  • umiejętnie odpytujesz bazy danych dzięki zoptymalizowanym zapytaniom SQL (m.in. funkcje okienkowe)

  • posiadasz doświadczenie w modelowaniu dużych zbiorów danych

  • umiejętne wykorzystujesz SQL/SAS 4GL lub Python w analizie dużych zbiorów danych (m.in: pobieranie danych z bazy, agregacja i transformacje danych, optymalizacja kodu dzięki wzorcom projektowym, budowa klas i bibliotek, działania na plikach, łączenie z zewnętrznym API)

  • projektujesz wizualizuje danych z wykorzystaniem narzędzi BI

  • bierzesz odpowiedzialność za swoje produkty, wychodzisz z inicjatywą i prowadzisz efektywne działania, by osiągnąć zamieszony cel

  • posiadasz wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne w zakresie logicznego argumentowania i krytycznego myślenia

Mile widziane:

  • znasz środowisko chmurowe Google Cloud i jego moduły analityczne (np.BigQuery)

  • posiadasz doświadczenie w modelowaniu dużych zbiorów danych w środowisku chmurowym

  • posiadasz doświadczenie w analizie danych dotyczących ESG np. śladu węglowego


To oferujemy:

  • Inwestujemy w rozwój - proponujemy dofinansowanie szkoleń i kursów oraz dostęp do platform edukacyjnych: Udemy Business, eTutor, wewnętrznej platformy elearningowej. Oferujemy także staże rozwojowe czy konsultacje z doradcami kariery

Pracując w ING masz możliwość dołączenia do Pracowniczego Programu Emerytalnego i Programu Profilaktyki Onkologicznej

title: Program Manager
description:
The Program Manager owns the successful strategy execution, coordination, and delivery of a portfolio of related projects for enterprise-level clients and is focused on achieving key business outcomes. The Program Manager develops the plan and direction, aligns cross-functional workstreams, and ensures that the combined output delivers measurable customer and business value.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Mapping

  • Define and maintain the overall program structure, vision, and multi-quarter roadmap.
  • Translate business objectives into program goals, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and sequence workstreams based on strategic impact, dependencies, and resource constraints.

Cross-Workstream Collaboration

  • Coordinate multiple workstreams (e.g., Strategic Consulting, AI scenario development, LMS implementation, content development, integrations, change management).
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, timelines, and delivery execution across all projects.
  • Manage interdependencies across projects and teams to prevent siloed decision-making and delivery conflicts.

Governance & Decision-Making

  • Establish and enforce consistent governance across all projects (standards, processes, reporting, escalation paths).
  • Drive program-level decision-making and escalate issues that impact scope, timeline, budget, or strategic alignment.
  • Facilitate cross-functional forums (steering committees, working groups) to resolve conflicts and align priorities.

Risk, Dependency & Issue Management

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate cross-project risks and issues that could derail program outcomes.
  • Maintain a living risk register and dependency map, with clear ownership and mitigation plans.
  • Proactively surface and resolve blockers that span multiple teams or systems.

Stakeholder & Executive Communication

  • Provide program-level reporting to executives and stakeholders (status, risks, decisions needed, value tracking).
  • Tailor communication to audience: tactical updates for delivery teams, strategic narratives for leadership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across functions (Product, Engineering, L&D, HR, Customer Success, etc.).

Value Realization & Continuous Improvement

  • Align program outcomes with customer success and business value realization (adoption, efficiency gains, revenue impact, etc.).
  • Define and track value realization metrics post-delivery to ensure benefits are achieved.
  • Continuously improve program processes, templates, and tools based on lessons learned and feedback.

Key Skills:

  • Thrives in ambiguity.
  • Able to influence without authority, and has a track record of turning complex, multi-team initiatives into coherent, executable plans.
  • Thinks strategically and systemically and can connect day-to-day work to long-term business goals, see interdependencies and optimize the whole, not just individual projects.
  • Operates as a servant leader, removes blockers, empowers teams, and fosters psychological safety.
  • Is decisive in uncertainty and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information.
  • Uses metrics to drive date-informed decisions, not just status reporting.

Requirements

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in program/project management, with at least 3+ years managing multi-project programs in a SaaS, tech, or professional services environment.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs (e.g., platform implementations, product launches, enterprise transformations).
  • Strong understanding of program management frameworks (e.g., PMI, Agile/SAFe, hybrid models) and tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet).
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically while staying grounded in execution details.

Preferred

  • Experience in Learning & Development, HR Tech, or AI technology(e.g., LMS implementations, content platforms).
  • Pharma sales enablement project management and/or program management experience
  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification; Agile/SAFe credentials a plus.
  • Background in change management, organizational design, or process improvement.
  • Experience working in small to mid-sized companies (50–200 employees) where roles are demanding, fluid, and impact is high

Benefits

Unboxed team members benefit from our comprehensive compensation and rewards program which includes:

  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • Ample paid time off
  • Dynamic and convenient office location – unlimited snacks, casual dress code, covered parking and gym on site
  • Open communication and a commitment to fostering teamwork across the organization

Salary Range: $115,000 - $150,000 annually

title: Reisadviseur Junior
description:
Met jouw ervaring in de reisbranche of achtergrond in toerisme ben je klaar voor de volgende stap. Vanaf je stoel reis je de hele wereld over en speel je moeiteloos in op de wensen van je team, je klant en wat er in de reiswereld gebeurt. Met je enthousiasme weet je klanten te overtuigen om die droomreis te boeken! 🏝️

Wat ga je doen?
Als Reisadviseur reis je met jouw klant mee vanaf het vakantie-idee tot het fotoalbum. Hierbij kan je denken aan onderstaande werkzaamheden:

  • Het verwelkomen van de klant;

  • Het in kaart brengen van de wensen/vragen/opmerkingen van de klant. Vervolgens anticipeer je hierop en onderneem je stappen om de klant een passend antwoord/aanbod te kunnen geven;

  • Je stelt reizen samen en communiceert tijdens dit proces continu met de klant én met onze partners (denk aan luchtvaartmaatschappijen, hotels en transferbedrijven);

  • Je zorgt voor een persoonlijke afronding met de klant en voorziet hen van alle nodige informatie.

Als reisadviseur sta je altijd klaar voor je klanten – ook op koopavonden en zaterdagen, zodat zij altijd zorgeloos hun volgende avontuur kunnen plannen.

Dit is wat wij én jij belangrijk vinden:

  • Van je passie je werk maken, elke dag bezig zijn met reizen! 🧡

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden: 24 vakantiedagen, reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenregeling.

  • Weten waar je aan toe bent: vaste uren op contract.

  • We weten dat je van reizen houdt: je krijgt korting op alle vakanties en gerelateerde producten of diensten vanuit D-reizen;

  • Elke dag is anders: werken bij ons is dynamisch – geen dag is hetzelfde, en je spreekt dagelijks nieuwe klanten met diverse dromen;

  • Uitdaging! Samen werken we aan onze individuele,- en organisatiedoelen. Voor de winkels die de interne uitdaging winnen, ligt een mooie beloning klaar;

  • Eigenaarschap: samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor de winkel, klanttevredenheid en omzet;

  • Een positieve sfeer. In onze "Make my D" complimentencorner vieren we successen met elkaar;

  • Een zachte landing waarin we je uitgebreid meenemen in ons onboarding traject met behulp van ons online leerplatform D-Academy;

  • Toegewijde coaches die regelmatig inspirerende workshops verzorgen zodat jij alle ruimte krijgt om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. 🚀

Deze bagage neem jij mee:

· Enige werkervaring in de reisbranche;

· Een mbo diploma, bij voorkeur in toeristische richting;

· Je bent creatief en ondernemend;

· Een berg energie voor elke klant waarvoor jij de perfectie vakantie regelt;

· Sterke skills in plannen, organiseren en overzicht houden;

· Commerciële drive: je enthousiasmeert klanten zo dat ze hun volgende reis weer bij ons willen boeken!


Klaar om samen met ons vakantiedromen waar te maken?

Upload je cv en motivatie. We maken graag kennis met je!
Nog vragen? We zijn maar één belletje (of WhatsAppje 😉) van je verwijderd: 06 45 76 71 20.

description:

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise.
