title: Staff Software Engineer (Full Stack, React, Next.js)
description:
Staff Software Engineer (Full Stack, React, Next.js)

Business Banking Technology

*Sydney or Melbourne locations*

  • Shape the future of digital customer and colleague experiences across Business Banking.
  • Influence architecture, engineering standards and technical direction across modern cloud, data and AI-enabled platforms.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges across customer channels, data and AI at enterprise scale

Do work that matters

At CommBank, we're building the future of customer channels and data-led experiences for Australian businesses.

We're investing heavily in the next generation of customer channel, data and AI-enabled platforms that simplify how customers and colleagues engage with the bank. Our teams are creating modern, scalable technology that helps customers access insights, complete critical banking journeys and connect with the right banking services more easily.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll join one of several engineering crews across our Customer Channel & Data domain. Depending on your experience and interests, you may contribute to customer-facing channels, banker and CRM experiences, data-driven services, AI-enabled engagement platforms or core platform capabilities. You'll help shape products used across Business Banking while influencing engineering direction across a rapidly growing technology organisation.

This is an opportunity to work on platforms undergoing significant transformation, modernising how customer and colleague experiences are delivered through contemporary cloud, data and software engineering practices.

See yourself in our team

Business Banking Technology executes the Technology Strategy across Business Banking through the world-leading application of technology and operations. We partner closely with the business to solve real-world problems using data and AI-driven insights, resilient platforms and modern engineering practices, delivering customer value at speed and scale.

You'll join a growing engineering organisation responsible for critical capabilities including:

  • Customer and colleague digital experiences
  • CRM and banker platform capabilities
  • Data-driven insights and decisioning services
  • AI-enabled customer engagement experiences
  • Shared platform services supporting Business Banking journeys

Working closely with engineers, product managers, architects, data specialists and business stakeholders, you'll help solve complex technical challenges while mentoring engineers and contributing to engineering excellence across the domain.

What you'll do

  • Lead the design and delivery of scalable, resilient software solutions across customer channel and data platforms.
  • Build and evolve applications, APIs, services and platform capabilities that support critical Business Banking experiences.
  • Contribute across the technology stack, including backend services, cloud platforms, customer experiences and data-enabled solutions.
  • Drive architectural decisions and influence engineering direction within and across squads.
  • Champion modern software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability and DevSecOps.
  • Partner closely with product, business and architecture stakeholders to deliver meaningful customer outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers and help grow technical capability across the broader organisation.
  • Support platforms in production and drive continuous improvement through automation, monitoring and operational excellence.

We're interested in hearing from people who have

  • Proven experience designing and delivering complex software solutions within large-scale or distributed environments.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering capability and a passion for solving challenging technical problems.
  • Experience building cloud-native applications, APIs, platforms or data-driven services.
  • The ability to balance strategic technical thinking with hands-on delivery.
  • Experience influencing technical direction, architecture and engineering standards.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and uplifting capability across teams.

Experience in customer channels, digital platforms, CRM, data services, AI-enabled products or financial services is highly regarded, but not essential. We're looking for exceptional engineers who can learn quickly, apply sound judgement and make an impact across a variety of product areas.

Technical skills

We value strong engineering fundamentals over expertise in any single language or framework. Our teams use a range of technologies across customer channels, platform services, data and AI-enabled experiences. Experience with some of the following will help you succeed.

Engineering Craft

  • Strong experience in React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js
  • Cloud & Platform: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation)
  • Engineering Excellence: CI/CD pipelines, Automated testing, Observability and monitoring, DevSecOps practices, Agile software delivery
  • Safe and effective use of AI-powered engineering tools to improve development productivity and quality
  • Experience in .Net or Python is a big plus
  • Microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Modern application design patterns including Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Working with us

At CommBank, we're committed to creating an accessible, inclusive and respectful workplace. If you require support or adjustments, please let us know.

Apply today!

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

description:
DCAS's mission is to make city government work for all New Yorkers. It's an opportunity to provide meaningful support, quality customer service, and help protect the future of New York City for generations to come. Visit our website at NYC.GOV/DCAS to learn more about the work we do.

DCAS Information Technology works in conjunction with the NYC Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI) on the daily management and support of the DCAS computer network. DCAS IT team members are responsible for the agencies software and hardware needs, the development and maintenance of applications, maintenance of the DCAS internet and intranet (DCASConnect) sites, the DCAS Help Desk, telecommunications services and equipment for DCAS employees, and the Cyber Security program to thwart any attempts at unauthorized access to the network

The Infrastructure Engineer reports directly to the agency Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), responsible for protecting, monitoring, and enhancing the infrastructure and security posture of NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services information systems, applications, networks, and cloud environments. The position combines advanced incident response, digital forensics, threat detection, vulnerability management, cybersecurity analytics, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), and security operations functions. The role serves as a technical escalation point for cybersecurity incidents, supports enterprise security initiatives, conducts cybersecurity assessments and audits, develops policies and procedures, and collaborates with City agencies, vendors, and stakeholders to improve cyber resilience and operational security.

- Assist the Agency CISO in ensuring cybersecurity-related change management and CI/CD processes align with NIST separation of duties requirements.
- Support the CISO with agency cyber awareness training, security onboarding and readiness assurance, and knowledge transfer for cloud-based applications.
- Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, malware analysis, threat hunting, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities.
- Monitor and analyze security events, alerts, logs, and threat intelligence using SIEM, endpoint protection, cloud security, and monitoring platforms.
- Perform vulnerability assessments, risk analyses, remediation tracking, validation testing, and reporting across infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, and endpoints.
- Conduct cybersecurity audits, control assessments, risk reviews, and compliance evaluations aligned with NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, Zero Trust principles, and Citywide cybersecurity policies.
- Develop and maintain cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, playbooks, incident response plans, and operational documentation.
- Support Identity and Access Management (IAM) operations, including SSO, MFA, RBAC, access reviews, provisioning, deprovisioning, and privileged access governance.
- Analyze cybersecurity metrics, trends, vulnerabilities, incidents, and operational performance indicators; develop executive-level reports and recommendations.
- Partner with internal technology teams, application owners, vendors, City agencies, and external partners to improve cybersecurity capabilities and remediation outcomes.
- Support cloud security reviews, application security assessments, secure application onboarding, and software security initiatives.
- Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to junior cybersecurity staff and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Assist with audit readiness, evidence collection, regulatory compliance activities, and cybersecurity governance initiatives.
- Research emerging threats, technologies, attack techniques, and industry best practices to strengthen defensive capabilities.

title: Barnvakt sökes i Täby 2-3 ggr/v
description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!


Om uppdraget / About the assignment

Familj i Täby söker en barnvakt med omgående start. Uppdraget omfattar 2–3 dagar i veckan med hämtning av två barn, 3,5 och 6,5 år. Hämtning sker omkring kl. 16.00 och passet pågår cirka 2,5 timmar. Förskola och skola ligger på olika platser, därför är körkort ett meritkrav. Familjen har bil tillgänglig för uppdraget. De ser gärna ett långsiktigt samarbete.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

  • Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
  • Kurs i barn-HLR
  • Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
  • Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
  • Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
  • Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
  • Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen


Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.

Build what’s next in AI — and take it all the way to production.

We’re partnering with a large, complex Australian enterprise investing significantly in the next generation of Generative and Agentic AI.

This is an opportunity for an accomplished Data Science / AI leader who doesn’t want to step away from the technology.

You’ll lead and develop a talented team while remaining close to the build — shaping architecture, prototyping solutions, solving difficult technical challenges and helping turn emerging AI capabilities into secure, scalable, production-grade solutions with measurable business impact.

This is not a strategy-only leadership role.

We’re looking for someone who can lead, build and deliver.


Why this opportunity?

  • 🚀 Build production-grade GenAI & Agentic AI at enterprise scale

  • 🤖 Lead a high-performing AI/Data Science team while staying technically hands-on

  • 📈 Own AI initiatives from concept to production and measurable business impact


What you’ll be doing

You’ll take ownership of significant AI initiatives from early opportunity identification through to design, deployment, adoption and ongoing optimisation.

You will:

  • Identify high-value opportunities where GenAI and Agentic AI can solve meaningful business and customer problems

  • Turn ambiguous ideas into clearly defined, technically sound AI solutions

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Cyber, Risk and business stakeholders

  • Identify blockers, dependencies and technical risks early — and take ownership of resolving them

  • Translate complex AI concepts and trade-offs into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders

  • Measure success through adoption, customer outcomes, productivity and tangible business value


What we’re looking for

You’re likely already operating as a senior Data Science, Machine Learning or AI leader, but you’ve remained technically credible and close to delivery.

You'll bring:

  • Proven experience leading and developing Data Science, Machine Learning or AI teams

  • Recent hands-on experience designing and delivering production-grade Generative AI applications

  • Practical experience with Agentic AI and/or multi-agent architectures

  • Strong technical capability across architecture, prototyping and solution design

  • Experience taking complex AI initiatives from an ambiguous problem through to production deployment and measurable outcomes

  • A strong ownership mindset — you're comfortable creating clarity, making decisions and maintaining momentum in complex environments

  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders while engaging credibly with highly technical teams

  • A passion for applying AI responsibly to solve genuine business problems


Your technical toolkit

You don’t need to tick every box, but experience across several of the following will be highly regarded:

Agentic & Multi-Agent AI

GenAI Evaluation
Groundedness • Factuality • Safety • Reliability • Task completion • Latency • Cost • Business outcome measurement

MLOps / LLMOps
Deployment pipelines • Model & prompt versioning • Monitoring • Feedback loops • Continuous improvement

Responsible AI

Why consider it?

This is a rare opportunity to operate at the intersection of AI leadership, deep technical delivery and enterprise-scale transformation.

You’ll have the opportunity to work on sophisticated GenAI and Agentic AI problems, lead strong technical talent and — importantly — see the solutions you build move beyond experimentation into real production environments used at scale.

If you’re an AI leader who still loves getting into the architecture, challenging technical decisions and building solutions that actually make it into production, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential conversation.

title: Deputy Director of Natural Resources Restoration
description:
*ONLY OPEN TO CURRENT FULL-TIME ANNUALLY PAID PARKS EMPLOYEES*

*This vacancy is only open to 1) current permanent Parks employees serving in the Administrative Horticulturist civil service title or 2) on leave from the title or 3) permanent Parks employees in or on leave from a comparable title (e.g. Administrative Park & Recreation Manager or Administrative Community Relations Specialist) or 4) Parks employees who took and passed the Administrative Horticulturist Civil Service Examination (Exam No. 6005) or 5) Parks employees who are reachable on a comparable civil service list or qualify for a comparable title. [Please indicate the exam number and your list number or comparable title on your resume.]

Natural Resources Capital Design and Construction is a team of designers, foresters, project managers and construction mangers who translate natural areas management goals for Parks' forests, wetlands and waterways into capitally-funded restoration and construction projects. We design and construct wetland, shoreline, riverine and forest restoration projects, green infrastructure retrofits and public access corridors within sensitive habitats and natural areas.

Major Responsibilities
- Under direction of the Director of Natural Resources Design and Construction, with very great latitude for the exercise of independent judgment or action, oversee all NRG restoration and construction projects, ensuring that they are completed on time and within budget.
- Work with agency leadership, staff scientists, Maintenance and Operations staff and other stakeholders to ensure that construction meets targets for ecological function and/or reduces ecological impacts while addressing Agency and community goals.
- Ensure all construction is responsive to Federal, State and local regulatory frameworks, including all required filings, reviews and approvals. Ensure that permitting and external agency review timelines are factored into project schedules and tracked throughout construction.
- Develop the professional capacity of Construction Supervisors, Senior Foresters and their direct reports. Responsibilities include but are not limited to administrative oversight of staff, hiring, training and coaching, disciplinary process when necessary and health and safety.
- Work with Construction Supervisor(s) and Senior Forester(s) to ensure that all construction operations comply with contract specifications and documents; Assess and monitor progress of construction by reviewing and approving requests for Information, submittals and shop drawings.
- Participate in site inspections to ensure quality assurance when warranted. Direct contractors on compliance with plans and specifications and approve changes in the field.
- Ensure lessons learned in the field are communicated across teams to ensure continuous improvement of contract documents and construction management processes.
- Oversee constructability review of project drawings during design phase (75% - 90% complete).
- Assist Parks lawyers and City Law department in the timely preparation of documents to support Parks’ position in contractor claims and other negotiations.
- Assist in the monitoring of various contract administrative requirements, including Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprise (M/WBE) goals, grant reimbursements and Project Labor Agreements.
- May act on behalf of the Director of Natural Resources Design and Construction and carry out all associated tasks, including supervision of the entire team, as needed.

Work Location: The Grove, Rego Park, Queens

All applicants must apply via cityjobs.nyc.gov. The City is no longer using ESS to accept applications.

*Current Employees please include your ERN on your cover letter and resume.

NOTE: All resumes must be received no later than the last day of the posting period. References will be required upon request.

nyc.gov/parks

title: Automationsingenjör - Industriell maskintillverkning
description:
Vill du arbeta nära tekniken och vara med och utveckla avancerade, helautomatiserade produktionslösningar från förfrågan till installerad anläggning? Vi söker en erfaren automationsingenjör med fokus på PLC- och / eller Robot- programmering som vill bli en del av vårt automationsteam på Camatec.

OM JOBBET I rollen kommer du huvudsakligen programmera och driftsätta automationslösningar. Du kommer att arbeta genom hela kedjan – från koncept till driftsatt maskin.

Arbetsuppgifterna består av att:

  • Delta i konceptutveckling för automationslösningar och produktionsutrustning.

  • Programmera och driftsätta industrirobotar (primärt ABB-robotar).

  • Programmera och driftsätta PLC-system (primärt Siemens).

  • Arbeta praktiskt nära maskiner och utrustning – installation, driftsättning, test, FAT, SAT.

  • Felsöka och optimera automationssystem i produktion.

  • Ta fram teknisk dokumentation.

VI SÖKER Vi söker dig som har mycket god erfarenhet av fullautomatiserad produktionsutrustning med avancerad maskin- och produktionsutveckling. Vidare ser vi att du;

  • Har mycket god erfarenhet av programmering av Robotar (helst ABB), och / eller PLC-system (helst Siemens) inom industriell automation.

  • Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med maskiner, produktionsutrustning och att driftsätta dessa ute hos kund.

  • Har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt – du ser och tar hänsyn till helheten.

  • Uppskattar att samarbeta tvärfunktionellt – PLC-programmering, Robot, el, mekanik, hydraulik, pneumatik, produktion – och kan kommunicera tekniska lösningar på ett tydligt sätt.

  • Har svenskt medborgarskap då vi har flertalet försvarsprojekt.

  • Med fördel talar och skriver flytande svenska samt engelska.

  • Innehar B-körkort

  • Meriterande: erfarenhet av: SCADA-system (helst Ignintion) / PLC-programmering / kommunikationsprotokoll / elschemaläsning / maskinsäkerhet / dokumentation

VI ERBJUDER Vi erbjuder dig en roll med tydligt tekniskt ansvar inom avancerad teknik och skräddarsydd maskinutveckling. Camatec är verksamma inom flertalet branscher, bl.a inom försvarsindustrin, så här får du delta i projekt med krav på hög säkerhet och kvalitet. Dessutom i en företagskultur där idéer välkomnas och i ett team med stor nyfikenhet och drivkraft. Fantastiska förutsättningar för kunskapsutbyte och fortsatt utveckling!

OM TJÄNSTEN & ANSÖKAN

  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidare

  • Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

  • Lön och förmåner: Lön enligt överenskommelse. Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter och hög grad att påverka arbetsroll med flexibilitet och hybrid placering. Omfattande kompensationspaket med tjänstepension, privatvårdsförsäkringspaket, friskvård, företagshälsovård, möjlighet till personalbil, förmånscykel samt ett generöst bonusprogram.

  • Placering: Stockholm, Västerås, Karlstad eller Årjäng. Resor i tjänsten förekommer, exempelvis vid driftsättning.

  • Ansökan: Vi intervjuar löpande så skicka in din ansökan snarast möjligt! Har du några frågor så kontakta gärna Affärsområdeschef Oscar på oscar.adolfsson@camatec.se.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At Mindera, we craft software with people we love. 💛

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build and run the pipelines and platforms that move our customers' data: from source systems to the warehouse, on production systems with real consequences.

We value empathy, self-organization, and the courage to take risks. If you love solving complex problems and believe that teaching others is the best way to learn, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re looking for someone who loves to build, learn, and guide others. You’ll be working closely with our leadership (CEO/COO) and our clients, so clear communication and a collaborative spirit are key.

At Mindera we encourage the use of AI to assist with coding and related tasks. We find a persons skill in engineering and software craft, has a big impact long term successful delivery, with or without AI. Our goal in the interview process is to understand the candidates knowledge and skill with engineering.

If you need to, or plan to use AI, please be transparent with us when you're using it, to avoid issues and misunderstandings that can either: impact your chance of securing the role or impact your success at Mindera.

When you join Mindera we welcome you into a fun and politics-free work culture, built on the principles of lean and self-organisation.

Note: Depending on the project and our clients' needs, you may get the chance to pack your bags and take off every now and then. Typically, we estimate travel time to be between 0% and 15%.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Pipeline Engineering: Build and operate robust ingestion pipelines (both batch and streaming) from databases, event streams, and third-party APIs.
  • Storage & Performance: Own storage architecture across the lake, lakehouse, and warehouse, optimizing for partitioning, cost efficiency, and query speed.
  • Reliability & Observability: Keep pipelines observable and restartable by implementing orchestration, automated testing, alerting, and ensuring clean recovery when something breaks at 08:00.
  • Engineering Best Practices: Work like a true software engineer by implementing infrastructure as code, CI/CD for data workloads, code reviews, and strict version control.
  • Data Contracts & Governance: Agree on data contracts with data-producing teams to keep schema drift under control, while managing access, retention, and lineage.
  • Lasting Documentation: Produce clear and comprehensive documentation that ensures your work outlives the engagement.

Requirements

We're Looking for Someone Who:

  • Has Proven Production Experience: You have built and ran data pipelines in production—and, more importantly, you can articulate what you learned when they broke.
  • Is an AI-Augmented Engineer: You seamlessly integrate AI tooling into your daily workflow, but you maintain the strict review discipline to verify what it generates before it ships.
  • Is a Confident Communicator: You possess fluent English and are completely comfortable working directly with customer teams.
  • Has a Cost Engineering Mindset (Valued): You know how to make a pipeline cheaper and can quantify the savings.
  • Understands Compliance (Valued): You have exposure to regulated environments, including GDPR obligations, access control, and auditable lineage.

Your Technical Toolkit:

  • Core Languages: Advanced, production-grade SQL and Python.
  • Cloud Platforms: Production depth in one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with a solid grasp of principles to move between them. (A second cloud platform is a plus).
  • Orchestration: Production experience with an orchestrator from a main vendor (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent).
  • Warehousing & Transformation (Nice to have): Warehouse depth in Snowflake or BigQuery (dimensional or Data Vault modelling), and experience with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks.
  • Processing & Streaming (Nice to have): Spark or PySpark at scale, Databricks, and streaming/pub-sub brokers like Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or MQTT-class brokers.
  • AI Data Infrastructure & Formats (Nice to have): Embedding pipelines, vector stores, retrieval feeds, feature stores, and open table/file formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Delta).
  • DevOps & Quality (Nice to have): Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and data quality frameworks in production (Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo).
  • Source Systems (Nice to have): NoSQL stores (like MongoDB) and marketing/ad-platform data (Google Ads, Meta, CRM platform APIs).

Benefits

THE PERKS OF BECOMING A MINDER:

  • Private medical subscription
  • Private medical subscription for children
  • Counseling and psychotherapy services
  • Reimbursement for eyeglasses
  • Self-proposal salary process
  • Annual profit distribution, subject to company performance and board decision
  • Mindera Unit Plan
  • Flexible benefits options (sports, medical, cultural, donations)
  • Trainings and learning opportunities to grow within your role
  • Coaching and development guidance
  • 25 days holiday
  • Flexibility to choose where you work from
  • Vacation incentive
  • Parties, gatherings & trips

WHY MINDERA?

We're thrilled to have the opportunity to share with you what it's like to be a part of the Mindera community.

We're a group of friendly and talented individuals who work together to bring projects to life, in a fun, politics-free environment.

Our culture is all about being adaptable and self-organized. We want Minders to take risks, make decisions, work together and feel free to be their most authentic selves, every single day.

We work closely with our clients to truly understand their products and develop high-performance, resilient, and scalable software systems that make a real impact for their users and businesses, worldwide.

We are proud of our work, we're always learning and growing in our Agile and collaborative environment, and we hope you'll love it here just as much as we do!

Check out our Handbook & get to know us better:

Mindera around the world: Por to, Portugal | Aveiro, Portugal | Coimbra, Portugal | Leicester, UK | San Diego, USA | San Francisco, USA | Chennai, India | Bengaluru, India | Blumenau, Brazil | Cluj-Napoca, Romania | Valencia, Spain | Casablanca, Morocco | Melbourne, Victoria, Australia & Remote

title: Export Declarant (Frankfurt Office)
description:
About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.


Purpose of the Position / Responsibilities

The purpose of this position is to ensure the compliant, efficient, and timely execution of all customs-related processes within export operations. The role is responsible for preparing and verifying customs declarations, as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable customs and tax regulations.

In addition, the position involves communication and coordination with customers, authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth international goods movement and proper, transparent customs clearance procedures.

Areas of Responsibility

Customs Operations

  • Preparation of export declarations for exports from the EU (currently via ATLAS)

  • Preparation of all required customs declarations and documentation in compliance with customs and tax regulations

  • Execution of all formal customs procedures for exports in accordance with legal requirements

  • Port registrations for Frankfurt ZAPP (HDS, GM01, ASUMA-WKS)

  • Port registrations for western ports (PORTBASE, BHT, WHT, APCS)

  • Preparation of preferential trade documents (T2L/F, ATR, EUR.1, and similar documents)

Customer Management

  • Responding to customer inquiries regarding customs-related matters

  • Ensuring a service-oriented and customer-focused approach when dealing with internal and external customers

Stakeholder Management

  • Cooperation with customs authorities, including the submission of customs-related documentation

  • Coordination with other operational departments regarding import and export processes

  • Independent collaboration with authorities and internal departments in the event of customs-related irregularities

Communication Responsibilities

  • Clear and accurate coordination with customs authorities and internal departments

  • Documentation of all relevant customs clearance activities and transactions

  • Communication in German and English within international supply chains

Competencies

  • Professional expertise to independently prepare and review customs declarations

  • Decision-making authority in handling and resolving irregularities in customs procedures

  • Responsibility for the accurate determination and documentation of customs duties and import levies

  • Application of in-depth knowledge of customs law and related procedures

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and organize workload effectively

  • Confident interaction with customers, authorities, and internal stakeholders

title: Wegontwerper
description:
Hoe jij het verschil kunt maken?
Als wegontwerper maak je het verschil door je passie voor infrastructurele projecten om te zetten in hoogwaardige 3D modellen en gedetailleerde ontwerpen, waarbij je continu blijft groeien en uitdagingen aangaat in je vakgebied, om zo waardevolle bijdragen te leveren aan projecten en het cluster weginfra binnen de ontwerpafdeling van Boskalis Nederland.

Als wegontwerper gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van infrastructurele projecten zoals de Herinrichting Thorbeckeweg - N516, de HOV-Busbaan Leiden-Katwijk en de A2: wegverbreding Het Vonderen-Kerensheide. Als onderdeel van het projectteam wil jij wil graag werken aan eenuitvoeringsgereed ontwerp. Je vindt het belangrijk om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen in jouw vakgebied, zodat je een waardevolle bijdrage kunt blijven leveren op projecten.

De ontwerpafdeling draagt zorg voor de totale ontwerpexpertise bij tenders en verworven projecten, veelal met een integraal en multidisciplinair karakter.

Wat je gaat doen als wegontwerper:

  • Je werkt aan 3D modellen en werkt ze tot het gewenste detail niveau uit, maakbaar voor uitvoering. Je bespreekt het gemaakte ontwerp met het ontwerpteam en het uitvoeringsteam en onderbouwt de gemaakte keuzes.
  • Je reviewt en toetst ontwerpen en bespreekt deze met senior wegontwerper/ ontwerpleider.
  • Je neemt actief deel aan de werkgroep overleggen en werkt de bevindingen in klein teamverband middels werksessies uit.
  • Je volgt marktontwikkelingen op het gebied van wegontwerp en modelleren en draagt bij aan kennisdeling binnen het cluster.

Wat je meebrengt:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde mbo of hbo opleiding Civiele Techniek.
  • Je hebt relevante werkervaring in infrastructurele projecten als wegontwerper bij een (middel)grote aannemer of ingenieursbureau en kennis van normen en richtlijnen.
  • Je kunt overweg met applicatie software als modelleer software Civil3D en/of OpenRoads Designer (ORD).
  • Je hebt ervaring met raakvlakbeheersing en system engineering.
  • Je hebt de flexibiliteit om door Nederland te reizen om op de verschillende (project)locaties te werken.

Wat je kunt verwachten:

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving: Een baan waarbij je impact kan maken bij een toonaangevend bedrijf en waar je deel uitmaakt van een divers (internationaal) team van experts.
  • Salaris en meer: 26 vakantiedagen, een aantal aan te wijzen collectieve dagen en een premie vrij pensioen, bedrijfsregelingen zoals collectieve ziektekostenverzekering en een leaseauto.
  • Carrièremogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om persoonlijk en professioneel alles uit je carrière te halen. Daag je zelf uit met (online) trainingen in onze Boskalis Academy.
  • Boskalis campus: Ervaar de unieke Boskalis vibe op onze locatie in Papendrecht, compleet met restaurants, sportvelden en een kade waar onze schepen aanmeren. We bieden een state-of-the-art auditorium, brainstormruimtes, experience center voor klantvergaderingen en een nieuwe koffieplek waar je kunt afspreken met collega's.
  • Young Boskalis: Ben jij jonger dan 36? Kom dan bij Young Boskalis! Maandelijkse sociale en sportieve activiteiten, variërend van pubquizzen, yoga, bootcamps en een jaarlijkse zeilbootrace. Ook netwerken en kennis delen zijn een belangrijk onderdeel van Young Boskalis.

Extra informatie:

  • Jouw team: Cluster Weginfra is onderdeel van de ontwerpafdeling van Boskalis Nederland. Naast dit cluster bestaan de volgende vakgroepen: Vakgroep Ontwerpleiding, Vakgroep Constructie en Vakgroep Technische Installatie.
  • Bij de ontwerpafdeling werken ca. 60 medewerkers.
  • Waar kom je te werken: Als wegontwerper werk je regelmatig op projectlocatie of op ons kantoor in Papendrecht. Thuiswerken behoort tot de mogelijkheden.
  • Fulltime/parttime: Het betreft een aanstelling voor 32 of 40 uur per week.
  • Procedure: Solliciteren doe je eenvoudig door het online sollicitatieformulier in te vullen. We voeren sollicitatiegesprekken online en op kantoor. Denken we allebei dat we een goede match zijn na deze gesprekken, dan zullen we je een mooie aanbieding doen. Ben jij daar blij mee? Welkom aan boord!

Wil je meer weten?
We staan je graag te woord om al je vragen over deze functie te beantwoorden. Neem contact op met Joyce Hoornik, Recruitment Boskalis, via joyce.hoornik@boskalis.com of 06 - 1382 7817

Geïnteresseerd? Solliciteer door jouw gegevens in te vullen en je cv en motivatiebrief te uploaden op onze careers site.

title: Business Analyst - Integration Platform
description:
This intermediate level Business Analyst role sits within the Integration Platform team, helping define how customers and partners integrate with Vista systems through APIs.

Work closely with product, engineering, and architecture teams to translate integration and data requirements into clear specifications that support scalable and secure API-based solutions. This role is ideal for someone with strong BA fundamentals and a good understanding of APIs, data, and platform-based systems.

What you’ll be doing

  • Support discovery, scoping, and requirements gathering for integration and API-driven initiatives
  • Work with product, engineering, and other SMEs to clarify integration use cases and data requirements
  • Contribute to defining API requirements, data mappings, and user stories
  • Assist in analysing data to ensure it is exposed in a clear and usable way via APIs
  • Support the definition of integration flows between Vista systems and external platforms (e.g. partners, third-party services)
  • Capture and document non-functional requirements such as security, performance, and scalability
  • Facilitate workshops and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure alignment and clarity of requirements
  • Produce clear and structured artefacts including user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and documentation

Requirements

About you

  • Proven experience gathering and documenting requirements relating to software delivery APIs and integrations
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to break down problems into structured solutions
  • Confident communicator who can engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in evolving environments and adapting to new problem areas

Technical and domain capabilities

  • Good understanding of APIs and integration concepts (REST or similar)
  • Exposure to working with data structures or databases
  • Understanding of how systems interact and integrate, even at a high level
  • Awareness of non-functional requirements such as security and performance

Core skills

  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working in Agile teams
  • Ability to clearly communicate requirements and work through feedback with engineering teams
  • Good stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation skills
  • Structured approach to requirement gathering, documentation, and validation

What success looks like

  • Deliver clear, well-structured requirements that enable engineering teams to build effectively
  • Develop a strong understanding of APIs, data, and integrations over time
  • Proactively identify gaps or inconsistencies in requirements or data
  • Contribute to building solutions that are consistent and reusable where possible
  • Grow into thinking about platform and integration design, supported by senior team members

For this particular role, we are currently only considering applicants with the right to live and work in New Zealand without the need for employer sponsorship.

About Vista

Vista is a world-leading company that makes software for the cinema industry. Started in Auckland, New Zealand, over 25 years ago, we now serve cinemas, film distributors, and moviegoers worldwide.

Our HQ is in the City Works Depot in Auckland. We have offices and subsidiary companies in Sydney, Los Angeles, London, Amsterdam, Cape Town, Shanghai, Mexico City, and Kuala Lumpur. We use the latest technologies and offer a fun, agile and collaborative environment. We continue to innovate and build our reputation as one of the best Kiwi tech companies to work for.

Shared Standards

Our Shared Standards act as a compass for how we work together and reflect the behaviours we value at Vista Group. The way in which each member of our crew embodies these Shared Standards is an indicator for performance and success, as it aligns with our vision and strategy.

One Crew • We're a diverse team, in different places and functions, and we're at our best when we connect, help and collaborate

Shine a Light • We communicate openly, we explain the why, and we ask when we don't understand. We don't leave people in the dark

Make it Happen • We make good things happen as people and as teams through our focus on delivery

Chase Great • We challenge ourselves and each other to keep improving

Benefits

You will be supported to continually learn and improve your tech skills, share knowledge and ideas in the team, and be part of a dynamic and open culture.

We have a range of benefits that include:

  • Excellent work/life balance including a 4 ½ day working week
  • Hybrid working (home and office-based split, requiring 1-2 days attendance per week in the Auckland office)
  • Medical and Life insurance (after qualifying period)
  • Volunteer day, enhanced paid parental leave and wellness benefits
  • Strong mentoring & career development focus
  • Fun team events including the Vista Innovation Cup

If you enjoy a challenge and working in a dynamic and collaborative team, you’ll love working at Vista.

We value inclusivity celebrate diversity and are committed to offering equal opportunity to our staff and candidates — regardless of gender, age, race, ethnicity, marital status, disability, sex, sexual orientation, religious, ethical beliefs or political opinion. This commitment is reflected in all our employment policies and procedures.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Location: Ottawa, ON (Hybrid/On-site)

Security Clearance: Reliability (or eligibility to obtain)

Vacancy Status: This posting is for a new vacancy. We are actively hiring for this position.

Salary Range: $80,000 - $120,000 annually, plus benefits.

About Us

We are a member firm of the greater Raymond Chabot Grant Thornton & Grant Thornton Canada networks. OXARO is a dynamic and fast-growing technology consulting firm at the forefront of digital transformation within the Canadian public sector. Our mission is to partner with government agencies to modernize their applications, streamline their processes, and enhance their service delivery through innovative technology solutions. We are a team of passionate problem-solvers dedicated to making a tangible impact on our community.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to join a collaborative Agile team and lead the development of modern, scalable applications that deliver real business value. This role combines hands-on software development with technical leadership, providing the opportunity to influence solution delivery, mentor team members, and help drive innovation throughout the development lifecycle. You'll work closely with business and technical stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions that support evolving organizational needs.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Develop, prototype, and scale applications using modern full-stack development technologies, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Vue.js, Angular, Ruby on Rails, HTML, CSS, PostgreSQL, and authentication protocols.
  • Perform development activities supporting user onboarding, API development, system scalability, and application migration between environments.
  • Streamline business processes and procedures to meet evolving operational requirements.
  • Utilize project management and application repository tools, such as Azure DevOps, to manage user feedback systems, including bug reports, feature requests, and support tickets.
  • Maintain and continuously improve DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks, adapting to evolving operational requirements and threat environments while ensuring deployments can be completed in under 10 minutes.
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies with the Product Owner and Product Director.
  • Provide technical assistance and recommendations to support effective application development and delivery.
  • Liaise with Product Owners and Product Directors to review feature requests and maximize business value.
  • Act as a lead within an application development team, coordinating development activities and supporting project execution.
  • Prepare and maintain drawings, data packages, and system manuals.
  • Provide recommendations regarding feature timelines and story point estimates.
  • Provide expertise in the evaluation of new application concepts and initiatives.
  • Research, evaluate, trial, and report on emerging technologies.
  • Review documents, project activities, and Statements of Work.
  • Oversee and mentor Junior Developers, Intermediate Developers, and co-operative education students.

What You Bring To The Table

  • 5-10 years of experience developing software as part of an Agile software development team, including experience in custom software development, short iterative development cycles, CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  • 5+ years of experience working with 2 or more programming languages, such as Python, C#, Java, or Ruby.
  • 5+ years of experience with cloud infrastructure and runtime environments, source code management systems (e.g., Git), networking technologies and protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, TLS, HTTP, WebSockets, DNS), and gateway and firewall configuration.
  • Deep understanding of React fundamentals, including hooks, component lifecycle, and state management solutions such as Redux, or Context API, to build responsive and dynamic user interfaces.
  • Strong backend development experience using Node.js to build scalable, high-performance RESTful APIs and support asynchronous programming.
  • Knowledge of web security best practices, including the prevention of SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF, as well as application performance and load-time optimization strategies.
  • 5+ years of experience working with relational and key-value databases, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server, Cosmos DB, and Redis.
  • 2+ years of experience leading and mentoring a team of at least 4 software developers.
  • Bachelor's degree or college diploma in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related engineering or science discipline.

Additional Skills We Value

  • Collaborative Mindset: Brings a positive, solution-oriented attitude to group projects and thrives in a highly collaborative team environment.
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with a proven ability to identify root causes and implement effective, data-driven solutions.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications in AWS, including EC2 for hosting, S3 for static asset storage, RDS for PostgreSQL, and IAM for security management.
  • Experience building and consuming secure RESTful APIs and WebSockets, including the implementation of authentication and authorization mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth 2.0.

Why Join Us?

  • Make an Impact: Play a key role in modernizing Canada's public sector and see the direct impact of your work on our communities.
  • Career Growth: As a fast-growing company, we offer significant opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive and collaborative team where your ideas are valued and you can learn from some of the best in the industry.
  • Challenging Projects: Work on a variety of interesting and complex projects that will keep you engaged and continuously learning.

AI Disclosure:

We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of our recruitment process. All applications are reviewed by our recruitment team.

OXARO is committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace where every individual feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We believe that diversity drives innovation and strengthens our ability to serve our clients and communities. We are dedicated to ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process and welcome applications from members of the four designated groups under the Employment Equity Act: women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment process.

We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest in this opportunity. While we appreciate every application, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Oliver Wyman – Consultant Intern (m/f/d) 2027 – Copenhagen
description:
Company:

Oliver Wyman

Description:

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

As an intern, you'll join us for an 8-12 weeks internship and be a fully integrated member of a project team, working alongside colleagues and clients on real business challenges from day one. You'll contribute to meaningful client work, gain firsthand consulting experience, and develop the skills that will support your future career.

  • Contribute to client projects through research, analysis, problem solving, and the development of client recommendations and deliverables.
  • Work alongside experienced consultants, participating in team discussions and client interactions to gain firsthand consulting experience.
  • Receive ongoing coaching, mentorship, and feedback while collaborating with colleagues across industries and capabilities.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

  • Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.
  • Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.
  • Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a Leader

  • From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective.
  • Learn how to structure problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to team discussions and client conversations.
  • As you grow, you’ll build confidence, take on greater responsibility, and see the impact your contribution can make.

Learn and grow without limits

  • Build real consulting skills through hands-on project experience, formal training, continuous coaching, and mentoring.
  • Learn from experienced consultants and industry experts while developing your analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Expand your network across the firm and gain insight into the many career paths available at Oliver Wyman.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

  • Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.
  • Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.
  • Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

  • Participate in a structured internship program designed to accelerate your professional growth.
  • Build your network through intern events, social activities, and connections across the firm.High-performing interns may be considered for future internship or full-time opportunities, subject to business needs and local hiring practices.

Who can apply?

  • Students currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree and expected to graduate within the next 1–2 years.
  • Strong academic performance and demonstrated intellectual curiosity.
  • We welcome students from all academic backgrounds; no specific major or prior consulting experience is required.
  • Individuals who display initiative, creativity, adaptability, and a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Evidence of leadership positions, teamwork, entrepreneurship, extracurricular involvement, or other meaningful achievements is highly valued.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
  • Language skills: Danish and English (native/fluent).

How to apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

What to expect during the interviews process?

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business.

If you want to learn more about consulting interviews and start your preparation, please visit our careers page:

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. title: Senior Public Health Sanitarian, Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation
description:
Open to candidates who are permanent or those who have filed for PROMOTION TO ASSOCIATE PUBLIC HEALTH SANITARIAN Exam No. 6513.

The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, injury prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York’s most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. This includes hazards related to food safety wherever meals are served to the public, including restaurants, school cafeterias, mobile food vending carts, senior centers, and soup kitchens, first-hand and second-hand smoke for all places of employment and public spaces. BFSCS also monitors compliance with regulations in other facilities, such as tattoo parlors, correctional facilities, and homeless shelters. Additionally, BFSCS investigates environmental health complaints received from New York City residents.

DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
- Supervising Public Health Sanitarians (PHS) in the daily activities of the program.
- Assigning work to subordinates and establishing schedules for its completion.
- Reviewing subordinates' work and evaluating their performance.
- Taking corrective actions as needed to maintain unit performance at a satisfactory level.
- Training staff in new job procedures and/or skills.
- Orienting new employees to program rules, policies, and procedures.
- Performing special inspections, assignments, and investigations of difficult or unusual situations, and implementing appropriate corrective actions.

PREFERRED SKILLS:
- Strong Communication Skills
- Excellent Leadership and Supervisory Skills
- Exceptional Problem-Solving and Decision-Making
- Excellent Organizational and Time Management Skills
- Technical Knowledge
- Training and Development Skil

Why you should work for us:

- Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
- Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:
o a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
o a tax-deferred savings program and
o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
- Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.
- Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

Commitment to Equity:

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

The NYC Health Department is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation to all individuals. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact Sye-Eun Ahn, Director of the Office of Equal Employment Opportunity, at sahn1@health.nyc.gov or 347-396-6549.

ASSOCIATE PUBLIC HEALTH SANITA - 31220

title: Mobile BLE Engineer
description:
Salary: $80,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

ABOUT THE WORK

Aston Dynamics builds brake-by-wire systems for trailers and autonomous vehicles. Our electric-over-hydraulic (EoH) platform replaces conventional mechanical override and electric-drum trailer braking with electronically controlled hydraulic actuation, giving faster, more precise, independently controllable braking.

You'll be working on software with a physical consequence. The app you work on is how users actually meet the product: it connects to an actuator over Bluetooth, shows live data from a physical machine, configures hardware that stops a loaded trailer, and pushes firmware updates to it. You will spend time at the bench and on vehicles, working closely with the firmware and electronics engineers who build that hardware.

Our architecture is unusual and worth understanding before you apply. Our BLE stack is not a JavaScript library - it is a Rust core exposed to React Native through UniFFI, sharing protocol definitions with our microcontroller firmware. Every device-facing feature in the app - live telemetry, gain, sway, calibration, OTA - is a Rust function behind that boundary. The TypeScript is a thin layer over generated bindings.

That means there is no such thing here as a purely TypeScript mobile role.


TWO POSITIONS, ONE ADVERTISEMENT

We're hiring two engineers into the same codebase and weighting them differently.

Apply once; tell us which end you lean toward:

  1. Device-weighted - you'd own the Rust BLE core, the UniFFI boundary, the OTA path, and the protocol seam with firmware.

  2. App-weighted - you'd own the Expo/React Native app, the offline data path, release engineering, and the product surface.

Both need to be able to read and change async Rust behind a UniFFI boundary. Neither needs to be expert in the other's half on day one.


WHAT YOU'D WORK ON

  • Extend the Rust BLE library and its UniFFI bindings into the React Native app.

  • Build reliable device pairing. Several visually identical actuators may be in range, some belonging to other customers, with no operator-visible identifier on the housing. You'd design the disambiguation and make it durable.

  • Ownership of the over-the-air firmware update path.

  • Strengthen the security of the device link, including pairing, bonding and signed firmware images.

  • Implement device configuration and calibration at protocol level, including reading from and writing to device storage.

  • Design and build the offline data path: durable local queuing, retry, deduplication, and survival across restarts and reinstalls. This is new work, defined end to end with our incoming backend engineer.

  • Extend real-time visualisation of live actuator data, including choosing the right rendering approach for it.

  • Build a guided first-run setup flow so a technician can get started without training.

  • Implement multi-brand theming and build configuration so branded variants are configuration rather than app forks - themes, assets, bundle identifiers, signing identities and store listings.

  • Own store releases across variants: build configuration, signing, TestFlight and submission.

  • Debug BLE behaviour on physical hardware across iOS and Android: connection stability, backgrounding, timing and reconnection.

  • Build out automated test coverage for device-facing code.


REQUIREMENTS

  • A systems programming background. Our device library is async Rust and the firmware it talks to is embedded Rust. We don't require Rust on day one if you have strong C, C++ or similar, but expect to be writing non-trivial async Rust within weeks.

  • Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript. We're an Expo app end to end - expo-router, EAS, config plugins - which is materially different from bare React Native CLI.

  • BLE from the app side: connection lifecycle, notify/subscribe semantics, and the Android 12+ runtime permission model.

Additionally, for the app-weighted position:

  • App signing, provisioning and store submission - ideally at least one app you have personally shipped to both the App Store and Google Play.

  • Performance-sensitive rendering. We build our own instrumentation rather than leaning on a charting library.

  • Comfort making small changes to a Node/Express backend, with enough Prisma and relational-schema literacy to add a model or a migration.


NICE TO HAVE

  • UniFFI, or comparable cross-language binding and FFI work.

  • Native build-toolchain experience: Gradle, CMake, NDK, CocoaPods, JNI. Our native layer is generated rather than hand-written, so build-system skill is worth more here than native app development.

  • Prior OTA firmware update experience.

  • Embedded Rust, or embedded C with an interest in moving to Rust.

  • White-label or multi-variant app architecture.

  • Automotive, industrial or other safety-relevant systems.

  • Familiarity with NixOS.

title: Medewerker Groepsvoorlichting
description:
Medewerker Groepsvoorlichting bij MEE Rotterdam Rijnmond

Heb je altijd al kennis over mensen met een beperking willen overbrengen aan groepen? En hou je van afwisseling? Misschien ben jij dan wel onze nieuwe collega voor de functie van Medewerker Groepsvoorlichting. Je kan aan de slag voor 24 uur per week (3 werkdagen).

Wat ga je doen

Als medewerker voorlichting verzorg en coördineer je bijeenkomsten over het leven met een beperking of chronische ziekte. Dit doe je niet alleen, maar altijd samen met ervaringsdeskundigen. Je geeft zelf voorlichting en training op locatie – bijvoorbeeld over het herkennen van en omgaan met mensen met een licht verstandelijke beperking (LVB) – aan diverse doelgroepen zoals huisartsen, wijkteams, de politie, de gemeente Rotterdam en het beroepsonderwijs (van MBO-Verzorgende IG tot WO-Geneeskunde). Je doel? (Meer) begrip creëren, zodat deze professionals betere handvatten hebben in de praktijk.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw baan is de samenwerking met onze ervaringsdeskundige vrijwilligers. Je begeleidt hen en leidt ze op om voorlichting te kunnen geven. Ook begeleid je ervaringsdeskundigen bij het testen van brieven/websites van de overheid op ‘direct duidelijkheid’. De vrijwilligers waar je mee werkt vormen een diverse groep: zij zijn bijvoorbeeld visueel, auditief of motorisch beperkt, hebben een licht verstandelijke beperking (LVB), hebben autisme (ASS), niet-aangeboren hersenletsel (NAH) of een chronische ziekte.

Om alles in goede banen te leiden, ben je daarnaast verantwoordelijk voor de planning van de verschillende bijeenkomsten.

Ons aanbod

Je gaat werken in een gemotiveerd en leuk team in een heel afwisselende zelfstandige baan, geen dag is hetzelfde!

Zelf vindt het team ‘voorlichting’ dat zij de leukste baan binnen MEE hebben! Na een dienstverband van een jaar (en bij goed functioneren), hebben wij de intentie om dit te verlengen voor onbepaalde tijd. Het fulltime bruto maandsalaris bedraagt minimaal € 3.052, - en maximaal € 4.262 -, op basis van ervaring, bij een 36-urige werkweek (CAO Gehandicaptenzorg, schaal 45). Er vindt een cao verhoging van 2% plaats per 1 november a.s.

We bieden goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris en 8% vakantietoeslag;

  • Marktconforme reiskostenvergoeding en een NS Businesscard voor het werk;

  • 201 verlofuren (fulltime) op jaarbasis, met de mogelijkheid tot aan- en verkoop van verlofuren;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone

Je volgt het inwerkprogramma ‘Welkom bij MEE’. Een ervaren collega is jouw buddy. Je krijgt meerdere trainingen/cursussen aangeboden, waaronder een cursus Nederlandse Gebarentaal en een jaarlijks opleidingsbudget.

Heb je vragen?
Neem voor vragen over de inhoud van de functie contact op met Wilma Bruinen (coördinator voorlichting) via telefoonnummer 06 - 411 79 946. Wilma staat je graag te woord vanaf 31 augustus.

Wil je solliciteren?

title: C++ Developer
description:
Susquehanna technologists are at the heart of where cutting-edge technology meets the fast-paced world of trading. Our growing teams build some of the most powerful trading systems in the financial industry and solve complex problems in a constantly changing environment. From large scale computations, real-time systems, high performance computing to petabytes of data. By integrating sophisticated coding techniques with innovative engineering ideas, we design and optimise systems that can process massive amounts of data while still ensuring high performance and stability. Collaborating with traders and quantitative researchers, our systems engineers, network architects, technical analysts and software developers create competitive edge through best-in-class technical solutions.

As a Software Developer within our Trading Systems team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with traders and the firm’s top technologists. Ideally, you will have a background in trading systems and/or performance tuning and want the chance to compete against the best systems in the world.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and enhance trading applications by designing, implementing, and delivering complex software systems that meet the business needs.
  • Solve complex problems by providing innovative and scalable solutions with a focus on high frequency and low latency automated trading.
  • Bring/gain a thorough understanding of the business domain (trading, strategies, market making, market data and low latency).
  • This is a hands-on role where you will thrive on the technology challenges. You will see your ideas and hard work used by experienced traders across a diverse range of instruments and markets.

  • A bachelor's degree (or higher) in a technical or related discipline
  • A minimum of 2 years experience (upto 5 years is ideal) designing and developing applications using modern C++ on Linux, as well as proficiency in Python
  • Excellent attention to detail, accuracy and a thorough understanding of full life-cycle development and performance optimization/latency reduction methodologies.
  • A demonstrated track record of successfully delivering complex applications that meet demanding performance and scalability goals.
  • Experience in trading application development would be highly regarded.
  • Knowledge of financial products would be highly regarded.

What’s in it for you

Real Impact: As an essential member of the team, your role involves supporting, innovating, and optimising systems processing and models using massive amounts of data, all while ensuring high performance and stability. You’ll see how your contributions towards supporting leading-edge hardware and software technologies make a firm-wide impact that makes us all smarter, faster, and better.

Collaboration: You will partner closely with our Trading, Quantitative Research, Infrastructure and Strategy Developer Teams to develop and manage scalable and highly performant systems to support trading in the region.

Growth: We’re looking for people who are naturally curious, relentless problem solvers, and have the desire to continuously innovate, learn, and grow.

Benefits: Susquehanna offers a wide array of competitive employee perks & benefits

Explore our benefits and culture

About Susquehanna

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

What we do

We are experts in trading essentially all listed financial products and asset classes, with a focus on derivatives trading. Through market making and market taking, we handle millions of trading transactions around the world every day, providing liquidity and ensuring competitive prices for buyers and sellers. While our presence in the market is broad, our trading desks are highly specialised, allowing for a deep understanding of unique drivers of each asset class.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We encourage applications from candidates from all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities.

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

title: Clinical Supervisor
description:
Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  1. Provides clinical supervision of substance abuse treatment professionals to include discussing specific cases, problems, and treatment interventions with staff members on an individual or group basis.
  2. Audits clinical records on weekly basis, ensuring that quality and compliance deficiencies are identified and corrected.
  3. Plans, facilitates, and documents treatment groups and individual counseling sessions in accordance with clients treatment plan.
  4. Oversees discharge planning to promote positive outcomes and ensure continiuty of care.
  5. Completes and implements weekly programming schedule, ensuring adherence to program curricula.
  6. Completes biopsychosocial assessments and level of care determinations within 48 hours of intake in a manner which reflects SMR policy and procedures.
  7. Creates, monitors, and updates client treatment schedule, individualized treatment plan, and goals in a manner which is fully understood by client and which reflects clients individualized treatment plan and progress toward treatment goals.
  8. Attends and participates in all trainings, clinical meetings, and supervision groups during and outside of working hours as required by Clinical Director.
  9. Supports and assists in crisis intervention and at all other times deemed appropriate in a manner consistent with SMR policies and procedures.
  10. Assign cases to staff, signs off on treatment or discharge plans, review patient charts for quality and compliance.
  11. Provide back-up assistance to Therapists with group therapy and psycho-education groups as necessary
  12. Provide[LS1] clinical consultation to referral resources, family members, and others to help support clients in their recovery
  13. 25% direct service productivity
  14. Work closely with clients to engage them in the decision-making process and help them understand the benefits of assessment and accessing the appropriate level of care as indicated

Qualifications:
