The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Language Ability:

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

Math Ability:

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Computer Skills:

To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of word processing software, spreadsheet software, design software, internet software, project management software, database software, and Google analytics.

Education/Experience:

Masters degree in Social Work, Counseling, or related field plus one year of clinical experience in an alcohol or other drugs (AOD) or mental health setting preferred

Certificates and Licenses:

Current CPR and First Aid certificate

Current TB test

Valid drivers license

LSW, LICDC-CS, LISW, LPC

Knowledge, Skills, and Other Abilities:

  • Oral and written communication skills
  • Professionalism
  • Combination of comparable skills, experience, and education
  • Understanding and supportive of a trauma-informed system of care
  • Experience with trauma-informed services, cognitive behavioral therapies including DBT, and motivational therapies preferred
  • Personal recovery experience not required, however, knowledge of recovery support systems and 12-Step programs preferred
  • Strong interpersonal and engagement skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong computer skills required; experience with EMR system a plus
  • Ability to support the agencys mission and philosophy, and demonstrate sensitivity to cultural diversity and workplace harmony · Value for and ability to deliver excellent customer service
  • Self-directed and flexible to meet the needs of administration and management

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision.

title: Intensivvårdssjuksköterska, Lindesbergs lasarett
description:
Verksamhetsområde anestesi- och Intensivvård söker engagerade IVA-sjuksköterskor till intensivvårdsavdelningen i Lindesberg. Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av ett professionellt och sammansvetsat team inom intensivvård. Hos oss får du arbeta i en högspecialiserad miljö där kvalitet, patientsäkerhet och teamarbete står i fokus.

Som IVA-sjuksköterska ansvarar du för avancerad omvårdnad av kritiskt sjuka patienter. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med läkare, undersköterskor och övriga yrkesprofessioner, med modern utrustning och evidensbaserade arbetssätt. På IVA vårdas även patienter efter stora eller komplicerade operationer och under helgerna fungerar IVA också som övervakningsenhet efter operationer av akut karaktär.

Arbetsuppgifter

Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat omvårdnads- och patientarbete, läkemedelshantering och handhavande av avancerad teknisk utrustning. Vi erbjuder dig internutbildning och ett lärande klimat, personalen som arbetar här har god erfarenhet och bred kompetens.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som:

  • Är legitimerad sjuksköterska med specialistsjuksköterskeexamen inom intensivvård.
  • Är trygg i din yrkesroll och har god klinisk bedömningsförmåga.
  • Trivs med att arbeta i team och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat.
  • Är flexibel, ansvarstagande och patientfokuserad.

Vi fäster stor vikt vid din personliga kompetens och dina personliga egenskaper. Utifrån hur vår verksamhet är utformad så innebär det att du behöver vara både ansvarsfull, strukturerad och flexibel med förmåga att prioritera i det självständiga arbetet. Vidare behöver du tycka om att jobba i team och att arbeta i ett omväxlande tempo för att trivas i rollen. Att du bemöter patienter, medarbetare och studenter med omtanke och respekt ser vi som en självklarhet.

Ansökan

Ansökan ska innehålla CV och personligt brev. Intyg, betyg, examensbevis med mera ska lämnas vid en eventuell intervju.

Om du är eller tidigare varit anställd i Region Örebro län kommer vi ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef, om du blir aktuell för anställning.

Kontroll av registerutdrag från Polismyndigheten kan komma att ske enligt aktuell lagstiftning.

Som anställd i Region Örebro län omfattas du av trygga kollektivavtal. Läs mer om villkor och förmåner.

Vi sätter löner individuellt och differentierat. Läs mer om lön och lönestatistik.

Vi krigsplacerar våra tillsvidareanställda och i vissa fall även visstidsanställda. Läs mer om vad det innebär.

Om verksamheten

Verksamhetsområde anestesi- och intensivvård bedriver verksamhet vid regionens tre sjukhus, Universitetssjukhuset Örebro, Karlskoga lasarett och Lindesbergs lasarett. Det är ett stort verksamhetsområde med cirka 400 anställda. Våra arbetsområden är anestesi, intensivvård, operationsservice (postop och dagkirurgi) samt en neurointermediär avdelning. Vid Karlskoga lasarett finns en anestesiavdelning, intensivvårdsavdelning och en postoperativ enhet.

Lindesbergs lasarett är ett av Region Örebro läns tre akutsjukhus. Här hittar du det lilla sjukhusets alla fördelar - en vänlig och familjär atmosfär i kombination med effektivitet och stort kunnande. Lasarettet har cirka 600 anställda.

Region Örebro län är en av länets största arbetsgivare. Tillsammans med 11 000 kollegor kan du skapa ett bättre liv för de vi finns till för. Hos oss finns meningsfulla och samhällsviktiga jobb där du kan göra skillnad i invånarnas vardag, hälsa och livskvalitet. Dygnet runt, året om, ansvarar vi för hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård och länets kollektivtrafik. Vi har också det regionala utvecklingsansvaret i länet och ett uppdrag att bidra till kulturlivet.

Övrig information

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annonsering.

title: Finance Specialist & Grant Application Specialist
description:
Nacre is seeking a detail-oriented Finance Specialist to join our finance team. In this role, you will manage day-to-day accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial operations, while also leading non-dilutive funding acquisition by identifying and applying for grants across our portfolio companies. A core responsibility of this role is implementing modern financial tools and automation to streamline processes across all accounting and reporting workflows.

Working Hours:

Working hours for this position are based on Central European Time (CET).

Reports To:

Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable (AR) & Accounts Payable (AP)

  • Oversee end-to-end AP workflows, including invoice intake, verification, approval routing, and batch payments.
  • Manage AR by issuing invoices, tracking collections, following up on overdue accounts, and maintaining healthy cash flow.
  • Reconcile bank feeds, merchant processors, and credit card transactions with core ledgers.

Process Automation & Workflow Optimization

  • Identify manual bottlenecks in financial administration and implement automated solutions using Google Apps Script, AI tools (e.g., Gemini), and custom workflows for tasks like automated invoice capture and payment processing.
  • Leverage advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VBA, Power Query, Apps Script) and modern accounting platform tools to automate recurring schedules, data aggregation, and status tracking.

Financial Analysis (FP&A) & Compliance

  • Support preliminary financial modeling, budget tracking, and monthly variance analysis.
  • Collect and clean raw financial inputs from portfolio companies into standardized reporting templates.
  • Assist with tax schedule preparation, tax compliance, and maintaining digital audit trails.

Grant Application & Management

  • Source, evaluate, and submit applications for government grants, tax credits, and non-dilutive funding opportunities for portfolio companies.
  • Gather required documentation, prepare supporting financial schedules, and maintain structured tracking for compliance and disbursement timelines.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Education: certified accountant; background in business management or an MBA is an advantage.
  • Experience: 1–3 years of professional finance or accounting experience, preferably from a reputable audit firm (top 10).
  • Tax Expertise: Direct experience or a foundational background in Tax compliance and schedules - advantage.
  • Core Skills: Solid understanding of double-entry accounting, AR/AP operations, and basic FP&A principles.
  • Technical & Automation Aptitude: Strong proficiency with advanced spreadsheet automation (Power Query, VBA, Google Apps Script), familiarity with leveraging AI tools for data extraction/workflows, and experience with modern accounting software.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills are required for all business communication and documentation.

Soft Skills

  • Pro-active: You take initiative to solve problems before they escalate.
  • Self-starter: You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable driving projects forward with minimal supervision.
  • Self-learner & Eager to Grow: You have a growth mindset, constantly seeking new knowledge and adapting to new technologies and processes.
  • Interpersonal Skills: You build strong, collaborative relationships with stakeholders and team members, communicating clearly and effectively.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We acknowledge with respect that BC Transit delivers our mission on the ancestral territories of Indigenous Peoples across British Columbia, and their historical relationships with the land continue to this day.

In Victoria, where our Corporate Office is located, our people are privileged to live and work on the unceded traditional territories of the Lək̓ʷəŋən peoples, and the Esquimalt and Songhees Nations.

Location: Victoria, BC

Employment Type:12 monthsFull-Time Temporary

Number of in-office/on-site days: 2 days per week

Union: MoveUP

Monthly Salary Range: MOVEUP_12_TMA, MIN $8,281.00- MAX $9,935.00is available through annual general wage/step increases.

Recruitment Range: MIN $8,281.00– STEP 3 $9,196.

Placement in the salary range is determined by an assessment of knowledge, skills, experience and ability of the candidate to meet the key requirements of the job. In exceptional cases, candidates may be hired above the recruitment range, provided agreement is reached with the Union.

Closing Date (MM/DD/YYYY):08/30/2026

Are we right for you...

Do you enjoy solving difficult technical problems that don't have an obvious answer?

Perhaps you're a software-first data engineer who enjoys building robust systems, creating scalable data products, and continuously improving how engineering work gets done. Maybe you're the person who doesn't just build the thing, you ask whether or not there's a better way to build it.

If you're energized by variety, continuous learning, modern engineering practices, and collaborating with a highly technical team that is still learning and evolving every day, this may be the next step in your career.

In this role you will be asked to...

Build the data foundation that powers reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and machine learning across BC Transit. Reporting to the Manager, Enterprise Data & Analytics, you'll design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines that transform raw data into reliable, scalable, and reusable data products.

This role goes beyond simply moving data from one place to another. You'll help shape the future of the organization's data engineering practice by introducing best practices, improving standards, recommending new approaches, and helping the team evolve its capabilities.

You'll work with a variety of technologies including cloud data platforms, lakehouses, warehouses, and Data/MLOps practices. You'll collaborate with project teams, vendors, architects, analysts, and technical stakeholders to solve new and often complex challenges as business needs evolve.

As a senior member of the team, you'll mentor other data engineers, contribute to technical decision making, and help establish engineering patterns that can be adopted across the organization.

No two days are exactly the same. One day you may be troubleshooting an ingestion issue, the next designing a new lakehouse, building a feature engineering pipeline, or helping define the future roadmap for data engineering at BC Transit.

In this role you will not be asked to...

  • Operate in a highly predictable environment where the same processes and tasks repeat day after day.
  • To do things strictly by the book. Success comes from curiosity, experimentation, continuous improvement, and solving new technical problems as they emerge.
  • Contribute as a data generalist. This is a highly technical engineering role focused on data platforms, software engineering practices, automation, architecture implementation, and scalable data solutions.
  • Work in isolation. Collaboration is fundamental to how the team operates, and engineers work closely with each other and stakeholders across the organization.

What you might love about this role...

  • Build the Practice, Not Just the Product: You'll help define engineering standards, best practices, tooling approaches, and the future direction of data engineering at BC Transit.
  • Software-First Engineering: This role embraces modern software engineering concepts including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, DataOps, and MLOps.
  • Interesting Problems to Solve: You'll tackle complex data integration, architecture, quality, performance, and scalability challenges across a diverse technology environment.
  • Modern Technology Stack: Work with cloud data platforms, tiered architectures, automated workflows, machine learning pipelines, and enterprise-scale data products.
  • Collaborative Technical Culture: You'll join a team that is highly collaborative, supportive, low-key, and committed to delivering quality outcomes while continuing to learn from one another.
  • Visible Organizational Impact: The solutions you build become foundational assets that support reporting, analytics, operations, governance, and decision-making across BC Transit.

What might not resonate...

  • You prefer highly repetitive work with established processes and limited ambiguity.
  • You enjoy working independently with minimal collaboration or stakeholder interaction.
  • You see yourself as a data generalist rather than a specialist technical engineer.
  • You are not interested in mentoring others or contributing to engineering standards and best practices.
  • You prefer maintaining existing solutions rather than designing and building new capabilities.

What you'll bring to the table...

Some qualities you possess to be successful in this role:

  • Data Engineering Expertise – deep understanding of modern data engineering practices and scalable data architecture patterns.
  • Software Engineering Mindset – strong commitment to engineering discipline, code quality, automation, testing, version control, and CI/CD practices.
  • Advanced Python and SQL Skills – expert-level proficiency developing and maintaining data pipelines, transformations, and automated workflows.
  • Cloud Platform Experience – experience working with modern cloud data platforms and lakehouse architectures such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Snowflake.
  • Problem-Solving Ability – demonstrated analytical and computational problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges independently.
  • Innovation Mindset – a passion for continually improving systems, practices, processes, and technical approaches.
  • Collaboration and Communication Skills – ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and build strong working relationships with stakeholders and teammates.
  • Leadership Through Influence – experience mentoring peers, coaching teammates, and helping elevate technical capability across a team.

The successful candidate will typically bring a post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience building production data pipelines and three years of hands‑on experience developing automated workflows using SQL, Python, and modern data engineering tools such as Airflow and dbt. Experience with cloud data platforms, machine learning pipelines, DataOps practices, and mentoring technical teammates will be highly valued.

To learn more about this role, we encourage you to review theSenior Data Engineer job description where you'll see all the accountabilities of the position.

What we’ll bring to the table...

We value and prioritize personal wellness and offer comprehensive benefits to support all the important phases and milestones of your journey:

  • Comprehensive medical and dental benefits to support you and your family, regardless of what life throws at you
  • Membership in BC’s Public Service Pension Plan (PSPP). Nationally recognized for its strong investment and governance practices, PSPP is a "defined benefit" plan
  • Access to fitness and lifestyle centers to help you take care of your physical fitness and health
  • Various programs that support employees such as an Employee Assistance Program and health and wellness initiatives and events aimed at fostering your mental health
  • A complimentary employee bus pass (plus taxable dependent passes)
  • A corporate learning and development program to help you in continuous career growth
  • An employee recognition program where we all recognize each other's successes (not just your Leaders!)
  • A social club that gives you access to events throughout Victoria

What next steps could look like...

  • Interviews will be conducted the week of September 7th, 2026
  • An eligibility list for future full time regular and temporary full time vacancies may be established
  • The position requires the completion of a Criminal Record Check or Vulnerable Sector Search
  • If you have a disability that requires an accommodation during any stage of our recruitment process, please let us know how we can assist you by contacting careers@bctransit.com
  • BC Transit is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. If the organization identifies this position as a reasonable accommodation for an existing employee, all candidates will be notified as soon as reasonably possible

At BC Transit, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace; if you’re excited about this role and you have a combination of education and experience that you feel would fulfil its requirements. In keeping with this belief, we do not discriminate on any basis. Should you require any accommodation or have questions, please let us know.

title: DC Business Expert - 3PL
description:
What You'll Do

As a DC Business Expert - 3PL, you will be the key link between Distribution Centre (DC) operations, third-party logistics (3PL) partners, and business stakeholders. You will ensure operational excellence by supporting warehouse management systems, driving process improvements, maintaining compliance, and enabling smooth logistics operations. You will:

  • Support 3PL operations by ensuring warehouse systems, processes, and integrations run effectively and efficiently.
  • Act as the key contact for system support, incident management, troubleshooting, and user guidance.
  • Partner with 3PL providers and internal stakeholders to implement operational, system, and service requirements.
  • Coordinate logistics and operational activities, including change requests, inbound planning, and stock movement execution.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and ensure compliance with company standards, policies, and governance requirements.

Who You'll Work With

You will work closely with Distribution Centre (DC) Operations & Management, Sales, Merchandising and Supply Chain teams, as well as IT, System Support, Project Teams, and 3PL partners to ensure seamless warehouse operations, system performance, and process excellence.

This role will be reporting to the Distribution Centre Manager.

Who You Are

We are looking for people with…

  • Experienced in warehouse, distribution centre, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Knowledgeable in Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and logistics technologies.
  • Strong understanding of DC processes, inventory management, and operational workflows.
  • Hands-on problem solver with the ability to troubleshoot system and operational issues.

Also people who are…

  • Skilled in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to train, guide, and influence others.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence.
  • Adaptable, detail-oriented, and committed to compliance, service quality, and business results.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our colleagues attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

  • All our colleagues receive a global employee discount, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our global employee discount.
  • In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

If you feel that your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please send your application in English as soon as possible, but no later than 7 September 2026. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Director of Data and Systems, Office of the Agency Chief Contracting Officer
description:
Open to candidates who are permanent Administrative Staff Analyst or Computer Systems Manager

The Finance Division at the NYC Health Department has central responsibility and authority for all the finance, contracting, procurement, payroll, and revenue functions of the agency. Finance helps to ensure that programs and operations have the information, analysis, funding, and capacity to deliver critical services effectively and meet the NYC Health Department’s public health and racial equity objectives. Finance is organized into five bureaus, each led by an Assistant Commissioner: Bureau of the Agency Chief Contracting Officer; Bureau of Budget; Bureau of the Controller; Bureau of Finance Administration and Planning; and Bureau of Revenue. Position Summary: The Director will oversee the development, implementation, and maintenance of data systems and tools that support procurement operations, reporting, and decision-making. -Liaise with internal and external stakeholders, including NYC Health Department IT teams, Finance bureau IT liaisons, and the Mayor's Office of Contract Services (MOCS), to coordinate systems and streamline procurement processes.
-Perform special projects and related work as required.

-Previous experience working (at least 2 years) in any of the fields described above including writing queries in SQL.
-Previous experience (at least 2 years) developing and testing software/platforms or systems.
-Experience with stakeholder engagement and project management.
-Excellent, clear and succinct communication (verbal & written) and interpersonal skills.
-Experience juggling multiple priorities to meet hard deadlines; and exercising independent judgment and working both alone and with a
collaboration of colleagues within the Department.
-Experience with data collection, analysis and interpretation.

Why you should work for us:

For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)

title: Staff Platform Engineer / Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
Staff Platform Engineer / Lead DevOps Engineer

  • You are Driven to stay ahead of cloud and platform engineering practices and motivated by building secure, scalable platforms that help engineering teams move faster.

  • We are A growing engineering team within the bank delivering AI-enabled risk platforms and modern AWS-first infrastructure to support risk management at scale.

  • Together we can Shape resilient, automated platforms that help simplify risk processes, improve delivery, and support better outcomes across the bank.

Do work that matters

Join the Operational Risk & Compliance Crew to engineer our core AI-enabled risk platforms. You will work within a squad delivering agentic AI capabilities into risk management processes that operate across the bank. Here, you’ll create, manage and optimise the platforms used to power our entire business. You’ll have the opportunity to take responsibility for continuous improvement, ensuring our systems are simpler, faster and more secure.

See yourself in our team

Risk Management is modernising how the bank identifies, assesses, and manages risk by building an enterprise-grade Risk AI Platform powered by an AWS-first approach, ArgoCD-managed deployments, and strong API standards. The platform underpins a growing portfolio of AI-enabled products that automate risk processes, embed agentic intelligence, and deliver scalable, human-in-the-loop workflows across Operational Risk & Compliance.

You’ll work closely with Product Owners, Data Scientists, Principal Engineers, Risk Technology and adjacent crews to deliver platform capabilities, improve engineering practices, and meet tech control and privacy obligations.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and evolve reusable cloud infrastructure, platform tooling and automation that support secure, scalable application delivery.
  • Enable engineering teams through CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code and modern platform practices across AWS environments.
  • Deploy and operate containerised workloads using Kubernetes, EKS and related platform tooling.
  • Improve observability, monitoring, resilience and operational support across critical services.
  • Partner with internal and third-party engineers to improve delivery quality, speed and safety.
  • Contribute to governance, service management, incident response and continuous improvement across the platform.

We’re interested in hearing from people who:

We know great candidates may not meet every requirement listed below. If you’re excited about this opportunity and believe your experience could add value, we’d love to hear from you.

Must have

  • Strong experience with AWS-based platform engineering or cloud infrastructure.

AWS is preferred for this role.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, particularly EKS, and containerised deployments.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, including CloudFormation.

Terraform experience is also relevant.

  • Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or ArgoCD.
  • A strong automation mindset and the ability to improve platform reliability, consistency and engineering efficiency.

• Experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Observe or AppDynamics.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud-native APIs and deploying modern application services.
  • Experience with Python, Golang or C#.
  • Exposure to AWS AI services such as Bedrock.

Working with us

Whether you’re passionate about customer service, driven by data, or called by creativity, a career with CommBank is for you.

Our people bring their diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives to build a respectful, inclusive, and flexible workplace with flexible work locations. One where we’re driven by our values, and supported to share ideas, initiatives, and energy. One where making a positive impact for customers, communities and each other is part of our every day.

Here, you’ll thrive. You’ll be supported when faced with challenges and empowered to tackle new opportunities. We’re hiring engineers from across all of Australia and have opened technology hubs in Melbourne, Adelaide, Brisbane and Perth. We really love working here, and we think you will too.

We support our people with the flexibility to balance where work is done with at least half their time each month connecting in office. We also have many other flexible working options available including changing start and finish times, part-time arrangements and job share to name a few. Talk to us about how these arrangements might work in the role you’re interested in.

If this sounds like the role for you then we would love to hear from you. Apply today!

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

title: Hemmakväll Borås söker en ny Butikschef
description:
Sedan starten 1994 har vi på Hemmakväll gjort allt för att du ska kunna njuta av både de små och stora stunderna som hör till livets goda sida. På Hemmakväll tar vi godis på riktigt och roligt allvar.

Hemmakväll driver butiker över hela landet och har idag närmare 600 medarbetare i våra ca 70 butiker. Vårt mål är att ha det bästa sortimentet med den högsta kvaliteten inom lösgodis, stycksaker, dryck, snacks, glass och leksaker. Tillsammans med våra leverantörer ger vi kunderna möjligheten att handla de senaste nyheterna först hos oss. Vår ambition är att alltid bjuda våra kunder på upplevelser, överraskningar – och oss själva.

Längtar du efter att förmedla glädje? Älskar du godis lika mycket som oss? Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

Vi söker ny Butikschef till vår butik i Hemmakväll Borås!

Om tjänsten

Vill du ta klivet/steget upp till en spännande och utmanande roll som butikschef? Då har vi en fantastisk möjlighet för dig att ta ansvar för den dagliga driften av vår butik och leda vårt team till ännu större framgångar.

Som butikschef har du en avgörande roll i att maximera försäljningen, upprätthålla hög driftsnivå och säkerställa att vår personal alltid levererar förstklassig kundservice. Du ansvarar för att leda, motivera och utveckla teamet, genomföra kampanjer och aktiviteter enligt aktivitetsplan, samt följa upp resultat och nyckeltal. Du rapporterar till regionchef.

Arbetet innebär både dag- och kvällstid samt helgarbete, vilket kräver flexibilitet och förmåga att planera och prioritera utifrån butikens behov.

Om dig Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbete inom detaljhandeln och goda kunskaper inom ledarskap och personalansvar. Du är drivande, resultatinriktad och engagerad, med förmåga att hantera högt tempo och växlande arbetsbelastning. Du är strukturerad, flexibel och har god administrativ förmåga.

Din passion för kundrelationer och service är en nyckelkomponent i ditt arbete. Du sätter alltid kunden i centrum och brinner för att skapa positiva upplevelser. Du tycker om att arbeta med människor, ta ansvar och utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team.

Meriterande är erfarenhet av servicehandel, butiksarbete och ledarskap – gärna som butikschef. Vi värdesätter personliga egenskaper såsom hög servicekänsla, drivkraft, god samarbetsförmåga och ett genuint intresse för våra kunder.

Hemmakväll tror på mångfald och strävar efter en arbetsplats där olika erfarenheter och perspektiv berikar vårt arbete.

Kontakt Stämmer ovanstående in på dig och du vill bli en av oss – tveka då inte att söka och bifoga ditt CV med ett personligt brev redan idag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

HEMMAKVÄLL

title: ASISTENT/KA PRODEJE/SKLADNÍK V PRODEJNĚ JYSK ZLÍN – možnost zkráceného úvazku
description:
Chceš se jednou stát manažerem prodejny? Prokaž své odhodlání a získej příležitost ke kariérnímu a profesnímu růstu. Ve společnosti JYSK stavíme na silných týmech a skvělé spolupráci - společně překonáváme cíle a neustále měníme věci k lepšímu. Pokud máš rád/a různorodost a práci v maloobchodě máš spojenou s poskytováním skvělých služeb zákazníkům, jsi na správném místě!

CO TI NABÍZÍME:

  • Férovou firemní kulturu s jasně definovanými hodnotami, které nás spojují.
  • Příležitosti k osobnímu, profesnímu a kariérnímu růstu - 80 % našich manažerů začínalo jako asistenti prodeje.
  • Atraktivní měsíční bonus za skvělé prodejní výsledky.
  • Prodejní tým, na který se můžete spolehnout, a společenské akce, které vám umožní poznat kolegy z celé republiky.
  • Flexibilní pracovní dobu s pracovním úvazkem 37,5 hodin/týdně (v případě plného úvazku), abyste mohli sladit práci, rodinu a volný čas.
  • 5 týdnů dovolené.
  • Slevu 20 % na produkty JYSK.
  • Zprostředkování karty MultiSport.
  • Mimořádné finanční odměny za doporučení zaměstnance až do výše 20 000 Kč.
  • Pravidelné soutěže s atraktivními peněžními odměnami, či dárkovými kartami.
  • Mzda: 34 000 Kč brutto + měsíční bonusy podle výkonu prodejny.

O ČEM BUDE TVOJE PRÁCE:

  • Zákaznický servis: Budete zákazníkům poskytovat nejlepší zážitek z nákupu.
  • Péče o prodejnu: Zajistíte, aby byla prodejna čistá a uklizená, aby se naši zákazníci cítili vítáni.
  • Práce se zbožím: Přijímání, naskladňování a doplňování zboží na prodejní ploše tak, aby byl celý sortiment vždy dostupný.
  • Vlastní úsek: Získáte zodpovědnost za vlastní úsek prodejny, což vám dá příležitost projevit svůj talent a iniciativu.

Hledáme člověka, který je:

  • Zaměřený na potřeby zákazníků a dosahuje tak skvělých prodejních výsledků;
  • Otevřený a přátelský, přirozeně komunikuje s lidmi a vytváří příjemnou atmosféru;
  • Iniciativní a energický, který se vždy chopí příležitosti a přispívá k úspěchu týmu.

JE JYSK TVOU NOVOU PŘÍLEŽITOSTÍ? Přihlas se ještě dnes!

Rádi vám poradíme nebo pomůžeme. Stačí nám poslat e-mail na adresu evy/chsi@jysk.com.

Výběrové řízení:

Přijaté životopisy zpracováváme průběžně a nábor ukončíme, když najdeme toho pravého kandidáta. Vždy provádíme pohovory a na vybrané pozice zasíláme uchazečům videodotazníky, osobnostní dotazníky a dotazníky kognitivních funkcí. Zajímá nás, co vás motivuje k tomu, abyste se stali našimi kolegy na dané pozici.

Zjistěte, jak zpracováváme Vaše údaje v našich [Zásadách ochrany osobních údajů].

O NÁS

Věříme, že naši zaměstnanci jsou klíčem k našemu úspěchu. Proto se snažíme v rámci naší společnosti nabízet rozvoj,možnosti růstu a hledání nových výzev v rámci společnosti JYSK. Od roku 1979, kdy náš zakladatel Lars Larsen otevřel svou první prodejnu v Dánsku, rozšířil JYSK globální působnost o prodejny a internetové obchody v zemích po celém světě.

Naše tři základní hodnoty JYSK - Kupec, Kolega a Kultura firmy - vyjadřují chování a přístup, který můžeme očekávat jeden od druhého. Navzájem si důvěřujeme, věříme ve zmocnění a svobodu s odpovědností. Jsme také hrdí na to, že odměňujeme angažovanost a velké úsilí našich zaměstnanců. Se správným přístupem je v JYSKu velké množství příležitostí.

Pro více informací prosím navštiv naši kariérní stránku.

title: Busschaufför lokaltrafiken Kiruna
description:
Den 1 juli 2026 tog Boreal över avtalet för Kiruna lokaltrafik! Där alla linjer elektrifierats med nya moderna bussar.

Inför hösten söker vi fler engagerade busschaufförer till vårt team! Har du busskort men saknar YKB? För rätt person erbjuder vi alla fem YKB delkurser

Kiruna har ett starkt fritids- och kulturliv, söker du en lugn och trygg vardag i en stad i ständig utveckling, så kanske detta är platsen för dig! Har du funderingar på boende på orten, tveka inte att kontakta oss!

Boreal Sverige värdesätter en positiv attityd och kamratskap. Vi strävar efter att vara en arbetsplats där människor mår bra och känner sig trygga. För oss kommer säkerhet först, sist och alltid; för dig, dina medarbetare, kunder och medtrafikanter.

Kvalifikationer och egenskaper

För tjänsten krävs D-körkort, YKB för persontrafik kan vi erbjuda för den som saknar detta.

Som bussförare är det viktigt att du förmedlar en positiv känsla av att åka buss och att du tar ett stort eget ansvar. Du ska på ett säkert och behagligt sätt transportera våra kunder och hjälpa till vid frågor eller funderingar från dem. Du måste ha en positiv attityd och vara villig att behandla varje kund precis som du själv vill bli behandlad.

Du förstår och utrycker dig obehindrat på svenska.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som bussförare i Kiruna kommer du att köra linjetrafik inom orten samt tågtransfer. I arbetsuppgifterna förutom körning så ingår fel- och skaderapportering. Arbetet är socialt och passar dig som tycker om service och kundkontakter. title: RF and Antennas Systems Engineer
description:
Job Title: RF and Antennas Systems Engineer

Job Category: Engineering

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *


The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking an RF and Antenna Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and test of advanced RF and antenna solutions for mission-critical defense applications. This role focuses on phased array antennas, reflector antenna systems, beamforming architectures, and RF subsystem integration across the engineering lifecycle—from concept development and requirements definition through prototype development, test, and transition to fielded systems.

You will work in a collaborative environment with multidisciplinary engineering teams to help deliver innovative, practical solutions for complex technical challenges.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the design, development, integration, and test of RF, phased array, and reflector antenna systems.

  • Contribute to system and subsystem architectures, requirements, and trade studies for antennas, apertures, beamforming approaches, RF distribution networks, feeds, and associated hardware.

  • Perform system-level analyses including RF propagation, link budgets, range estimates, cascade analysis, interference assessments, and sensitivity evaluations.

  • Support prototype development, fabrication, and assembly of RF systems and antenna hardware.

  • Develop and execute test plans and procedures for laboratory, chamber, range, and field testing; analyze results and recommend design improvements.

  • Document technical work products and present analyses, test results, and recommendations to internal teams and customers.

  • Support proposal efforts, IRAD activities, and other technical business development tasks as needed.

  • Collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Qualifications:
Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in RF systems, antenna systems, or related mission applications.

  • Experience supporting the design, analysis, integration, and test of RF and antenna systems.

  • Working knowledge of RF propagation, link budgets, range estimates, cascade analysis, interference effects, and system sensitivity.

  • Experience supporting development of system and subsystem technical requirements.

  • Hands-on experience with RF test equipment such as network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and power meters.

  • Familiarity with antenna performance metrics such as gain, beamwidth, sidelobes, efficiency, scan loss, and aperture illumination.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Desired:

  • Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electromagnetics, RF/Microwave Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience with phased arrays, reflector antenna systems, AESA, or digital/hybrid beamforming.

  • Experience with antenna testing, array calibration, beam steering validation, or near-field/far-field measurements.

  • Experience with tools such as Microwave Office, Keysight Genesys, MATLAB, and/or Python.

  • Familiarity with electromagnetic modeling, antenna simulation, and RF analysis tools.

  • Experience supporting defense, intelligence, or other government mission customers.

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

title: Staff Quality Engineer
description:
The Staff Quality Engineer owns quality for the Unboxed platform. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical authority over how quality is defined, measured, and enforced across every surface we ship, including work produced by teams outside QA. Quality spans four surfaces: a robust learning management system, AI-generated roleplay and practice, coaching workflows, and client-facing analytics and reporting.

The role is hands-on. The Staff Quality Engineer designs the test architecture, writes and reviews automation, runs exploratory testing on high-risk changes, and diagnoses defects personally. The difference between this role and a senior testing role is reach. This person sets standards that other engineers follow, changes how the platform is built so it is testable and holds release authority on behalf of the company.

A significant portion of the role is quality for AI-generated output. Unboxed delivers AI scoring, feedback, and roleplay to enterprise clients in regulated industries. Those clients will ask how we validate that the system performs accurately and fairly across their populations. The Staff Quality Engineer is an owner of the program that produces that answer.

The role includes direct managing, mentoring, and developing two QA Engineers and setting the quality standards that contract engineering and QA partners operate within.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Architecture and Strategy

  • Own the test architecture for the platform, including framework selection, automation strategy, test data management, and environment strategy, and make the build-versus-buy decisions that go with it.
  • Set the quality standard for the organization: what gets tested, at what layer, to what depth, and what coverage gaps we consciously accept.
  • Author and maintain the defect severity rubric, definitions of done, and test conventions used across in-house and contract teams.
  • Stay hands-on in the highest-risk areas of the product, including exploratory testing, complex defect diagnosis, and automation for critical paths.

Release Authority

  • Hold go/no-go authority for releases against a published, evidence-based standard, and communicate the basis for each decision.
  • Own release verification and the quality signal that supports it, so ship decisions rest on data rather than confidence.
  • Escalate accepted risk explicitly, with the exposure named, rather than allowing it to pass unrecorded.

AI Quality and Fairness

  • Own how quality is measured for AI-generated scoring, feedback, and roleplay, using evaluation approaches built for output variability rather than exact-match expectations.
  • Build and maintain the evaluation harness: golden sets, rubric-based scoring, regression gates on model, prompt, and scoring-logic changes, and drift monitoring in production.
  • Own the fairness and bias testing program for AI scoring. Run subgroup analysis, monitor for differential performance across learner populations, interpret results, and escalate findings. Partner with measurement and psychometrics expertise on methodology and thresholds.
  • Produce the evidence artifacts enterprise clients and their compliance functions rely on to trust AI-generated output and translate client trust concerns into acceptance criteria the team can verify.

Quality Outcomes and Reporting

  • Own the outcome metrics for platform quality, including Defect Escape Rate, Critical Path Coverage, and MTTD/MTTR, and report on them directly to leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Use those metrics to drive change in how software is built, not only to describe how testing performed.
  • Provide leadership with a clear read on quality trends, risk concentration, and where investment is warranted.

Engineering Influence

  • Change how engineering builds, so quality moves upstream. Drive testability into design, acceptance criteria into stories, and automated checks into CI.
  • Review designs and pull requests for quality risk and raise the bar through direct technical influence rather than process enforcement.
  • Earn adoption of quality practices across teams that do not report to this role.

Sourcing and Partner Strategy

  • Set the strategy for how testing capacity is sourced, including what stays in-house, what goes to contract partners, and where automation replaces manual effort.
  • Define the standards, conventions, and acceptance criteria contract engineering and QA teams operate within, and review their output against the same bar as in-house work.
  • Serve as the single point of quality accountability across in-house and contract contributions

Mentorship and Development

  • Manage, mentor, and develop two QA Engineers, owning their prioritization, technical growth, and performance with a coaching-first approach.
  • Grow each engineer’s ability to reason about quality independently, so team judgment scales without requiring this role in every decision.
  • Raise the quality skill level of the broader engineering organization through review, pairing, and documented practice.

Key Skills

  • Deep hands-on quality engineering skill: test design, exploratory testing, regression strategy, and defect diagnosis in B2B SaaS. This remains the primary skill the role is hired for.
  • Test architecture judgment: the ability to design an automation strategy that holds up over years and to know where automation pays off versus where it becomes maintenance burden.
  • Practical experience testing AI/ML or otherwise non-deterministic systems, including evaluation of scored output where there is no single correct answer.
  • Statistical literacy sufficient to read a subgroup analysis, distinguish signal from noise, and interpret fairness results responsibly.
  • Demonstrated influence without authority: the ability to change how other engineers work through credibility and evidence.
  • Fluency with quality metrics and the ability to use them to drive decisions, not just report them.
  • Ability to communicate quality risk credibly to technical and non-technical audiences, including enterprise clients.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of quality or software engineering experience in B2B SaaS, with demonstrated ownership of quality outcomes rather than test execution alone.
  • A track record of staying hands-on at a senior level, with systems or practices they designed that outlived their direct involvement.
  • Evidence of organization-level impact: a quality practice, framework, or standard they introduced that changed how a company-built software.
  • Experience testing AI-driven, ML-driven, or data-driven features, or clear demonstrated ability to reason about quality under output variability.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and setting standards for contract, offshore, or vendor teams.
  • Strong automation and CI/CD background with modern testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with enterprise quality expectations, including regulated or compliance-sensitive clients.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits

Unboxed team members benefit from our comprehensive compensation and rewards program which includes:

  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • Ample paid time off
  • Dynamic and convenient office location – unlimited snacks, casual dress code, covered parking and gym on site
  • Open communication and a commitment to fostering teamwork across the organization

Salary Range: $115,000 - $130,000 annually

title: IT Project Manager
description:
Jouw missie

In de rol van IT Project Manager breng jij digitale initiatieven van vraagstuk naar werkende oplossing. Je beweegt je moeiteloos tussen business en IT: je begrijpt wat de organisatie nodig heeft, brengt structuur in complexe vragen en zorgt dat projecten daadwerkelijk vooruitgaan.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en voortgang van IT-projecten binnen onze e-commerceomgeving. Daarbij bewaak je scope, planning, kwaliteit, risico’s en afhankelijkheden. Je verbindt stakeholders, IT-teams en eventuele externe partners, houdt iedereen aangehaakt en stuurt bij wanneer dat nodig is.

Naast projectmanagement heb je een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol. Je haalt requirements op, vertaalt businessbehoeften naar heldere user stories en functionele specificaties en onderzoekt de impact van wijzigingen. Zo zorg je niet alleen dat een project op schema blijft, maar ook dat de oplossing aansluit op het oorspronkelijke doel

Over het team

Je wordt onderdeel van het Project Management Office (PMO) van Winparts. Het PMO ondersteunt projecten die bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze organisatie en digitale dienstverlening.

Binnen het team werken verschillende tracks samen, waaronder Supply Chain/Logistiek en IT. Jij versterkt de IT-kant van het PMO en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit Business Development, IT en andere delen van de organisatie.

Dit is een nieuwe positie binnen het team. Daardoor krijg je ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, processen te verbeteren en zichtbaar het verschil te maken. Je rapporteert aan de Team Lead Project Management & PMO.

Wat ga je doen?

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • IT-projecten begeleiden van intake en scopebepaling tot implementatie en evaluatie.

  • Scope, planning, kwaliteit, risico’s, budgetten en afhankelijkheden bewaken.

  • Projectoverleggen, stakeholdermeetings en refinement-sessies organiseren en faciliteren.

  • Samenwerken met en verbinden van business, IT-teams en externe leveranciers.

  • Requirements ophalen, analyseren en vertalen naar user stories en functionele specificaties.

  • Impactanalyses uitvoeren bij wijzigingen en nieuwe verzoeken.

  • Opgeleverde functionaliteit toetsen aan de gemaakte afspraken en requirements.

  • Rapporteren over voortgang, risico’s en besluiten aan de Team Lead Project Management & PMO.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling en professionalisering van het PMO.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je bent een zelfstandige professional die eigenaarschap neemt en energie krijgt van het verbinden van business en IT. Je brengt structuur in complexe vraagstukken, stelt moeiteloos prioriteiten en houdt verschillende stakeholders aangehaakt. Daarbij combineer je een inhoudelijke blik met een praktische aanpak: je vertaalt businessvragen naar haalbare IT-oplossingen en pakt de regie om deze verder te brengen.

Je hoeft niet al jarenlang de titel IT Project Manager te dragen. Ook met ervaring als bijvoorbeeld Business Analyst, IT Consultant of Product Owner kun je goed aansluiten. E-commerce-ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Ongeveer 3 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen IT-projecten, digitale omgevingen of vergelijkbare verandertrajecten.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden of coördineren van projecten en het samenwerken met verschillende stakeholders.

  • Ervaring met het ophalen, analyseren en uitwerken van requirements.

  • Kennis van agile- en scrumwerkwijzen.

  • Begrip van IT en het vermogen om technische en zakelijke vraagstukken met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Een gestructureerde, proactieve en resultaatgerichte werkwijze.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Bij Winparts vinden we het belangrijk dat jij je werk met plezier kunt doen, en daar bieden we graag het volgende voor:

  • Hybride werken: een goede balans tussen samenwerken op kantoor en werken vanuit huis.

  • Volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden via onze Academy, inclusief trainingen van Growth Tribe op onderwerpen als groei, marketing, data en AI.

  • Een passend salaris, pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Een vitaliteitsprogramma, inclusief korting op een sportabonnement, en een fijne verlofregeling.

  • Een informele, betrokken werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en eigen ideeën centraal staan.

Ready? Buckle up!

Ben je enthousiast en wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met Wout Dijkstra 06-36025968 of reageer direct via de knop ‘Solliciteren’. We leren je graag kennen!

Let op: wij werven ons personeel zelf, acquisitie door bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Apotektekniker
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Apotektekniker/apotekmedarbeider

Lillehammer kombinerer småbyliv med store naturopplevelser. Byen har et aktivt kulturliv, hyggelige kaféer og butikker, og et godt lokalmiljø der det er lett å bli kjent og trives. Samtidig har du Mjøsa, skog og fjell rett i nærheten – med flotte muligheter for turer, sykling og ski gjennom hele året.

Boots apotek Lillehammer ligger midt i gågaten, i hjertet av byen. Det gir en variert og levende arbeidsdag med nærhet til kundene våre, pulsen i sentrum og et bredt spekter av henvendelser – samtidig som det er kort vei til alt Lillehammer har å by på, både før og etter jobb.

Vi ser nå etter nye tilkallingsvikarer som kan jobbe ved behov, i helger og ferier. Personalgruppen består av apoteker, to farmasøyter og en apotektekniker. Åpningstidene er mandag-fredag kl. 9-17, og lørdag kl. 10-16.

Er du apotektekniker og får energi av å hjelpe kunder med deres helsebehov?

Vi mener det er nettopp medarbeiderne som utgjør den viktigste forskjellen for kunden!

Bli med på vårt team og få muligheten til å veilede og gi rådgivning til kunder i et miljø som setter kvalitet i kundemøtet og utvikling av helsetjenester i fokus! Bli med på å forme fremtidens apotek!

Søknadsfrist: 31.08.2026
Tiltredelsesdato: 01.09.2026 eller etter avtale

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Som apotektekniker hos Boots apotek vil du ha en sentral rolle i å veilede og gi rådgivning til kundene våre. Dette innebærer å velge riktige produkter og forstå hvordan de skal brukes, samt gi informasjon om og utføre helsetjenester. På denne måten bidrar du med din kompetanse til bedre helse og økt livskvalitet for kundene!

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Vi søker etter en apotektekniker eller noen med annen relevant bakgrunn, ideelt sett med erfaring fra norske apotek.

Personlige egenskaper

  • I denne rollen er det viktig at du liker å bruke din kompetanse i kundemøtene. Du bør være engasjert i å hjelpe kundene med deres individuelle behov og kunne kommunisere tydelig om medisiner, tjenester og helseprodukter.
  • Ditt engasjement driver deg til å stadig strekke deg etter det beste. Du ønsker alltid å levere den beste servicen til kundene dine ved å være kunnskapsrik, profesjonell og imøtekommende.
  • Gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter er viktige i denne rollen da du vil jobbe tett sammen med kolleger og samhandle daglig med kunder. Evnen til å etablere gode relasjoner, være utadvendt og ha et positivt humør vil bidra til en trivelig arbeidsatmosfære.

Vi tilbyr

  • Stillingen som apotektekniker hos Boots apotek gir deg muligheten til å bli en del av en anerkjent apotekkjede.
  • Vår virksomhet er preget av et nytenkende apotekkonsept som setter stor vekt på kvalitet i kundemøtet. Vi ønsker aktivt å utvikle helsetjenester slik at vi kan møte kundenes behov på best mulig måte.
  • Vi investerer også i din personlige og faglige videreutvikling gjennom opplæringsprogrammer eller interne kurs slik at du kan trives og lykkes i stillingen din hos oss.


Ved spørsmål om stillingen, kontakt Marion K. Dahl Jensen på e-post: marion.kd.jensen@boots.no eller telefon: 41647651

.

Alliance Healthcare Norge Apotekdrift AS eier og driver over 150 Boots apotek i Norge. Vi har kjedekontor på Økern i Oslo og grossisten Alliance Healthcare Norge AS, med administrasjon og lager på Drøbak og lager i Tromsø.

Boots, som har mer enn 160 års erfaring fra internasjonal apotekdrift, åpnet sitt første apotek i Norge i 2008. Selskapet er i dag et av verdens best kjente merkenavn. I samarbeid med forskere og spesialister innen helse og hudpleie, utvikler og produserer Boots flere bestselgende merkevarer for eksempel No7, Soap & Glory og Soltan. Disse distribueres gjennom Boots Apotek i Norge. Boots Apotek/Alliance Healthcare Norge Apotekdrift AS og Alliance Healthcare Norge AS er en del av det internasjonale selskapet Cencora.

Cencora er et ledende, globalt selskap innen farmasøytiske tjenester. Vårt fokus er å forbedre livene til mennesker og dyr over hele verden. Vi samarbeider med farmasøytiske innovatører på tvers av verdikjeden for å lette og optimalisere markedstilgangen til legemiddelbehandling. Vi sørger for sikker og pålitelig leveranse av legemidler, helseprodukter og løsninger. Selskapet har 46 000+ ansatte globalt, som alle bidrar til selskapets formål: Vi står sammen om vårt ansvar for å skape en sunnere fremtid. Cencora er rangert som nr. 11 på Fortune 500 og nr. 24 på Global Fortune 500 med mer enn 200 milliarder USD i årlig omsetning. Les mer om selskapet på www.cencora.com

Vi jobber for å skape en sterk kultur i selskapet der mangfold og inkludering er sentralt i alt vi gjør. Ved å fremme samarbeid og innovasjon får vi inspirasjon til å hjelpe mennesker over hele verden til å få bedret helse og livskvalitet. I vårt selskap skal medarbeiderne ha like muligheter for utvikling og involvering, uansett bakgrunn. Hos oss skal alle føle seg respektert, verdsatt og inspirert til å drive selskapet vårt fremover.

title: Engagement Lead - Low Carbon Economy
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water
description:
Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW), New Delhi
Engagement Lead – Low Carbon Economy

Terms of Reference
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for (and what we don’t stand for!) as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!


At CEEW, we build careers in public policy

• We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale

• We actively promote leadership by initiative

• We celebrate talent and ambition

• You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow

• You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations

• Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility come together at CEEW

• You will get above-market remuneration

• We provide a safe space for all

• At CEEW, your life is your example for others

Designation offered
Engagement Lead

Reporting to
Senior Fellow, Low Carbon Economy

Location
New Delhi

Purpose

CEEW seeks to hire an Engagement Lead (EL) for its Low Carbon Economy (LCE) programme. The individual would be responsible for actively engaging while strengthening and building trusted relationships with state governments, while also engaging with central government ministries, industry, academia, civil society and other stakeholders as need to achieve the programme’s objective. The EL will be responsible for preparing the engagement and advocacy strategy for the LCE programme’s initiatives across various states and implementing it through intensive consultations with major stakeholders.

We are looking for an experienced professional with hands-on experience and deep sectoral understanding, to build and expand CEEW’s work on informing climate policy-making, particularly at the state level. The candidate should be able to connect the dots across many moving parts and look for innovative ways to conduct and socialise research with the key decision makers.

Job Duties and Accountabilities

· - Represent CEEW and build networks: represent CEEW at relevant meetings and events especially at the state level, and strengthen relationships with governmental and non-governmental stakeholders.


- Develop state-level strategies: Support the design and implementation of the LCE programme’s engagement and advocacy strategy.

· Facilitate communication and coordination: Act as the primary point of contact for technical exchanges and communication between CEEW and stakeholders and prepare meeting notes.

· - Organise strategic events: Plan, minute and manage meetings, consultations, and events in collaboration with stakeholders.

· - Build research networks: Establish and maintain local, national, and international research collaborations to support program goals.

· - Work closely with senior researchers to develop short briefs/presentations with research insights and support revenue generation.

· - Present research findings: Share research outcomes with key stakeholders, advisory bodies, and at conferences.

· - Any other responsibilities related to the work profile.

Selection Criteria

Education and Experience:

● Master’s degree in Public Policy/Governance/Climate Change /Environment Management/Urban Planning/ Sustainable Development or any other relevant field.

● At least 10 years of relevant work experience in consulting, policy engagement and project management, preferably in climate policy or sustainable development.

● Experience of engagement with government ministries is critical.


Key Skills:

● Strong networking skills with senior government representatives.

● Understanding of India’s climate policy and the role of states in it.

● Demonstrate strong networking skills and ability to represent the organisation on national and international platforms.

● Ability to summarise and communicate research insights/findings as briefs and presentations.

● Must leverage his/her stakeholder network in the to keep a tab on the latest climate policy trends.

● Strong written and oral communication skills.

● Proficiency in MS Office application suite.


Personality

· Willingness to learn new skills.

· Ability to adapt and deliver under tight deadlines in a professional environment.

· Striving for rigour and quality in work output.

· Ability to effectively work in a team.

· Ability to dig deeper into details while understanding the big picture.

· Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment.

· Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

· Good organisational skills are desirable.


Compensation

Competitive compensation – commensurate to the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.


Application Process


CEEW is an equal opportunity employer and the selection process does not discriminate on the basis of age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by us. We appreciate your interest.

CEEW operates in a dynamic environment and the candidate will be required to show flexibility in undertaking a variety of tasks.

title: Ploegleider Jaarbedrijf
description:
Als Ploegleider Jaarbedrijf werk je in 2-ploegendienst en ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw ploeg. Je zorgt ervoor dat de productie soepel en volgens planning verloopt. Je verdeelt het werk, bewaakt de voortgang en grijpt in waar nodig. Daarbij heb je altijd oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en efficiëntie. Jij bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer en zorgt dat jouw team gemotiveerd en goed geïnformeerd is. Tevens vervul je een rol als Operationeel Veiligheidskundige binnen het Jaarbedrijf.

Je werkt in het jaarbedrijf, waar wij suiker verwerken en uitleveren naar onze klanten in verschillende vormen: bulk, grootverpakking en klein verpakking. Dit betekent dat jij te maken hebt met een dynamische omgeving waarin logistiek, techniek en productie samenkomen. Jij zorgt dat alle processen op elkaar aansluiten en dat de klant op tijd krijgt wat is beloofd.

Naast het aansturen van de dagelijkse operatie denk je actief mee over verbeteringen. Je signaleert knelpunten, komt met oplossingen en draagt bij aan een cultuur van continu verbeteren. Ook begeleid je medewerkers in hun ontwikkeling, zodat zij optimaal kunnen presteren en zich blijven ontwikkelen.

Jouw belangrijkste taken:

  • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen jouw ploeg;
  • Bewaken van productieplanning, kwaliteit en veiligheid;
  • Zorgen voor een correcte uitlevering van suiker in bulk, groot- en klein verpakking;
  • Signaleren en oplossen van storingen en afwijkingen in samenwerking met onderhoud;
  • Rapporteren aan de Productieleider over voortgang en verbeterpunten;
  • Motiveren, coachen en ontwikkelen van medewerkers;
  • Actief bijdragen aan procesoptimalisatie en verbeterprojecten;
  • Je neemt tijdens de bietencampagne (medio september t/m januari) deel aan een consignatierooster. Gemiddeld één keer per drie weken ben je in het weekend bereikbaar en beschikbaar om te ondersteunen bij storingen of verstoringen.
  • Mbo+ of Hbo werk- en denkniveau, en bij voorkeur beschik je over een afgeronde, relevante opleiding (levensmiddelentechnologie, procestechniek, werktuigbouwkunde);
  • Ervaring in een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie;
  • Leiderschapskwaliteiten: je kunt mensen motiveren, coachen en zorgen voor een goede samenwerking;
  • Je bent praktisch ingesteld, besluitvaardig en hebt oog voor kwaliteit en procesverbetering;
  • Je staat open voor technologische ontwikkelingen en denkt mee over verbeteringen in de werkprocessen;
  • Ervaring met TPM of vergelijkbare verbeterprogramma’s is een pré.

Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek en afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring bieden we het volgende:

  • €4.200 tot €5.100 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
  • 25 vakantiedagen en 23 ADV-dagen
  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%
  • Pensioenregeling met slechts 3% eigen bijdrage en 25% inleg door Cosun.

title: Senior Detective Investigator
description:
RICHMOND COUNTY DISTRICT ATTORNEY
The men and women of the Richmond County District Attorney’s office work each day in partnership with Law Enforcement and the people of Staten Island to pursue justice for victims of crime, to prevent crime in all its forms, and to promote the safety and well-being of all citizens of our Borough.

THE ROLE
The Richmond County District Attorney (RCDA) is seeking veteran law enforcement professionals for the position of Senior Detective Investigator. The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to the following:

- Conduct investigations on a wide variety of matters, including but not limited to: cold case homicides; organized crime; narcotics; identity theft; financial crimes; violent crime; special victim cases; domestic violence; welfare fraud; child abuse; gangs; hate crimes; firearms.
- Assist in transporting witnesses for grand jury/court appearances
- Conduct background checks for prospective RCDA employees.
- Conduct surveillances and assist prosecutors with trial preparation.
- Interview witnesses and arrange for witness protection at the direction of the Chief Investigator.
- Other duties as assigned.

PREFERRED SKILLS

- Three or more years of full-time, paid employment as defined in CPL 1.20, within the State of New York.
- Accredited police academy training.
- Certified in firearms proficiency.
- Extensive knowledge and investigative experience in one or more of the following areas: cold case homicides; organized crime; narcotics; identity theft; financial crimes; violent crime; special victim cases; domestic violence; welfare fraud; child abuse; gangs; hate crimes; firearms.
- Strong technical computer skills using a variety of applications for law enforcement use, including law enforcement photography and videotaping skills regarding, e.g., crime scenes, lineups, interrogations, victim injuries.
- Demonstrated understanding of criminal law and procedures with experience building cases and maintaining documentation to assist ADAs.
- Experience with providing status updates to supervisor and ability to present cases to prosecutors and leadership.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to serve as a Liaison to other law enforcement agencies and/or other government institutions.
- Ability to work both independently and as a team to manage multiple projects.
- Familiarity with various media, e.g., extracting/downloading video footage from surveillance systems.
- Experience in installing a system for, and the execution of, eavesdropping warrants.
- Familiarity with CALEA; SYTECH system; Title III requirements.

The candidate selected for this position must be a resident of the City of New York or become a resident within 90 days of appointment.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description:
Shape the Future of Privacy

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Office of AI

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

About the role

You are the hands-on technical arm of AI adoption at Usercentrics. Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and every other department have real AI use cases, and your job is to turn them into governed, working software, not slide decks.

You will prototype and build department AI applications, run technical enablement sessions directly with the teams who will use them, and make sure everything you ship meets our governance standards before it goes live. You work from the use-case pipeline the AI Enablement Lead runs, and you report progress and adoption back into it.

This is not a support role bolted onto engineering. You are a full engineer, building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, and the internal AI platform, and you are expected to leave every pattern you build reusable by the next team. What you build feeds the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub. As that platform grows into its next layer, LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, you will contribute to that build alongside the rest of the Office of AI team, not just consume it.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be one of two engineers doing this work day to day, with a Staff AI Enablement Engineer setting the technical bar above you.

Requirements

What you will do

  • Prototype, build, and hand over department AI applications, working directly with the business team that will own the outcome.
  • Run technical enablement sessions with non-engineering teams: walk them through what was built, how to use it, and how to ask for the next thing well.
  • Guide teams on tech stack choices, MCP servers, AI artefacts (Skills, Connectors, plugins), and integration patterns for AI in a business context.

ABOUT US
