title: Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
Job Title: Cybersecurity Specialist

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity

Join a team dedicated to protecting critical enterprise systems and supporting secure global operations through cybersecurity engineering, information assurance, and risk management. As a Cybersecurity Specialist, you will help safeguard mission-critical technology by implementing security controls, assessing cyber risk, supporting compliance efforts, and strengthening the security posture of enterprise infrastructure operating across worldwide environments.

This requisition supports multiple experience levels—from professionals building foundational cybersecurity expertise to senior technical leaders responsible for designing secure architectures, managing cybersecurity programs, and leading enterprise risk management initiatives. Successful candidates will collaborate with engineering, operations, cloud, networking, and Government stakeholders to ensure systems remain secure, resilient, and compliant throughout their lifecycle.

If you enjoy solving complex security challenges, protecting enterprise environments, and contributing to high-impact national security missions, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference while advancing your cybersecurity career.

Opportunities available upon contract award

Responsibilities

Depending on experience and level, responsibilities may include:

  • Implement, maintain, and assess cybersecurity controls across enterprise IT systems, cloud environments, applications, and network infrastructure.

  • Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities throughout the system lifecycle, including authorization packages, security documentation, assessments, and continuous monitoring.

  • Develop, review, and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), security policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.

  • Conduct security assessments, vulnerability analysis, compliance reviews, and risk assessments to identify and mitigate cybersecurity threats.

  • Coordinate vulnerability remediation efforts with engineering and operations teams while tracking corrective actions to completion.

  • Monitor enterprise security posture using cybersecurity tools, vulnerability scanners, endpoint protection platforms, and security monitoring solutions.

  • Support security accreditation activities, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting.

  • Evaluate proposed system changes to determine security impacts and recommend appropriate safeguards.

  • Participate in incident response activities, forensic support, root cause analysis, and lessons learned documentation.

  • Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, cloud engineers, software developers, and Government stakeholders to integrate cybersecurity throughout system design and operations.

  • Support implementation of Zero Trust principles, cloud security best practices, identity and access management, encryption, and secure configuration standards.

  • Develop security metrics, dashboards, and reports to communicate cybersecurity performance and risk.

  • Senior-level professionals may lead cybersecurity engineering efforts, oversee RMF activities, serve as Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), mentor junior staff, and advise Government leadership on enterprise cybersecurity strategy and compliance.

Required Qualifications

Qualifications vary based on position level.

  • High School diploma with relevant experience or bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Active Secret Clearance

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity, information assurance, system security engineering, network security, or information systems security.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, risk management, security controls, and secure system design.

  • Familiarity with vulnerability management, security monitoring, and cybersecurity best practices.

  • Experience developing technical documentation and communicating cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required Government security clearance.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Federal Government or Department of State cybersecurity programs.

  • Experience serving as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or Information System Security Manager (ISSM).

  • Experience implementing the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) processes.

  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, FISMA, FedRAMP, and other Federal cybersecurity standards.

  • Experience with vulnerability management tools such as Tenable Nessus, Tenable Security Center, Qualys, or similar platforms.

  • Experience using security information and event management (SIEM) tools such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk Enterprise Security, IBM QRadar, or Microsoft Defender XDR.

  • Knowledge of cloud security technologies supporting Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Experience supporting endpoint security, identity and access management (IAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), PKI, and privileged access management (PAM).



This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.


Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$103,800 - $218,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Propositiemanager
description:
Als propositiemanager bij de KB nationale bibliotheek onderzoek en ontwikkel je welke diensten wij als bibliotheek kunnen leveren vanuit het perspectief van de gebruiker. Een unieke kans voor jou om als ondernemende propositiemanager een cruciale bijdrage te leveren aan Nederlands erfgoed, binnen een bibliotheek die zich klaar maakt voor de toekomst.

Over de KB nationale bibliotheek

De KB, de nationale bibliotheek van Nederland sinds 1798, staat steeds meer in de maatschappelijke schijnwerpers. Samen met meer dan 600 collega’s en met onze netwerkpartners zetten we ons in om Nederland elke dag slimmer, vaardiger en creatiever te maken. Wij maken toegankelijk wat er in, maar ook over Nederland is geschreven, fysiek en digitaal. En streven met elkaar naar een samenleving waarin iedereen volwaardig mee kan doen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als propositiemanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van proposities die bijdragen aan onze maatschappelijke opgaven, vanuit de behoeften van verschillende doelgroepen. Je kunt denken aan leesbevordering, digitale inclusie of toegang tot digitaal erfgoed. Je verkent kansen, valideert richtingen en brengt focus aan waarin je continu toetst, leert en bijstuurt, onder andere via design thinking-methodieken. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het proces, de inhoud, het creëren van draagvlak en je zorgt voor een plan van aanpak voor de implementatie. Hoe ziet dat er in de praktijk uit?

  • Je identificeert kansen op basis van beleid, strategieën, data, marktanalyses en doelgroepinzichten en vertaalt deze naar concrete proposities.

  • Je valideert de aannames met doelgroepen om je keuzes te onderbouwen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met interne stakeholders en stuur je waar nodig externe onderzoeksbureaus aan.

  • Voor elke propositie stel je een onderbouwde businesscase op en zorg je voor een heldere vertaling naar realisatie en implementatie.

“Je ontwerpt voor hoe mensen zijn, niet voor wie je wilt dat ze zijn.”

Wat breng je mee?

Je hebt als propositiemanager een scherpe blik op waardecreatie voor de gebruiker en samenwerking in multidisciplinaire teams. Je combineert analytisch vermogen met creativiteit en weet ideeën snel tastbaar te maken. Vanuit de afdeling Marketing & Diensten draag je bij aan de positionering en strategische doorontwikkeling van digitale diensten zoals Delpher, de online Bibliotheek en . Ook werken we aan verschillende educatieve programma’s, onder andere op het gebied van lezen en digitale geletterdheid voor alle Nederlanders. Wat is voor ons belangrijk in deze rol?

  • Je hebt minimaal 10 jaar werkervaring, (deels) als propositiemanager of in een vergelijkbare rol, met focus op design thinking of service design.

  • Je hebt gewerkt binnen een middelgrote tot grote organisatie, of vanuit een bureau met complexe opdrachtgevers.

  • Je bent gewend om verschillende soorten trajecten te begeleiden: van verkenning tot validatie.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht en besluitvaardig; je durft keuzes te maken en richting te bepalen aan de hand van goed onderbouwde business cases.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met onderzoek, design en UX voor concrete en testbare proposities.

  • Je bent organisatiesensitief en sterk in stakeholdermanagement.

Gedragscode van de KB | de nationale bibliotheek: Samen zorgen we voor een prettige, veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving. Bij de KB maar ook in ons netwerk. Waar je jezelf kan zijn, jezelf mag uitspreken en iedereen met respect wordt behandeld. En waar je op een fijne manier je werk kunt doen en bij kunt dragen aan de doelen van de KB.

Waar kan jij op rekenen?

Als je kiest voor de KB, dan kies je ook voor uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4885,- en € 6722,- (schaal 11) met een contract voor 1 jaar. Een vast dienstverband na dit jaar is onze intentie, waarover we je goed zullen informeren.

  • Een zeer goede werk-privébalans. Zo heb je 42 vrije dagen en praten we graag met je over flexibele werktijden.

  • 100% vergoeding van jouw OV-reiskosten.

Deze arbeidsvoorwaarden gelden voor een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur per week. Voor deze vacature is een dienstverband voor 32-40 uur per week aan de orde. Lees hier meer over onze uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Hoe solliciteer ik naar deze vacature?

Kom bijdragen aan onze innovatie! We kijken er naar uit om jouw cv en motivatie te ontvangen. Als je vragen hebt, kun je deze stellen aan Frouke Röben via frouke.roben@kb.nl. Vanaf 14-9-2026 willen wij de eerste interviews op locatie gaan houden. Bij voldoende sollicitaties behouden wij ons het recht de vacature eerder te sluiten.

title: Senior Public Health Sanitarian, Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation
description:
Open to candidates who are permanent or those who have filed for PROMOTION TO ASSOCIATE PUBLIC HEALTH SANITARIAN Exam No. 6513.

The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, injury prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York’s most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. This includes hazards related to food safety wherever meals are served to the public, including restaurants, school cafeterias, mobile food vending carts, senior centers, and soup kitchens, first-hand and second-hand smoke for all places of employment and public spaces. BFSCS also monitors compliance with regulations in other facilities, such as tattoo parlors, correctional facilities, and homeless shelters. Additionally, BFSCS investigates environmental health complaints received from New York City residents.

DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
- Train and Supervise Public Health Sanitarians on new procedures and in the daily activities of the program.
- Assign work to subordinates and establish a schedule for its completion.
- Review work of subordination and evaluate work performance.
- Take corrective action when required to maintain unit performance at a satisfactory level.
- Train staff in new job procedures and/or skills.
- Orient new employees to program rules, policies, and procedures.
- Perform special inspections, assignments, and investigations of difficult or unusual situations and takes appropriate corrective actions.

PREFERRED SKILLS:
- Excellent communication skills.
- Excellent interpersonal skills.
- Excellent decision making and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent leadership and supervisory skills.

Why you should work for us:

- Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
- Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:
o a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
o a tax-deferred savings program and
o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
- Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.
- Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

Commitment to Equity:

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

The NYC Health Department is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation to all individuals. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact Sye-Eun Ahn, Director of the Office of Equal Employment Opportunity, at sahn1@health.nyc.gov or 347-396-6549.

ASSOCIATE PUBLIC HEALTH SANITA - 31220

1. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college, including or supplemented by 30 semester credits in the physical and/or biological sciences, i.e., biology, botany, chemistry, geology, physics, physiology, and zoology; of which not more than 12 credit hours may be in the applied sciences, i.e., environmental technology, sanitation technology, medical technology, public health, infection control or food service; and at least two years of satisfactory full-time experience performing inspections to assure compliance with pertinent laws, rules and regulations governing the areas of food, drugs and general environmental conditions; or

2. An associate degree from an accredited college, with 15 semester credits in the physical and/or biological sciences, of which not more than 6 credit hours may be in the applied sciences, and 4 years of satisfactory full-time experience as described in "1" above; or

However, all candidates must have at least 60 semester credits from an accredited college, including at least 15 semester credits in the physical and and/or biological sciences. Furthermore, to assure compliance with Section 11.112 of the Compilation of the Rules and Regulations of the State of New York (NYCRR) – Title 10 (Health), all candidates must have at least 2 years of experience as a public health sanitarian as described in "1" above.

title: Interim Head of Engineering
description:
Contract: Initial 3–6 months
Start: ASAP
Level: Head of Engineering / Engineering Director

Hybrid: 3 days a week onsite in Paddington

The Role

We are looking for a senior engineering leader to provide technical and delivery oversight across two key areas: Contact Centre Transformation and Personalisation.

This is an interim cover role for a few months, focused on providing stability, supporting the engineering teams and two new Engineering Managers, maintaining delivery momentum, and ensuring a smooth handover to the permanent replacement.

There is no line management responsibility.

Requirements

  • Provide senior technical leadership across Contact Centre Transformation and Personalisation.

  • Provide technical oversight across a complex, third-party and partner-led delivery environment.

  • Maintain delivery momentum, resolve technical blockers and manage dependencies.
  • Ensure technical decisions and engineering direction remain aligned to business and customer objectives.

Benefits

title: B2B Partner Onboarding & Enablement Specialist
description:
What is Exoticca?

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.

We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

What is our proposal?

We are looking for a B2B Partner Onboarding & Enablement Specialist to support the growth of Exoticca’s B2B channel by delivering high-quality onboarding and training experiences to our travel agent partners.

This role plays a key part in ensuring travel agents fully understand our platform, tools, value proposition, and sales processes, enabling them to confidently sell Exoticca’s luxury travel products in key markets such as USA, Canada, Mexico, and the UK.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and comfortable working closely with external partners on a daily basis through live online training sessions. You enjoy explaining products, influencing adoption, and helping partners succeed commercially. Strong communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and confidence delivering trainings in English and Spanish are essential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver live onboarding and training sessions to B2B travel agents in English and Spanish (approximately 5 sessions per day) via Google Meet.
  • Ensure agents fully understand:

1) How to use the Exoticca B2B platform.

2) Key selling points and value proposition

3) Target customer profiles and how to position Exoticca products

  • Actively support agent adoption by:

1) Calling and emailing agents to sign up and attend trainings.
2) Managing pre- and post-training communication.
3) Sending confirmations, certificates, and follow-up materials.
4) Clarifying doubts and providing post-training support.

  • Maintain accurate training records and complete the confirmed training drive after each session.
  • Develop, update, and continuously improve training materials and presentations.
  • Gather feedback from agents and contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding and training sessions.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams (Sales, Operations, Product) to ensure training content is aligned with business needs.
  • Act as a key point of contact for agents during their onboarding phase, building strong and trusted relationships

Tools & Training:

  • Daily use of Salesforce, B2B Advisor Portal, Adiona, Gmail, Calendly, and Sprinklr
  • Full onboarding and training will be provided to ensure familiarity with all tools, processes, and content


Schedule:

  • Monday to Thursday: 3:00 pm – 12:00 am
  • Friday: 3:00 pm – 9:00 pm

(Schedule aligned with our main B2B markets in the Americas)

Requirements

    • Fluency in English and Spanish (mandatory).
    • Experience in onboarding, training, sales, customer success, customer support, or similar client-facing roles.
    • Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence delivering live trainings.
    • Proactive, autonomous, organized, and solution-oriented.
    • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to adapt training sessions to different audiences and experience levels.
    • Comfortable working with external stakeholders and commercially driven profiles.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
  • Additionally, we propose the use of flexible compensation management for diet, transportation, private health insurance wit Cobee.
  • On-site work model: Offices in Barcelona city.
  • Permanent contract from the start.
  • Travel packages at reduced prices as perk for employees!
  • Unlimited coffee, language lessons, quarterly teamwork activities, global biannual parties.
  • And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization!

Join Exoticca and play a pivotal role in creating life milestones through unforgettable travel experiences! This is your opportunity to shape the future of a dynamic and innovative travel brand on a global scale.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under European, country, or local law.

title: ZASTĘPCA / ZASTĘPCZYNI KIEROWNIKA / KIEROWNICZKI SKLEPU Rzeszów Ul. Krakowska (6400 PLN)
description:
Odkryj inny wymiar pracy w handlu. Dołącz do JYSK!
Lubisz pracę z ludźmi, środowisko w którym dużo się dzieje i satysfakcję ze wspólnego osiągania realizacji celów?
Potrafisz angażować zespół, budować dobrą współpracę i działać z nastawieniem na rezultaty? Chcesz rozwijać swoje kompetencje, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i stopniowo przejmować większą odpowiedzialność?
Świetnie - być może właśnie na Ciebie czekamy!

CO NA CIEBIE CZEKA?

  • Możliwości rozwoju i jasne ścieżki kariery. Dowiedz się więcej tutaj.
  • Wynagrodzenie i premie powiązane z efektami Twojej pracy oraz wynikami zespołu.
  • Konkursy sprzedażowe i dodatkowe akcje z atrakcyjnymi nagrodami.
  • Elastyczny grafik i zespół, który wie, że poza pracą też jest życie.
  • 20% rabatu pracowniczego na zakup produktów we wszystkich sklepach JYSK i spółkach Lars Larsen Group - również na produkty objęte promocją.
  • Atrakcyjne benefity, m.in.: prywatna opieka medyczna, finansowe świadczenia świąteczne, karta Multisport, wspólne integracje i wydarzenia.
  • Stabilne miejsce pracy, w firmie o skandynawskiej kulturze organizacyjnej, opartej na współpracy i wzajemnym szacunku.
  • Nagrody jubileuszowe – doceniamy osoby, które rozwijają się razem z nami.

CZYM BĘDZIESZ SIĘ ZAJMOWAĆ?

  • Realizacja celów i wyników sprzedażowych - wspólnie z Kierownikiem / Kierowniczką Sklepu.
  • Prowadzenie zespołu w codziennej pracy - organizowanie zmian, dbanie o tempo i jakość pracy, ustalanie priorytetów.
  • Motywowanie i rozwijanie ludzi - szkolisz, dajesz feedback, budujesz postawę prosprzedażową.
  • Wdrażanie kampanii sprzedażowych i standardów sklepowych - dbasz o ekspozycję i oznaczenia produktów, dostępność oraz wygląd sklepu.
  • Tworzenie wysokiego standardu obsługi klienta, opartego na otwartości, dostępności i dobrej atmosferze.
  • Praca operacyjna z zespołem - dostawy, towarowanie, organizacja sklepu.
  • Wspieranie Kierownika / Kierowniczki Sklepu w komunikacji, organizacji pracy i działaniach zgodnych z naszymi wartościami.

SZUKAMY OSÓB, KTÓRE:

  • są zorientowane na sprzedaż, realizację wyników oraz wysoką jakość obsługi klienta,
  • budują pozytywne relacje, są otwarte na współpracę i dobrze odnajdują się w pracy z ludźmi,
  • potrafią wspierać i rozwijać zespół poprzez komunikację, feedback i codzienne zaangażowanie,
  • wykazują inicjatywę i energię do działania,
  • dobrze odnajdują się środowisku, w którym dużo się dzieje i jest wiele wyzwań,
  • mają gotowość do pracy w godzinach otwarcia sklepu, w tym w soboty oraz niedziele handlowe,
  • cenią różnorodność, elastyczność w wykonywanych zadaniach.

Jeśli chcesz się rozwijać, damy Ci przestrzeń do zdobywania nowych doświadczeń i kompetencji. Stopniowo będziesz przejmować większą odpowiedzialność oraz przygotowywać się do kolejnych kroków rozwoju - także w kierunku roli Kierownika / Kierowniczki Sklepu.

Poznaj jednego z naszych Zastępców Kierownika Sklepu i dowiedz się, jakim pracodawcą jesteśmy tutaj.

O NAS

W JYSK ludzie są w centrum wszystkiego, co robimy. To ich energia, zaangażowanie i współpraca napędzają nasz rozwój. Dlatego tworzymy środowisko, w którym można się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i budować swoją ścieżkę kariery krok po kroku, w swoim tempie.
Nasza historia sięga 1979 roku, kiedy Lars Larsen otworzył pierwszy sklep w Danii. Od tego czasu rozwinęliśmy się w międzynarodową sieć obecna w wielu krajach, w tym w Polsce, gdzie mamy już ponad 340 sklepów oraz nowoczesne centrum dystrybucji, które wspiera sprawne funkcjonowanie całej sieci. Rozwijamy zarówno sprzedaż stacjonarną, jak i kanały online, pozostając blisko klientów i ich codziennych potrzeb.
Naszą kulturę definiują trzy wartości: Kupiec, Kolega i Duch Firmy. Przekładają się one na codzienną pracę: odpowiedzialność za wyniki, współpracę w zespole oraz zaangażowanie.
W JYSK stawiamy na środowisko oparte na zaufaniu, szacunku i rozwoju. Wspieramy się nawzajem i dajemy przestrzeń do nauki, niezależnie od miejsca startu.
Jesteśmy organizacją otwartą na różnorodność. Cenimy ludzi bez względu na wiek, tożsamość płciową, orientację seksualną, sprawność, pochodzenie, doświadczenie czy sposób myślenia. Wierzymy, że różne perspektywy, talenty i doświadczenia wzmacniają nasze zespoły i pozwalają nam działać lepiej każdego dnia.

Chcesz uzyskać więcej informacji, odwiedź naszą stronę kariera JYSK.

Dowiedz się, w jaki sposób przetwarzamy Twoje dane osobowe w naszej Polityce Prywatności.

title: Head of Expansion ePARK
description:
Are you ready to bring your innovative perspective and creative skills to ePARK as part of the SKIDATA Group and ASSA ABLOY? Join our team, headquartered in Gothenburg Sweden and enjoy a collaborative culture that empowers you to build a career you can be proud of.

What you would do as our Head of Expansion ePARK

The Head of Expansion at ePARK is a senior commercial leadership role reporting into the Head of ePARK, and connected closely with SKIDATA’s Business Domain “Parking & Mobility”. The role is driving ePARK's growth across Europe as it scales from a recently-acquired digital & SaaS business model with start-up spirit into a strategic growth engine within SKIDATA. The role combines hands-on market expansion with organization-building, with a clear mandate to grow revenue substantially over the coming years, deepen ePARK's mobility ecosystem, and strengthen alignment & synergies with SKIDATA.

The role requires significant travel across Europe, particularly to markets ePARK is expanding into, and to SKIDATA's HQ (Salzburg/Austria).

You would also:

• Design and execute go-to-market & expansion strategies for new and existing markets, coordinating market entry in priority growth markets.

• Complete ePARK's commercial and operational alignment with SKIDATA, with an effective go-to-market approach for ePARK and SKIDATA regional sales teams.

• Work closely with the Head of ePARK to build up ascalable organization with high-performing teams and grow your own leadership scope significantly over time.

• Grow ePARK's mobility ecosystem by identifying, negotiating, and integrating strategic partnerships in alignment with SKIDATA (e.g. EV charging, mobility hubs, tech partners).

• Own delivery of revenue and mobility solution targets, balancing growth investment with EBIT targets and reporting progress to key stakeholders.

The skills and experience you need

We are looking for someone who:

• Has 8+ years in leadership roles with experience in commercial & business development assignments, ideally with P&L responsibility, and a proven track record of scaling businesses through profitable growth (from growth-stage to scale-up).

title: Junior Visual Designer
description:
REBORRN is a new breed of management consultancy, future-proofing global marketing teams for the age of change. Its proprietary "58:hours" methodology tackles complex business challenges in under three days, by bringing the right people together in a focused, agile, and distraction-free environment. REBORRN is a cross-functional team of 55+ experts working across geographies to drive radical transformation to the world's leading marketing teams.

Focused on fast, impact-driven solutions, REBORRN's expertise spans every need of a modern marketing team, covering Strategy, Marketing Operating Systems, Change Management, and In-market Activation. Over the years, REBORRN has partnered with some of the world's most influential brands, including The Coca-Cola Company, Philip Morris International, L'Oréal, Nestlé, Bayer, PUIG, and more.

We are looking for a talented Junior Visual Designer to help bring our communications strategies to life.

What will your day-to-day look like?

Due to our lean structure, you will be working closely with other Visual Designers and Consultants taking an active role in all aspects of the experience design process.

Your main field of work will be visual design in the digital ecosystem. A large portion of your role will involve envisioning how a company communicates and brands new products, projects, teams in the digital era. Some specific examples of work include creating visuals, logos and complete brand-books for digital (or non-digital) products. Be prepared to design everything from presentation decks to brand initiatives, including internal communication materials for major brands, helping global marketing organisations get complex ideas across through impactful, concise design choices.

We’re all about cross-functional collaboration

One week you might be building a brand book, another a leadership presentation, and the one after that an event campaign, each for a different global brand. No two days look the same - you’ll never get bored, that’s a promise! And It doesn’t stop there. You will always be more than welcome to get exposed to different tribes within REBORRN and jump into cool projects that resonate with your personal interests. We are strong advocates of cross-functional collaboration.

Requirements

Who are you?

You’ve spent some time working in a similar role before. We don’t have strict requirements regarding your previous job - you may have been a digital or branding designer at an agency, a freelancer, or a full-stack designer at a startup. What matters most to us is what you can bring to the team: your design thinking, your own way of solving problems, and how that comes through in your visual work. We want to see your fingerprint - the thing that will make our work different, better, fresher.

The key thing we need from you:

  • Demonstrate your design skills through your project portfolio. It can be anything, from your personal design projects to a link of your Behance/Dribble profile. We both know this is the best way for designers to present their skills. Impress us!

In your portfolio, we expect to see that you:

  • Have 1-3 years of experience and you can translate ideas into designs using visuals, graphics, and fireworks!
  • Are proficient with tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator etc. We are big fans of Figma too, so be prepared to learn.
  • Have a genuine interest in how good design can tell a compelling story and solve complex problems.
  • Are intrigued by the latest trends and cutting-edge technologies. You keep up with the design community and bring new ideas to the table.
  • Have some technical knowledge and understand how digital tools work.
  • Are a fast learner, comfortable stepping out of your comfort zone, and eager to embrace new ways of working.
  • Are curious by design. You always try to find better ways to make things work. You experiment and you learn through trial and error.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools is a plus! We'd love to hear how you've used them, from workflow to outcome.
  • Just as you are master of your craft, you are a master of your time and schedule. You're autonomous and work well under tight deadlines.

We definitely need a team player, someone who can collaborate effectively with our designers. We are flexible on remote working, so knowing how to stand independently under directions is important too. We are searching for someone who doesn’t give up easily when something doesn’t work out on the first try.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

Our most important perk is providing a workplace filled with top talent from diverse backgrounds who thrive on efficiency and the excitement of smart, fast-paced progress. Here, everyone is weird in their own unique way! We have a culture of continuous learning so you will definitely be inspired and improve in your craft day by day. Additional highlights include:

  • Unlimited, self-managed vacation policy
  • Private medical insurance
  • Top-notch tech gear
  • Growth Opportunities
  • Work from anywhere policy
  • Free Travel Card for Public transport if you are based in Athens
  • "All you can read" books programme
  • Subscription for Electric Scooter or Bike
  • Amazing office space at the heart of Athens

title: Senior Engineer (Go)
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description:
Dreamdata is the industry leader in B2B marketing attribution and activation. We're on a mission to help B2B marketing leaders finally connect their efforts directly to real revenue - solving a complex problem that has plagued the industry for years.

Founded in 2018 by ex-Trustpilot (TRST:LSE) product and engineering leaders, Dreamdata was born from a real-world need, building the platform they always wished they'd had.

It's working. We have achieved strong product-market fit and are experiencing explosive, triple-digit YoY growth. This momentum is now backed by a recent $55,000,000 Series B funding round set to fuel our rocketship as we scale globally.

We are expanding rapidly and looking for exceptional, top-tier talent to help us build the future of B2B marketing.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Engineer at Dreamdata, you will own the systems that pull our customers' go-to-market data out of dozens of third-party platforms - Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn, and many more - and turn it into the attribution and activation the Dreamdata Platform is known for. This is a hard, high-leverage engineering problem: every API is different, every customer's setup is different, and the quality of what our customers see depends entirely on how well these systems hold up.

You will own outcomes. That means you decide how a problem gets solved, you talk to the customers who are affected by it, and you go back and improve the system when it isn't good enough. Nobody will hand you a specification and nobody will approve your design decisions for you. If you are not comfortable making calls on your own and living with the consequences, this is not the right role for you.

We also expect you to build with agents. Dreamdata engineers use coding agents daily to write, refactor, test, and operate our systems, and increasingly to run the integrations themselves: detecting schema drift, triaging failed syncs, and proposing fixes. We want someone who is genuinely curious about how far this goes and who will push our tooling forward rather than wait for someone else to.

This is a hybrid role, in office at our Central Copenhagen Office located at Kalvebod Brygge. We require a minimum of 3 days each week in office. No exceptions for a full-time remote environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own our B2B integrations end to end - design, build, run, and improve the pipelines that ingest data from third-party ad, CRM, and marketing automation platforms at scale.
  • Take decisions independently on architecture, tooling, and trade-offs, and be accountable for how they play out in production.
  • Measure your work by customer outcomes: correct data, trustworthy attribution, and problems that stay fixed.
  • Engage directly with customers and with our Customer Success and Product teams to understand what is actually breaking and why.
  • Build and extend the agentic tooling we use to develop and operate our systems - agents that write code, monitor integrations, diagnose failures, and reduce the manual work of keeping hundreds of connections healthy.
  • Improve systems you did not build. When you find something fragile, slow, or confusing, fixing it is part of the job, not a separate project.
  • Work across Go, SQL, and Google Cloud Platform, feeding our analytics engine with technologies such as Apache Beam, Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Temporal, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery.

Requirements

  • You are a skilled backend engineer, ideally with Go experience, or with a strong track record building complex data pipelines in another language.
  • You have integrated with many third-party systems and know your way around REST APIs as both a consumer and a constructor - including the messy parts: rate limits, pagination, partial failures, breaking changes, and inconsistent data.
  • You are strong in SQL. Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift is a significant advantage.
  • You take ownership by default. You are comfortable deciding without consensus, shipping without permission, and being answerable for the result.
  • You care about customer outcomes more than about output. You want to know whether what you built actually worked for the people using it.
  • You use coding agents as part of how you work, and you are curious about applying them to build and maintain production systems more efficiently.
  • You are curious about the B2B go-to-market world - how marketing and sales teams actually operate, and why connecting their data to revenue is so hard.
  • You are pragmatic. You make complicated things simple, iterate in sensible steps, and use the tools that make sense rather than the tools that are interesting.
  • Experience with Kubernetes is a big plus.
  • You enjoy learning new technologies as we use the latest and greatest ones. Take a look at our profile for the complete list.

Benefits

    • Location: Our office is located in the heart of Copenhagen with a harbor view
    • Ownership: Equity in a growing company.
    • Lunch: Delicious lunch available in our canteen
    • Inclusive Culture: Be part of a supportive and dynamic team making an impact in the B2B marketing space
    • Private insurance: Private health insurance that comes with our pension plan
    • Office dogs

At Dreamdata, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. Join us in shaping the future of B2B marketing analytics and activation while developing your skills and growing your career.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. If you’re passionate about building meaningful connections and helping businesses succeed, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lärare i svenska som andraspråk

title: Barnvakt sökes i Perstorp mån-fre
description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!


Om uppdraget / About the assignment

En familj i Perstorp söker barnvakt för sina två barn, 9 och 5 år gamla. Uppdraget innebär hämtning från två olika skolor runt kl. 16:45 på vardagar, måndag till fredag, med barnen fram till ca kl. 23:00. På fredagar slutar barnen skolan 18:00–19:00. Uppdraget gäller tre veckor i månaden.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

  • Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
  • Kurs i barn-HLR
  • Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
  • Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
  • Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
  • Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
  • Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen


Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.

title: Content Quality Analyst (3 month contract)
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Quality Analyst to review and validate CMS content against client briefs, defined standards, templates and quality checklists. This role is responsible for ensuring content across the client websites is accurate, consistent, accessible and ready for publication across digital platforms. You will work closely with content authors, editors, client stakeholders and third-party partners to identify issues, resolve defects and improve content quality processes. You will help to raise content quality standards over time through better guidance, training and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review CMS content against client briefs, defined quality standards, templates and checklists before publication
  • Check content for structure, copy accuracy, links, images, tagging, localisation and basic accessibility requirements
  • Identify, log and track content defects, ensuring issues are resolved in a timely manner
  • Work closely with authors, editors and client stakeholders to correct issues and maintain publishing standards
  • Support end-to-end testing across key content and integration touchpoints
  • Monitor issues, test failures and recurring issues, escalating where required and supporting root cause resolution
  • Provide first-line support for content and platform-related queries
  • Advise internal teams and third parties on content and quality standards
  • Maintain tracking documentation and provide updates on project status, issues and progress
  • Identify recurring quality trends and contribute to improvements in templates, training materials and guidelines

Requirements

  • Experience reviewing digital or CMS content against quality standards, templates or checklists
  • Able to work on a hybrid basis, with 2 days per week at our Head Office in Fort Dunlop, Birmingham
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify inconsistencies, errors and defects quickly and accurately
  • Good understanding of content quality assurance principles and best practice
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms and digital publishing workflows
  • Understanding of basic accessibility, localisation and responsive web content considerations
  • Ability to gather and analyse information, prioritise issues and manage multiple tasks or projects at once
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work with internal teams and third-party partners
  • Highly organised, proactive and comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively
  • Proven ability to deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines

Benefits

Perks at ITG — alongside a competitive salary, here's what you can look forward to:

  • Time off that works for you — 25 days' holiday + bank holidays, a paid Wellbeing Day, flexible bank holidays to honour cultural or religious observances, and the option to buy or carry over up to 5 extra days.
  • Flexibility & lifestyle — Smart Working with up to 40% from home, and after 12 months, the option to work from abroad for up to 90 days a year.
  • Family & life milestones — Enhanced family friendly leave, 3 extra days for your wedding/honeymoon, and an Employee Assistance Programme whenever you need support.
  • Financial perks — Pension scheme, Corporate Medical Cash Plan, electric car salary sacrifice scheme, and tax-efficient payroll giving to your favourite charities.
  • Growth & recognition — Funding for professional qualifications, monthly Employee of the Month awards (£250 bonus), and referral bonuses of up to £1,500.
  • Community & wellbeing — Regular Wellbeing Workshops, 30+ Wellbeing Champions, a paid Volunteer Day, and an online perks platform with discounts on top brands, days out, and gym memberships.

We Value Diversity

We champion and welcome diversity in our workforce and ensure all job applicants receive equal and fair treatment, regardless of age, race, gender or gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or nationality.

We are not only committed to increasing the visibility and recognition of talent from under-represented groups within our organisation, but the wider industry too.

At the end of the day, we make sure we take time to look after ourselves, each other, and the planet, because we’re always stronger together.

title: Barnvakt sökes i Segeltorp - mån-ons & fre
description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!


Om uppdraget / About the assignment

Familj i Segeltorp som söker en barnvakt. De har två barn, 4 och 1 år gamla och hjälpen riktar sig främst till 4-åringen. Uppdraget innebär hämtning från förskolan måndag–onsdag samt fredag, cirka kl. 15:00–17:30, med en promenad på ungefär tio minuter. Start önskas från och med den 7 september. Spanska-kunskaper är meriterande, men inget krav.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

  • Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
  • Kurs i barn-HLR
  • Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
  • Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
  • Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
  • Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
  • Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen


Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.

title: Sr Advisor, Customer/Technical Training
description:
Digital-first learning experience design, eLearning development, and technical enablement for RSA Identity Security solutions.


The Opportunity

Join RSA Education Services and help shape the future of customer, partner, and employee enablement through modern digital learning experiences.

We are seeking a Technical Learning Experience Designer who is passionate about cybersecurity, digital learning, and innovative learner experiences. This role is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and continuously improving scalable learning solutions that help global audiences successfully adopt and use RSA solutions.

You will transform complex technical concepts into engaging, learner-centered experiences delivered through eLearning, interactive modules, hands-on labs, guided simulations, videos, microlearning, learning paths, assessments, and performance support resources.

This role works closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Documentation, and Subject Matter Experts to drive customer proficiency and product adoption through modern enablement practices.


Principal Responsibilities:

Learning Experience Design

  • Design and develop engaging digital learning experiences for RSA customers, partners, and employees.
  • Create learning journeys that combine self-paced learning, hands-on labs, knowledge assessments, performance support assets, and certification readiness.
  • Apply learner-centered design, adult learning principles, and learning experience design practices to improve engagement, retention, and learner success.
  • Design learning experiences that support multiple personas, roles, use cases, and skill levels.
  • Continuously improve content using learner feedback, learning analytics, assessments, and business outcome indicators.

Digital Content Development

  • Develop technical eLearning courses, guided simulations, tutorials, videos, microlearning assets, scenario-based exercises, and interactive learning resources.
  • Design and maintain hands-on lab exercises that provide practical, realistic experience with RSA solutions.
  • Partner with Subject Matter Experts to translate technical knowledge, product releases, and field insights into effective digital learning experiences.
  • Use AI-powered content development tools to accelerate drafting, content maintenance, quality reviews, accessibility checks, and localization support.
  • Ensure learning content remains accurate, scalable, accessible, and aligned with product releases and evolving customer needs.

Learning Technologies & Innovation

  • Use modern authoring tools, LMS platforms, video tools, simulation tools, AI, and digital learning technologies to deliver scalable learning experiences.
  • Contribute to learning content governance, standards, templates, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Explore emerging learning technologies and recommend practical ways to improve learner engagement, content quality, and team productivity.

Enablement Effectiveness

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure learning programs align with customer success, product adoption, and enablement objectives.
  • Provide technical guidance and peer support to team members when needed.

Facilitation Support

  • Facilitate virtual or instructor-led technical sessions when required, with primary emphasis on digital learning design and eLearning development.
  • Support train-the-trainer, internal enablement, and partner readiness initiatives as needed.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Instructional Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • Ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts and translate them into clear, effective learner experiences.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, Identity and Access Management, authentication technologies, networking, and enterprise software concepts.
  • Excellent written communication, content development, and visual organization skills.
  • Experience designing digital learning experiences, eLearning content, or technical enablement programs.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design, learning experience design, and adult learning principles.
  • Experience developing self-paced learning, interactive digital content, assessments, and learner support resources.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Articulate 360, Rise, Storyline, or similar content creation tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted content development, workflow automation, or productivity tools.
  • Experience designing technical hands-on labs, simulations, certification readiness content, or role-based learning paths.
  • Familiarity with RSA ID Plus, RSA Governance & Lifecycle, Authentication, MFA, Passwordless, Identity Security, orelated cybersecurity technologies.
  • Knowledge of learning measurement frameworks and data-driven content optimization.
  • Additional European language skills such as French, German, Spanish, or Italian are a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Digital learning experiences drive measurable customer, partner, and employee proficiency.
  • Learning content is modern, modular, scalable, accessible, and aligned with product evolution.
  • AI-enabled content practices improve speed, quality, and consistency across the learning content lifecycle.
  • Learners can build skills through effective self-service learning journeys, labs, assessments, and performance support assets.
  • Learning programs contribute directly to customer success, product adoption, certification readiness, and business outcomes.

title: Product Manager (d/f/m)
description:
Hypofriend is a next-generation online mortgage advisor using proprietary technology to find customers the best mortgage possible and give holistic financial advice.

Unlike other mortgage advisors or brokers, we use financial insights to guide our customers. By joining us, you will be able to tap into these insights and be part of our path to transform the industry. We provide customers with tools that help them navigate the entire home buying process, from making buying decisions and give advice on the next steps to build wealth in Germany.

As Product Manager you own a slice of that machine end-to-end: the internal platform our advisors and operations team run on, and the AI and automation that make the mortgage process faster and less manual. You will work closely with engineering, design, advisors, and the founders.

Tasks

  • Own your product area end-to-end — from problem discovery and prioritisation to spec, launch, and measurement.
  • Build for our advisors and ops team. Improve the CRM, advisory and application workflows, document handling, and lender submission so advisors spend their time advising, not administrating.
  • Ship AI and automation into the mortgage journey — document extraction and verification, AI-assisted advisory prep, decision support, and agentic workflows — with clear guardrails for accuracy and compliance.
  • Connect the dots across the funnel. Understand how the customer-facing product, advisor tooling, and lender/partner integrations affect each other, and make trade-offs across them.
  • Learn the business deeply enough to find the levers. Understand our advice and sales principles, how the market works, and how advisors, banks and agents actually move a case forward. Use that to spot where the business loses value — drop-offs, rework, waiting time — and where a product change unblocks it. A roadmap here is a set of bets on levers, not a wish list of features.
  • Define success with numbers. Set metrics per initiative (conversion, time-to-offer, advisor capacity per case, automation rate, error rate), instrument them, and report honestly on outcomes.
  • Write clear specs and keep delivery moving. Groom the backlog, run rituals, unblock engineers, and make the call when scope has to be cut.
  • Work within a regulated domain. Partner with compliance and our lending partners so what we ship holds up under German mortgage regulation.

Requirements

  • 2–4 years in product management, ideally on a product with real operational complexity (fintech, marketplace, internal tooling, or workflow automation).
  • Comfort with numbers and data — you can write your own SQL queries or analyses rather than waiting for someone else.
  • A practical grasp of what today's AI models can and cannot be trusted with, and how to design around that.
  • A solid UX foundation — you understand how interface and interaction design shape behaviour, and you can design flows that guide advisors and the CSM team towards the right action instead of just exposing more fields and buttons.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to make complex financial mechanics feel simple.
  • Structured, self-directed, and comfortable in a small team where you own the outcome, not just the ticket.
  • Fluent English. German is a strong plus (our lenders, contracts, and regulation are German).
  • Interest in mortgages, real estate, or personal finance — the domain rewards people who go deep.

Nice to have

  • Experience with process automation, document AI, or LLM-based product features in production.
  • Background in lending, insurance, or another regulated financial product.
  • Some technical fluency — you can read an API contract and discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers.

Benefits

What can Hypofriend offer you?

👪 Motivated, interdisciplinary team with years of experience building successful digital products

🏠 Work up to 100% from home, with occasional meetings in our Berlin headquarters

📈 Stock options in a growing company

💼 Excellent career opportunities as our company scales

💥 Help to shape the innovative practices and products which are redefining the German mortgage industry

💻 Latest Macbook

🏃🏼‍♂️ Urban Sports Membership

📍 3-story office at Rosenthaler Platz

  • A lean team and a flat structure. High independence and end-to-end ownership: you take a problem from discovery to launch to measurement yourself, without layers of approval in between.
  • Your users sit next to you. Our advisors and CSM team are the people your product serves, so feedback comes in hours rather than after a research cycle — and you see the effect of what you shipped almost immediately.
  • Big scope, real impact. Three brands and one shared financial picture — a wide surface for a team this size, and decisions that visibly move the business.
  • Fast pace. We ship, learn and correct quickly instead of planning quarters in advance.
  • Profitable, bootstrapped and proven. Eight years on the market, 500,000 customers, and we fund ourselves — so the roadmap follows customer value and business sense, not the next funding round. You also get real scale of data to work with.
  • Genuinely hard problems. Optimisation across lender rules, tax logic, risk and long-term financial outcomes, plus AI and automation applied to a regulated, high-stakes process.

How we work — and who thrives here

This will be a good fit if you:

  • Take initiative by default. When something is unclear or broken, you go and find out, rather than waiting for a decision to arrive.
  • Solve problems from first principles. You dig into messy, ambiguous situations, form your own view of the root cause, and propose a way forward.
  • Learn fast and enjoy it. Mortgages, German regulation, lender logic, our internal systems — a lot to absorb, and you will be expected to get up to speed largely on your own.
  • Handle context switching. On any given day you may move between an AI experiment, an advisor workflow bug, a lender requirement and a data question — and hold several threads open at once without dropping them.

It probably will not be a good fit if you:

  • Prefer one clearly scoped project at a time with minimal interruption.
  • Want a defined process, an existing playbook, and clear direction on what to work on next.
  • See the PM role mainly as writing tickets and coordinating rather than digging into the domain and the numbers yourself.
  • Are uncomfortable making decisions with incomplete information, or need consensus before moving.

First 6 months — what success looks like

  • Month 1–2: You know the mortgage process end-to-end, have shadowed advisors on real cases, and can articulate the core pillars of our workflow.
  • Month 3–4: You own a defined area, have a prioritised roadmap for it, and have shipped at least one improvement with a measurable effect on advisor efficiency or conversion.
  • Month 5–6: You are the go-to person for your domain, running discovery independently, and one AI/automation initiative is live and demonstrably reducing manual work per case.

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Principal Data Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
Principal Data Platform Engineer (AWS)

  • You are passionate about solving complex problem with the latest tech

  • We're the largest and most advanced Data Engineering teams in the country.

  • Together we build tomorrow’s bank with world class engineering

Do work that matters

The Capital Provisioning Modelling Crew builds and runs the platforms that support how credit risk models are developed, validated, implemented, and monitored aligning to the Model Development Lifecycle Methodology (MDLC), processes, and procedures. The outcomes produced by these models are used in managing the Group Risk Management functions including front line business processes as well as for regulatory reporting including loss provisioning, portfolio analysis, and reporting.

These are critical, model-driven systems operating under regulatory scrutiny, where accuracy, control and reliability are essential.

As a Principal Engineer, you will shape the engineering direction for platforms that enable data consumption, model execution and deployment at scale, while meeting strong governance and control requirements.

See yourself in the team

You’ll be part of the Capital Provisioning Modelling Crew, working across credit risk modelling, data and platform engineering.

The crew focuses on:

  • Consuming trusted data from enterprise data marketplace

  • Enabling model execution and orchestration at scale

  • Supporting SageMaker-based model deployment and ML workloads

  • Driving modernisation and decommissioning of legacy and sandpit environments

  • Delivering efficiencies into the framework and tools that can help deliver the models in a safe, sound, and secure way

  • Embedding controls, lineage and auditability by design

As a Principal Engineer, you will

  • Define and drive platform strategy for capital provisioning modelling

  • Architect and build cloud-native platforms (AWS) supporting model and data workloads

  • Provide thought leadership and contributes to the design of technical solutions and consumption patterns, including data security and data management.

  • Design solutions that consume and operationalise enterprise data marketplace assets

  • Lead engineering patterns for model and ML deployment, orchestration and monitoring

  • Drive migration from legacy platforms to strategic, governed environments

  • Ensure alignment with Model Risk Management, regulatory and audit requirements, including:

    • Data lineage and traceability

    • Reproducibility of model outputs

    • Strong controls and validation

  • Partner with modelling teams to productionise models and improve reliability and performance

  • Influence architecture and engineering decisions across crews and domains

  • Set and uplift engineering standards and practices

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to a high-performing engineering culture

We’re interested in hearing from people who

  • Have strong experience building cloud-native data and model platforms at scale

  • Have experience productionising models or ML workloads

  • Have experience in building frameworks and tools that can significantly improve engineering productivity

  • Understand data integrity, reconciliation, and accuracy in financial systems

  • Can influence across teams and align stakeholders on technical direction

  • Have a natural drive to educate, communicate, and coordinate with different internal stakeholders and consultants.

  • Are comfortable balancing technical debt with long-term platform strategy

Technical experience

We use a broad range of tools, languages, and frameworks. We do not expect you to know them all but experience or exposure with some of these, or a willing to learn these skillsets (or equivalents) will set you up for success in this team!

  • AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, SageMaker or similar)

  • Snowflake or enterprise data platforms / data marketplace patterns

  • Python, PySpark and distributed data processing

  • Batch and streaming data pipelines (e.g. Airflow, Spark, Glue)

  • CI/CD, automated testing and infrastructure-as-code

  • Observability, monitoring and reliability practices

  • Strong SQL and relational database experience

Working with us

Our people bring their diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives to build a respectful, inclusive, and flexible workplace with flexible work locations. One where we’re driven by our values, and supported to share ideas, initiatives, and energy. One where making a positive impact for customers, communities and each other is part of our every day.

Here, you’ll thrive. You’ll be supported when faced with challenges and empowered to tackle new opportunities. We’re hiring engineers from across all of Australia and have opened technology hubs in Melbourne and Perth. We really love working here, and we think you will too.

We support our people with the flexibility to balance where work is done with at least half their time each month connecting in office. We also have many other flexible working options available including changing start and finish times, part-time arrangements and job share to name a few. Talk to us about how these arrangements might work in the role you’re interested in.

If this sounds like the role for you then we would love to hear from you. Apply today!

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

title: Network Infrastructure Specialist
description:
Job Title: Network Infrastructure Specialist

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity

Join a team responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the enterprise network infrastructure that enables mission-critical operations across a global technology environment. As a Network Infrastructure Specialist, you will support the planning, deployment, operation, and modernization of highly available network solutions that connect users, applications, and systems around the world.

This requisition supports multiple experience levels—from technicians and administrators responsible for day-to-day network operations to engineers and architects designing enterprise routing, switching, firewall, wireless, and cloud networking solutions. Successful candidates will collaborate across infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems engineering, and operations teams to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable network services supporting domestic and international missions.

If you enjoy solving complex connectivity challenges, implementing modern networking technologies, and building secure enterprise infrastructure, you'll find meaningful opportunities to grow your career while supporting a global mission.

Opportunities are contingent upon contract award

Responsibilities

Depending on experience and level, responsibilities may include:

  • Install, configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, and related technologies.

  • Support the design, implementation, and optimization of local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), wireless networks, and software-defined networking solutions.

  • Configure and maintain network routing, switching, VPN connectivity, network segmentation, quality of service (QoS), and high-availability solutions.

  • Deploy, administer, and optimize enterprise firewall technologies, intrusion prevention systems, and network security controls.

  • Monitor network performance, availability, capacity, and reliability while identifying and resolving connectivity issues.

  • Perform network upgrades, technology refreshes, equipment installations, firmware updates, and lifecycle replacement activities.

  • Develop and maintain network diagrams, configuration documentation, technical standards, and operational procedures.

  • Conduct network performance analysis, capacity planning, and trend analysis to improve enterprise reliability and scalability.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement secure network architectures, Zero Trust principles, access controls, and compliance requirements.

  • Support cloud networking, hybrid infrastructure, remote connectivity, and enterprise modernization initiatives.

  • Develop automation solutions to streamline network provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and operational support.

  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, disaster recovery planning, and continuity of operations activities.

  • Evaluate emerging networking technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, resiliency, and operational efficiency.

  • Senior-level professionals may develop enterprise network architecture, establish engineering standards, lead modernization initiatives, mentor technical staff, and provide strategic guidance across multiple programs.

Required Qualifications

Qualifications vary based on position level.

  • High School diploma with relevant experience or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Active Secret Clearance

  • Experience supporting enterprise network administration, engineering, implementation, or operations.

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, network protocols, and enterprise connectivity principles.

  • Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, or troubleshooting enterprise networking equipment.

  • Familiarity with network monitoring, performance analysis, troubleshooting methodologies, and technical documentation.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required Government security clearance.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise networking platforms including Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, or similar technologies.

  • Experience configuring routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, multicast, and VPN technologies.

  • Experience with enterprise firewall administration, network segmentation, IDS/IPS, secure remote access, and Zero Trust networking.

  • Experience supporting LAN, WAN, wireless, SD-WAN, software-defined networking (SDN), and cloud networking environments.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud networking, and virtual networking technologies.

  • Experience with network automation using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, PowerShell, or Infrastructure as Code methodologies.

  • Experience using enterprise network monitoring and management platforms such as SolarWinds, Cisco DNA Center, ThousandEyes, PRTG, or similar tools.

  • Experience supporting Federal Government or Department of State enterprise IT environments.

  • Knowledge of ITIL service management, change management, and configuration management practices.
