description:
Job Title: Systems Administrators

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity

Join a team supporting mission-critical enterprise IT systems and services. CACI is seeking Systems Administrators at the Journeyman, Senior, and Subject Matter Expert (SME) levels to provide systems administration, desktop support, infrastructure management, application support, network operations, and IT Service Management (ITSM) support across complex enterprise environments.

In this role, you will help maintain the availability, reliability, and performance of systems and services supporting users across domestic and global operations. You will work alongside technical teams, Government stakeholders, and mission partners to troubleshoot complex issues, manage incidents and service requests, support infrastructure and applications, implement changes, and continuously improve the end-user experience.

Candidates may be considered for multiple levels based on their years of experience, technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and ability to independently manage increasingly complex assignments.

Responsibilities

  • Support Total Ticket Ownership (TTO) throughout the incident and service request lifecycle, including ticket logging, triage, troubleshooting, resolution, escalation, documentation, and root cause analysis.

  • Provide desktop and end-user systems support, troubleshooting hardware, software, operating system, connectivity, account, and peripheral issues within an enterprise environment.

  • Manage and support Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE) and provide limited technical support for approved mobile devices.

  • Perform systems and infrastructure administration supporting domestic and enterprise operations, including workstation, peripheral, card printer, consular office system, and web services infrastructure.

  • Install, configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise applications and services.

  • Support collaboration platforms and other enterprise tools used across geographically dispersed environments.

  • Perform network operations activities supporting reliable enterprise connectivity, availability, and performance.

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve systems, infrastructure, application, and network-related incidents in coordination with appropriate technical teams.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to maintain and improve Ticket Management System configurations, workflows, classifications, and processes.

  • Support and enhance self-service and self-help capabilities, including password resets, account provisioning, hardware and software requests, troubleshooting resources, and knowledge management content.

  • Participate in Problem Management and root cause analysis, identifying recurring issues, documenting findings, tracking corrective actions, and recommending long-term solutions.

  • Support Change Management activities by initiating, documenting, reviewing, tracking, and implementing approved changes to IT systems, services, applications, and infrastructure.

  • Assist with impact analysis, risk assessment, implementation planning, validation, and post-implementation reviews for technical changes.

  • Maintain accurate system, incident, problem, change, configuration, and operational documentation to support audit and compliance requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to improve hardware, software, workflows, processes, procedures, automation, and overall service delivery.

  • Collaborate with Government stakeholders, Product Teams, engineering teams, service desk personnel, network teams, and other technical organizations to resolve issues and support enterprise objectives.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Apply ITSM principles and established policies, procedures, security requirements, and technical standards to day-to-day operations.

  • Perform additional systems administration and enterprise IT support activities as required to meet mission and operational requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

Candidates will be considered at the appropriate level based on demonstrated experience and technical expertise.

  • All levels require a Secret security clearance

Journeyman Systems Administrator

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in systems administration, enterprise IT support, desktop support, infrastructure operations, network operations, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, operating systems, applications, peripherals, user accounts, and connectivity issues.

  • Experience working with an enterprise ticketing or IT Service Management platform.

  • Experience supporting incident and service request management processes.

  • Experience installing, configuring, deploying, maintaining, or troubleshooting enterprise applications and systems.

  • Working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts and infrastructure.

  • Ability to apply established technical concepts, processes, practices, and procedures to resolve technical assignments.

  • Ability to escalate complex technical issues and collaborate effectively with senior administrators, engineers, and other technical teams.

  • Strong documentation, communication, customer service, and problem-solving skills.

Senior Systems Administrator

In addition to the qualifications above:

  • 5-7 years of relevant experience

  • Demonstrated experience independently administering and troubleshooting complex enterprise IT environments.

  • Advanced experience with systems administration, desktop support, infrastructure operations, application support, and/or network operations.

  • Experience coordinating incident resolution and performing root cause analysis for complex or recurring technical issues.

  • Experience supporting Tier II/Tier III technical issues and collaborating across multiple technical teams to drive incidents through resolution.

  • Experience with Problem Management, Change Management, and other ITSM processes.

  • Ability to analyze trends, identify systemic issues, and recommend technical or procedural improvements.

  • Experience developing or maintaining technical workflows, knowledge management resources, system documentation, and standard operating procedures.

  • Ability to independently manage multiple complex technical assignments with appreciable latitude in determining methodology and solutions.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members.

SME Systems Administrator

In addition to the Journeyman and Senior qualifications:

  • 10 + years of relevant experience

  • Extensive experience administering and supporting large-scale, complex enterprise IT environments.

  • Expert-level knowledge across multiple areas of systems administration, infrastructure operations, application support, network operations, and IT service management.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead resolution of high-impact, high-priority, or technically complex incidents and problems.

  • Experience leading root cause analysis, Problem Management, Change Management, and continuous service improvement efforts across multiple technical teams.

  • Ability to evaluate proposed system and infrastructure changes, including technical impact, operational risk, dependencies, implementation requirements, and post-implementation results.

  • Experience developing technical strategies, standards, workflows, processes, and recommendations that improve enterprise service delivery.

  • Ability to serve as a technical authority and provide guidance to Government stakeholders, technical teams, and program leadership.

  • Demonstrated experience planning and leading major technical assignments and coordinating activities across multiple projects, teams, or functional areas.

  • Ability to mentor and provide technical direction to Systems Administrators and other technical personnel.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify complex technical challenges, develop solutions with limited direction, and communicate recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Software Delivery Specialist
description:
ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Software Delivery Specialist is responsible for coordinating and assuring the effective execution of software delivery activities across OrganOx digital products, software platforms, and technology initiatives. Working within the Digital team, the role acts as an Engineering Delivery Lead / Delivery Coordinator, improving day-to-day delivery execution across internal developers, offshore teams, and external development partners. The role focuses on removing delivery blockers, improving sprint and backlog effectiveness, maintaining delivery transparency, and ensuring SDLC evidence and documentation are current and audit-ready within a regulated healthcare environment.

The Software Delivery Specialist supports the Digital Software Manager and Product teams by coordinating people, priorities, dependencies, evidence, and execution. The role provides delivery visibility, risk management, and cross-functional coordination across Product Management, Engineering, QA/RA, Operations, and external partners, while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.

This is an on-site position in Oxford with flexibility.

Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

Major Responsibilities

Under direction from the Digital Software Manager, the Software Delivery Specialist will be responsible for:

  • Coordinate day-to-day software delivery activities across internal developers, offshore teams, external development partners, and relevant cross-functional teams.
  • Identify, track, escalate, and support removal of delivery blockers, impediments, execution risks, and unresolved dependencies.
  • Drive accountability for agreed actions, commitments, dependencies, delivery milestones, and work package outcomes.
  • Support effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery reviews, retrospectives, and follow-up actions.
  • Coordinate delivery alignment across Product Management, Engineering, QA/RA, Operations, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure SDLC deliverables, traceability records, delivery evidence, and audit trails are completed, maintained, and audit-ready.
  • Monitor adherence to OrganOx quality procedures, regulatory processes, and software lifecycle expectations.

title: Security Coordinator SK
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Security Coordinator, you will support the execution of security, compliance and audit programs across stores within the Sales Market. Your role is hands‑on and operational, focused on ensuring stores follow security standards, action plans and processes related to safety, loss prevention and compliance. You will work closely with store and area teams to manage risks, support inventories and investigations, and strengthen a strong security and safety culture. In this role, you will be responsible for Slovakia and 29 stores.

You will:

  • Execute and follow up security compliance programs across stores, areas and the Sales Market.
  • Plan and carry out store audits and internal monitoring in line with Green Security Standards.
  • Drive security requirements and action plans together with store and area teams, ensuring timely follow‑up and execution.
  • Support store management in achieving audit expectations, clearly communicating required actions and priorities.
  • Report audit results, deviations and follow‑ups using company tools and systems.
  • Act as an ambassador for security standards, services and requirements across stores and areas.
  • Drive awareness and training initiatives to strengthen safety and security culture.
  • Provide operational support to stores during Yearly Stock Take (YST), including preparation, store visits and troubleshooting.
  • Support inventory accuracy through on‑site support during counts in priority stores.
  • Contribute to Loss Prevention initiatives aimed at reducing shrinkage.
  • Support the security team in investigations related to fraud and compliance incidents.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

As a Security Coordinator, you will work closely with Store Managers, Area Teams and the Sales Market Security function. You will act as an important link between stores and central security, ensuring standards are understood, applied and followed up in daily operations.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

  • At least 1 year of experience in security operations, compliance, retail security or similar operational roles.
  • Previous experience as a Store Manager or in a comparable store leadership role within retail is a plus.
  • Good understanding of store operations, security standards and compliance programs.
  • Experience supporting audits, monitoring requirements and following up action plans.
  • Familiarity with inventory processes, including Yearly Stock Take (YST).
  • Experience supporting or participating in investigations, including fraud cases and incident reporting.
  • Ability to work with audit, reporting and compliance‑tracking tools and systems.
  • Good English skills, written and spoken.
  • Native or fluent level of Slovak, with excellent written and spoken communication skills.

And people who are…

  • Detail‑oriented, structured and reliable in execution and follow‑up.
  • Comfortable working hands‑on in stores and interacting with frontline teams.
  • Clear and confident communicators who can explain requirements and expectations.
  • Proactive problem‑solvers with a practical, solution‑oriented mindset.
  • Acting with integrity and aligned with H&M values in everything they do.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

More specifically, we offer:

  • 25% staff discount for you and one family member across all H&M Group brands – in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Working mode: 4 days from office / 1 day flexible.
  • Meal Allowance – Receive a meal allowance of 90 Kč for each working day, included in your salary.
  • H&M HIP incentive program.
  • Relaxing Days - 2 additional days off in your first year and 4 days annually after your first year with us.
  • Referral bonus for recommending externally hired colleagues.
  • Co-financed access to either a Multisport Card.
  • Occasional coupons and bonuses throughout the year.
  • Extra Annual Leave - 1 additional vacation day after 6 months of employment.
  • Additional day off (jubilee).
  • Educational Learning Studio platform, including LinkedIn Learning.
  • Structured year-round development process with goal setting, performance evaluation, and achievement review.
  • Career opportunities, with 70% of our recruitment processes filled through internal promotions.

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a full-time role based on a local contract in Bratislava (Slovakia). The Security Coordinator reports to Security Manager.

We offer a monthly salary from 1400€ gross.

If you feel that this is an opportunity that will drive you, please apply with your CV in English no later than 30th August 2026. Due to data privacy policies, we only accept applications via our career page.

Take the next step in your career with us. The journey starts here.

​

*we are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​

title: Staff Software Engineer – AI/ML, Payments Technology
description:
Salary: Base + Super + Bonus

Staff Software Engineer – AI/ML, Payments Technology

Sydney or Melbourne

  • Build AI-powered engineering capabilities within one of Australia's largest and most critical Payments technology environments.

  • Work at the intersection of software engineering, cloud and applied AI/ML, turning emerging AI capabilities into secure, scalable production systems.

  • Shape how AI is engineered and adopted across Payments, creating reusable patterns, platforms and capabilities that can scale across teams.


Do work that matters

Payments Technology sits at the heart of CommBank, building and operating platforms that move billions of dollars and support millions of customers and businesses every day.

We're investing in an AI Centre of Excellence within Payments Technology and are looking for several Staff Software Engineers to help us shape the next generation of AI-enabled engineering and payment capabilities.

This isn't about experimentation for experimentation's sake.

You'll work on practical applications of AI across Payments — from engineering productivity and intelligent automation through to agentic workflows, operational processes, investigation and exception handling.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI/ML and cloud capability to take ideas from experimentation through to secure, reliable and observable production systems.

You'll also help establish the engineering patterns, guardrails and reusable capabilities that enable other Payments teams to adopt AI safely and effectively.


See yourself in our team

You'll join the Payments Engineering AI Centre of Excellence, working alongside engineers, architects, product teams and specialists across the broader Payments organisation.

You'll operate as a senior technical leader — remaining hands-on while influencing architecture, engineering standards and the way teams design, build and operate AI-enabled software.


You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Design, build and operate production-grade AI/ML and GenAI solutions in a cloud environment.

  • Build backend services and AI capabilities using Python and modern software engineering practices.

  • Design and productionise AI agents and agentic workflows, including orchestration, tool use, grounding and human-in-the-loop patterns.

  • Work with LLMs and cloud AI platforms to solve real engineering and operational problems within Payments.

  • Develop RAG and grounding patterns, integrating models with enterprise data, APIs and internal systems.

  • Establish approaches for evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI, helping ensure AI solutions are reliable, explainable and appropriate for a regulated environment.

  • Design reusable AI services, frameworks, APIs and platform capabilities that can be adopted across multiple engineering teams.

  • Apply strong cloud-native engineering principles across scalability, resilience, security and performance.

  • Champion DevSecOps and design-to-run ownership, taking solutions from architecture and development through deployment, observability and production operations.

  • Explore how AI-assisted engineering can improve software delivery, testing, operational support and developer productivity.

  • Mentor engineers and help grow AI engineering capability across Payments Technology.

  • Influence technical strategy and contribute to engineering standards and reference patterns for AI adoption across the organisation.


We're interested in hearing from people who:

We don't expect you to have experience with every technology or AI framework listed below. We're looking for strong engineers with depth across software engineering, cloud and AI/ML who are comfortable learning quickly as the technology continues to evolve.


You'll ideally:

  • Bring strong Staff-level software engineering capability, with experience designing, building and operating complex production systems at scale.

  • Have strong hands-on programming capability, particularly in Python, with experience building production-quality services and applications.

  • Have strong experience with cloud-native engineering. We primarily use AWS, but experience designing and operating sophisticated solutions on Azure or GCP is also valuable, provided you're comfortable adapting to AWS.

  • Have practical experience building or productionising AI/ML or Generative AI solutions, rather than solely consuming AI tools.

  • Understand modern AI engineering concepts such as LLM integration, agents, RAG, grounding, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation and guardrails.

  • Understand the challenges of taking AI from prototype to production, including scalability, latency, cost, security, observability and reliability.

  • Bring experience designing APIs, microservices, distributed systems and event-driven architectures.

  • Have a strong DevSecOps mindset, with experience across CI/CD, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, observability and production operations.

  • Be comfortable making architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs and providing technical direction in ambiguous or rapidly evolving areas.

  • Have experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across teams.


Technology & engineering environment

Our environment continues to evolve, so we're more interested in strong fundamentals and adaptability than experience with every individual technology.

Exposure across a number of the following would be valuable:


AI & ML Engineering
Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, agentic workflows, RAG, prompt engineering, model evaluation, grounding, guardrails, responsible AI and human-in-the-loop patterns.


Cloud & AI Platforms
AWS, Amazon Bedrock and cloud-native architectures. Relevant Azure or GCP AI/cloud experience is also welcomed.


Software Engineering
Python, Java, Node.js/TypeScript, APIs, microservices and distributed systems.


Data & Event-Driven Engineering
Kafka/event streaming, data pipelines, vector and relational data stores, schema management and integration patterns.


Platform & DevSecOps
Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes/containers, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, observability, security and automated engineering controls.


What great looks like

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a strong software engineer first, with genuine depth in AI/ML and cloud engineering.

  • Enjoy turning emerging technologies into practical, production-ready capabilities.

  • Can move comfortably between experimentation, architecture and hands-on engineering.

  • Think beyond the model itself and consider the entire system around it — data, APIs, security, evaluation, observability, reliability and operations.

  • Understand that building AI in a critical, regulated environment requires strong engineering discipline and responsible controls.

  • Can take ambiguous problems and turn them into pragmatic technical solutions.

  • Create reusable patterns and capabilities rather than solving the same problem independently in every squad.

  • Influence engineers and technical leaders without needing direct authority.

  • Stay curious and continuously experiment as AI engineering practices evolve.

  • Care deeply about engineering quality, customer outcomes and building technology that can be trusted in production.


Why Payments Technology?

Few engineering environments combine the scale and criticality of Payments with the opportunity presented by AI.

You'll have the opportunity to help shape how one of Australia's largest technology organisations applies AI to real-world engineering and payment challenges — while working on systems where security, reliability and engineering excellence genuinely matter.

If you're an experienced engineer who enjoys building at scale and wants to help move AI from possibility to production, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Patient Administrator/ Aide- Athlone

Desirable

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Empathy

  • Flexibility and adaptability to be able to deal with different tasks

  • Honesty and Integrity

Application Process:

By clicking apply to this role your application will not only be considered for this position, but your details will be stored on our database and may be considered for similar future positions that may arise. This means that the personal data contained in your application and provided to Affidea as part of the application process may be retained by us for up to 12 months from the date of your application. After this time, it will be deleted. If you do not wish your details to be stored on our recruitment database, please email Affidea recruitment stating this and we will ensure that such information is not stored other than for the purposes of this application. Please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Notice for more information or to Affidea’ s Data Privacy Notice for Recruitment

title: Principal Software Engineer

Om jobbet

Som servicevärd inom Tentaservice är du universitetets ansikte utåt under tentor och ser till att allt fungerar från insläpp till avslut. Ditt arbete är på plats i tentalokalerna och vid Linköpings Universitet har vi 5 tentaperioder som vanligtvis är i 2-veckorsperioder i januari, mars, maj/juni, augusti och oktober. Under dessa perioder förväntar vi oss att du har en mycket hög tillgänglighet för att arbeta hos oss. Det kan också bli arbetspass mellan tentaperioderna, men då i mindre utsträckning. Du kommer att arbeta med olika digitala lösningar.

Som servicevärd ansvarar du för att:

  • Förbereda tentasalen inför insläpp enligt rutiner med ex material, skyltning och utrustning.
  • Ta emot studenter, informera om praktiska förutsättningar och skapa ett välkomnande men tydligt ramverk för tentan.
  • Vara tillgänglig under hela passet för frågor och stöd samt lösa enklare tekniska problem vid digital tenta. Eskalera till teknikvärd vid behov.
  • Ha aktiv närvaro i salen för att stötta studenter och motverka fusk enligt gällande rutiner.
  • Hantera avvikelser ex brand, sjukdom, misstanke om fusk enligt fastställda rutiner.
  • Delta i förberedande möten inför tentaperioder samt korta avstämningar före och efter arbetspass.

För att bli framgångsrik som servicevärd behöver du tycka om att arbeta teamorienterat med ett proaktivt förhållningssätt.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är en uppmärksam och tillmötesgående person med stor vilja och förmåga att hitta lösningar på situationer som kan uppstå i arbetet. Du arbetar mycket bra tillsammans med andra och relaterar till dom på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt.

Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och har lätt för att anpassa dig till ändrade förutsättningar. Om det uppstår en pressad situation i samband med en tentamen bibehåller du ditt lugn och kan med ett realistiskt perspektiv prioritera rätt saker.

Vi vill att du har:

  • Gymnasieexamen eller motsvarande
  • En grundläggande IT-teknisk förståelse, exempelvis kunna felsöka enklare fel
  • En god förmåga att arbeta i olika datorprogram
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i tal och skrift på svenska
  • Grundläggande kunskaper i tal och skrift på engelska

Det är meriterande om du också har erfarenhet av:

  • Arbete inom IT
  • Att stötta kollegor inom grundläggande IT-frågor
  • Pedagogiskt arbete
  • Att arbeta i team och bidra till teamets utveckling

Din arbetsplats

Lokal-, tentamens- och schemaenheten inom Studentavdelningen ansvarar för att genomföra schemaläggning och lokalbokning samt samordning och genomförande av skriftliga salstentamina inklusive högskoleprovet. På enheten arbetar ca 30 tillsvidareanställda medarbetare och dryga hundra timanställda servicevärdar.

Läs mer om vår verksamhet på Studentavdelningen här https://liu.se/organisation/liu/uf/sa

Om anställningen

Extraarbete på timmar. Som medarbetare arbetar du de arbetspass du och din arbetsledare kommer överens om under en ramperiod om ca 1 år. Du är inte garanterad en viss mängd arbete.

Vi söker medarbetare till olika orter men du kommer enbart att ha en placeringsort.

Skriftliga salstentamina genomförs i princip dagligen mellan kl 8-19 med ibland förlängda tider till klockan 22. Tentamina utförs även på lördagar under tentaperioderna. Några veckor per termin är mer tentamenstäta och under dessa veckor behöver du vara tillgänglig på heltid.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Lön och förmåner

Lön enligt lokalt avtal för servicevärdar.

Läs mer om förmåner för anställda https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/formaner.

Fackliga kontaktpersoner

Information om fackliga kontaktpersoner, se https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/hjalp-for-sokande.

Ansökan

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan med CV och ansökningsbrev senast den 14 september 2026. Du söker denna anställning genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök" här nedan. Ansökan som inkommer efter sista ansökningsdag kommer inte att beaktas.

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv, det berikar och utvecklar vår verksamhet. För oss är det självklart att värna om allas lika värde, rättigheter och möjligheter. Läs om vårt arbete med https://liu.se/artikel/lika-villkor/.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Linköpings universitet har upphandlade avtal och undanber oss direktkontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Salary: $100,500 – $147,750 per year

About Lyra
Driven by purpose. Defined by people.

Lyra started with a simple act. A group of engineers helped their roommates build a product from scratch. Six weeks later that product launched. Shortly after, it raised over $2M in a pre-seed round. That company was Paraform (now raised $80m series B). And that moment was the reason Lyra exists.

Since then we have become a collective of 70+ top-tier engineers across Australia, partnering with 50+ startups across Silicon Valley to build, design, and ship products that matter. Our mission is simple: build, teach, and grow. Join Australia's top engineering talent, building software for Silicon Valley startups.

About the Role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you embed directly with a client startup and take end-to-end ownership of a workstream. You're trusted to make the technical calls, commit on timelines, and deliver outcomes the founder cares about - with the autonomy of a senior engineer and the backing of Australia's strongest engineering bench.

This isn't a ramp-up role. You're generating value from week one: owning technical design for projects of moderate-to-high complexity, debugging deep in the client's systems without flailing, and shipping drama-free launches.

What we're looking for

  • At least 2-5 years of experience in a similar role at other startups or software companies under your belt.

  • High proficiency in full-stack engineering with Next.js / TypeScript and/or Python.

  • You are curious about how things work and have innate ability to problem solve - this is crucial as you won't always have the information you need to move forward.

  • Strong client-facing communication.

  • Based in Australia.

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Workstream ownership: Own a workstream on a client engagement end to end, from scoping through to launch, breaking complex requirements down into sub-tasks and driving them to completion despite roadblocks.

  • Technical design: Own the technical design for projects of moderate complexity within the engagement, evaluating implementation tradeoffs and documenting the chosen approach for the engagement team.

  • Domain depth: Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the client's systems and codebase, sufficient to diagnose and resolve defects in those systems efficiently and to act as a point of reference for other engineers on the engagement.

  • Production engineering: Ship production-quality code with minimal supervision, following the client engagement's stated best practices and setting a high quality bar for the work without sacrificing productivity.

  • Estimation and delivery commitment: Estimate work credibly, run planning for the owned workstream, and commit to and meet delivery timelines agreed with the client.

  • Software engineering practices: Apply core engineering disciplines including but not limited to automated testing, source control, code review and sprint planning in day-to-day work.

  • Release quality: Ensure work is well tested and fully verified before release, carry out quality-control checks across application features, and identify and resolve defects prior to release.

  • Requirements clarification and risk identification: Clarify unclear requirements and vet assumptions before work starts, and identify conflicting or problematic requirements and raise them with the client lead.

  • Product context: Understand how the work fits into the larger picture for the client (the why of a feature, not just the what) and use that understanding to inform prioritisation within the workstream.

  • Code review and mentoring: Review other engineers' pull requests and provide sustained technical mentorship to junior engineers on the engagement.

  • Specialist contribution beyond development: Take responsibility for at least one specialist area beyond hands-on coding, such as conducting technical interviews and candidate evaluation, on-call and incident response leadership, internal engineering tooling and automation, or client-facing technical roadmap discussions.

  • Proactive improvement: Identify and propose future areas of work and technical improvements for the engagement, supported by evidence, rather than working only from an assigned task list.

  • Client engagement: Attend client stand-ups and engagement meetings, and communicate work status, risks and feedback to peers, the engagement lead and the Lyra manager.

  • Mentoring: May be responsible for mentoring interns and newer engineers in client engagement.

  • Note: Higher-tier/client engagement arrangement involving additional hours (ie 50 hours per week) may apply, depending on client engagement needs and business requirements.

Compensation & Growth

  • $100,500 - $147,750 ex super per year

  • Transparent, level-based progression, fast promotions for high performers, with the ability to skip levels on skill.

  • Merit-based raises tied to performance and contribution.

Benefits

  • Free catering daily, plus drinks and snacks provided.

  • Access to our Silicon Valley VC & founder network.

  • Receive top-of-the-line work equipment.

  • Hybrid work with access to our Barangaroo office.

  • Weekly sports and activities funded by Lyra.

title: Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Petra Brands:

Petra Brands is a dynamic and innovative consumer products company that manages a diverse portfolio of brands, including House of Party, Fomin Soap, Roofus, Everymood, and Luna Naturals. We specialize in creating unique and memorable consumer packaged goods (CPG) in the party, craft, beauty, personal care, and lifestyle sectors.

Our mission is to deliver products that spark creativity, celebration, and connection — crafting experiences that evoke emotion, memories, and a sense of place through captivating brand identities and thoughtful packaging.

The Role:

We are looking for an Full Stack AI Engineer who lives and breathes AI and thrives on building scalable, data-heavy systems. You will help us leverage AI, custom web applications, and automation to streamline operations, manage huge datasets, and modernize our business workflows.

This isn't a purely theoretical research role—it’s about getting things built and deployed. You will work across our group of retail and consumer businesses to find opportunities where AI can automate manual work, process high-volume data, and power intelligent enterprise systems like ERPs.

If you are a builder who regularly uses Claude, ChatGPT, and modern web frameworks to solve real-world operational problems, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect and deploy custom web applications, ERP integrations, and automated workflows using AI models and modern web frameworks.
  • Handle large volumes of corporate, financial, and supply chain data to create intelligent, automated data pipelines.
  • Analyze existing workflows in finance and supply chain to identify high-impact areas for AI automation.
  • Connect AI models (including Claude) and modern tech stacks with existing internal systems, databases, and third-party tools.
  • Write, refine, and optimize prompts and leverage RAG architectures to deliver consistent, context-aware, and reliable AI outputs.
  • Work alongside non-technical business teams to translate complex operational pain points into practical software solutions.

Core Technical Skills Needed:

  • Languages: JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Frontend: React or Next.js.
  • Databases: Relational databases like PostgreSQL.
  • AI & Architecture: LLM integration and deep familiarity with AI concepts like RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Automation & Scripting: Comfort with workflow tools (Zapier, Make, or n8n) and scripting (Python or JS/TS).

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven track record of working on data-intensive projects, web applications, and enterprise systems like ERPs.
  • Direct experience building with AI models, specifically Claude, ChatGPT, or similar LLMs.
  • Strong problem-solver who can break down messy processes
  • Good communicator — can explain tech stuff to non-tech people

Nice To Have:

  • Experience with RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere).
  • Background in retail, e-commerce, or CPG agency environments.
  • Proven track record of measuring ROI on automation and AI projects.

What We Offer:

  • A chance to work with the exciting and rapidly growing global company.
  • Career growth and professional development support.
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses.
  • A collaborative and supportive workplace culture that celebrates creativity.

title: Ambulant Begeleider Jeugd & Gezin (SKJ)
description:
Rotterdam en omgeving | 16-36 uur | €3.296 - €4.705 (FWG 50) | Zakelijke auto | Kantoortijden

"Dit bespreek ik liever met jou dan met mijn ouders."

Als een jongere dat tegen je zegt, weet je dat het goed zit. Het vertrouwen is er. En precies dáár begint het echte werk: samen stappen vooruit zetten.

Bij Zeno Ambulant begeleid je jongeren en gezinnen met complexe zorgvraagstukken, vanuit de Jeugdwet. Je komt bij gezinnen thuis, op school en overal waar hun dagelijks leven zich afspeelt. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar er middenin. Jij bouwt de relatie op waar verandering mee begint.

Klinkt dit als jouw manier van werken? Lees dan verder.

Zo ziet jouw werk eruit

Als ambulant begeleider Jeugd & Gezin werk je binnen het gezinssysteem met jongeren en gezinnen die intensieve, individuele ondersteuning nodig hebben. Je kijkt verder dan het dossier en zoekt naar wat wél werkt: je bouwt een relatie op, bent zichtbaar aanwezig en werkt samen aan herstel van structuur, vertrouwen en perspectief. Stap voor stap, richting stabiliteit en ontwikkeling.

Je werkt zelfstandig en bent veel onderweg: bij gezinnen thuis, in Rotterdam en omgeving. Tussendoor sta je altijd in verbinding met een betrokken team dat samen verantwoordelijkheid draagt. Regelmatig kom je met alle collega's samen op kantoor in Sliedrecht voor het teamoverleg, waar jullie elkaar scherp houden met intervisie en samen werken aan de kwaliteit van de zorg. En omdat de hulpvraag van het gezin leidend is, ben je flexibel inzetbaar. Denk daarbij ook aan avonden en weekenden.

Zo werkt jouw collega Wessel

"Relatieopbouw staat voor mij centraal. In het begin kan het intensief zijn, maar als een jongere zegt: 'dit bespreek ik liever met jou dan met mijn ouders', weet ik dat het goed zit. Wederzijds vertrouwen geeft ons de ruimte om stappen vooruit te zetten.

Ik werk graag actief: wandelen, fietsen, sporten. Beweging als middel om contact te maken. Praten gaat vaak makkelijker als je niet tegenover elkaar zit en elkaar niet recht hoeft aan te kijken. Daarom gaat mijn hond regelmatig mee en ligt er standaard een bal in de auto, klaar voor een spontaan moment buiten."

Wessel, ambulant begeleider bij Zeno

Wat ga je doen?

Jouw werk gebeurt daar waar het leven van jongeren en gezinnen zich afspeelt: aan de keukentafel, op school of gewoon buiten. Samen werk je aan herstel van structuur, daginvulling en perspectief. Je stelt begeleidingsdoelen op en voert ze uit, en je sluit aan bij het netwerk om de jongere heen, van ouders tot mentor. Kleine stappen, gebouwd op vertrouwen, echte vooruitgang.

Je doet dat niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's en externe zorgpartners, en omdat Zeno Ambulant groeit, denk je actief mee over hoe we onze ambulante dienstverlening nog beter kunnen maken.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent iemand die rust bewaart als een dag totaal anders loopt dan gepland, en dat gebeurt in dit werk regelmatig. Je bent proactief, flexibel en je maakt makkelijk verbinding met jongeren, gezinnen én hun netwerk. In situaties waarin anderen afhaken, blijf jij juist zoeken naar contact en mogelijkheden. En je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, reflecteert op je eigen handelen en beschikt over een gezonde dosis humor.

Daarnaast breng jij het volgende mee:

  • Een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Social Work, SPH of vergelijkbaar.

  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie.

  • Gedragsproblematiek en complexe ondersteuningsvragen schrikken jou niet af, daar kom jij juist voor.

  • Ervaring met het opstellen van individuele dagprogramma's voor jongere en gezin.

  • Een rijbewijs (de auto regelen wij).

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • 16-36 uur per week.

  • Je start met een tijdelijk contract. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de stap naar een vast contract.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €3.296 tot €4.705 (FWG 50), afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring (cao Gehandicaptenzorg).

  • Een zakelijke auto met tankpas.

  • Een groeiend, ambitieus en betrokken team: collegiaal, informeel en ja, de teamuitjes zijn echt tof.

  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag conform cao.

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 PBL-uren, 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Ruimte om jezelf vakinhoudelijk te ontwikkelen door scholing, intervisie, werkbegeleiding en coaching, en een buddy die je in de eerste periode wegwijs maakt.

Daarom Zeno.

Zeno staat voor Zorg EN Ondersteuning, en die naam is geen toeval: wij geloven dat je samen verder komt dan alleen. Niet protocollen of systemen staan bij ons centraal, maar de mens achter de hulpvraag. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te handelen, initiatief te nemen en écht van betekenis te zijn. En omdat we groeien, groei jij mee: er liggen volop mogelijkheden voor wie ze wil pakken.

De kracht van Zeno is de kracht van verbinding. Collega's met verschillende specialisaties, maar dezelfde gedrevenheid om écht te zorgen. We staan voor elkaar klaar, denken mee en springen bij als een dag anders loopt dan gepland. We werken hard, maar humor en werkplezier verliezen we nooit uit het oog.

Zin om te zorgen?

Ben jij die ambulant begeleider die stevig staat, snel schakelt en oog houdt voor de mens achter het gedrag? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Solliciteer direct, of stel eerst vrijblijvend je vragen aan Sarono Peroti, recruiter, via 06-11178820. Bellen of appen mag allebei, en een kop koffie op kantoor kan natuurlijk ook. title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
Playtech is looking for a proactive Lead DevOps Engineer with strong technical expertise and excellent communication skills.

In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and scaling of our cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on Kubernetes-based environments. You will drive CI/CD automation, improve system reliability and observability, and enforce best practices across infrastructure as code, monitoring, and incident management. As a team lead, you will guide DevOps engineers, optimize production systems, and foster a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Resolve most complex DevOps tasks.
  • Lead the team of Product Operations engineers.
  • Conduct a comprehensive audit of existing service‑management processes and develop a clear plan for their improvement.
  • Establish key operational performance indicators and create a clear plan to track, measure, and improve them.
  • Provide immediate respond for any alert.
  • Liaise with SL1/SL3, 3rd parties and internal stakeholders.

Components for success. You...

  • Possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

  • Bring strong experience in Linux, Docker, configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet), CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins), Cloud services (AWS), and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Nomad).
  • Have experience writing infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Have worked with monitoring systems (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios/Sensu) and logging solutions (Elastic Stack, Loki).
  • Interact effectively with senior management, technical subject matter experts, and business stakeholders.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Have experience supporting web applications with microservices architecture, including Akka cluster management and monitoring.
  • Bring knowledge of NoSQL database support (MongoDB, Couchbase) and NGINX server management.
  • Possess programming skills in Python/Bash.
  • Have worked in a global, multilingual organization.

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.

In addition to your CV in English, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current working experience in a corporate environment - again in English. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

#LI-DR1

title: Supervising Investigator
description:
The New York City Department of Correction (DOC) is an integral part of the City’s evolving criminal justice system, participating in reform initiatives and strategies aimed to move the City towards a smaller jail system without compromising public safety. The DOC is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our employees, visitors, volunteers and people in our custody. Importantly, safe jails enable DOC to provide people in custody with the tools and opportunities they need to successfully re-enter their communities. The DOC operates facilities and court commands across the five boroughs with more than 7,500 diverse professionals and knowledgeable experts.

The New York City Department of Correction seeks to recruit Supervising Investigators for the Investigation Division. Under the direction of a Deputy Director for the Investigation Division and with latitude to exercise independent judgement and decision making, the successful candidates for this position will be responsible for supervising criminal and/or non-criminal, unique, highly confidential and sensitive investigations. The Investigation Division (ID) is responsible for investigating all Use of Force incidents that occur within the Department of Correction in a timely, efficient manner while remaining un-biased in the analysis of evidence. It is the Divisions responsibility to ensure that all employees act within the guidelines of Directives relating to Use of Force and prepare administrative charges when necessary.

Typical responsibilities of this position include:

- Supervising a team of investigators engaged in the performance of confidential, highly
complex, and/or special investigations involving surveillance, interrogation of subjects
and witnesses, and examinations and analysis of public or agency records.
- Supervising investigations concerning reported and/or alleged Use of Force incidents.
- Liaising with the Department of Investigation, the New York City Police Department,
and/or District Attorneys’ offices with respect to these investigations.
- Preparing, reviewing, evaluating, and acting on all reports, studies and recommendations
submitted for administrative action; making recommendations regarding investigations.
- Working in close coordination with federal, state and city investigation and law enforcement
agencies; testifying at hearings and court proceedings.
- Understanding and ability to apply the DOC Directives, procedures, rules and regulations,
and understanding of the administrative disciplinary procedures and the criminal justice system.

Preferred Skills:

- Previous supervisory or management background is a plus, with at least five (5) or more years
experience.
- Experience working with prosecutors in developing cases; testifying at hearings and court proceedings
is a plus.
- Significant knowledge of the NYPD investigative procedures and processes, NYPD special victims’
squads,
and the New York City criminal justice system; knowledge of the laws, regulations, consent decrees,
minimum standards and other legal mandates which affect the field of correction, investigations and the
criminal justice system; knowledge of DOC rules, regulations, directives and protocols is a plus.
- Ability to be objective and thorough in conducting investigations of law enforcement personnel, inmates,
confidential witnesses and informants.
- Experience conducting investigations using a variety of data sources (i.e. eJusticeNY, CLEAR, IIS,
IFCOM, Webcrims, Rapsheets, various watchdog registries, social media platforms, etc.)
- Possess excellent communications skills, strong analytical, research, problem solving, presentation
and writing skills.
- MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) proficiency.
- Successful candidates must clear a background investigation and possess a valid NYS driver’s license.
Firearms qualified is a plus.

INVESTIGATOR (DISCIPLINE) (DOC - 31164

1. A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and four years of satisfactory full-time experience in one or more of the fields of accounting, auditing, correction administration, criminal justice administration and planning, forensic science, inspection, investigation, law enforcement, personnel administration, police science, and security, or in a major operational area of the agency in which the appointment is to be made; or

2. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college; or

3. Education and/or experience equivalent to "1" or "2" above.

Iemand die eerst geen contact wilde, geeft na een tijdje zelf aan wat hij nodig heeft. Dan weet je: het werkt. Het vertrouwen is er. En precies dáár begint de echte groei.

Bij Zeno Ambulant begeleid je een diverse doelgroep met een intensieve hulpvraag vanuit de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz). Het draait om structuur, beweging en vertrouwen. Soms betekent dat samen boodschappen doen, soms een wandeling of gewoon even buiten zijn. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar er middenin.

Klinkt dit als jouw manier van werken? Lees dan verder.

Zo ziet jouw werk eruit

Je werkt binnen de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz) met cliënten die individuele ondersteuning nodig hebben in hun dagelijks leven. Samen werk je aan doelen op het gebied van structuur, vertrouwen en een zinvolle daginvulling. Je kijkt verder dan het dossier en zoekt naar wat wél werkt, stap voor stap richting meer stabiliteit en perspectief. Samen zorg je voor succeservaringen.

Je werkt zelfstandig en bent veel onderweg: bij cliënten en gezinnen thuis, in Rotterdam en omgeving. Tussendoor sta je altijd in verbinding met een betrokken team dat samen verantwoordelijkheid draagt. Regelmatig kom je met alle collega's samen op kantoor in Sliedrecht voor het teamoverleg, waar jullie elkaar scherp houden met intervisie en samen werken aan de kwaliteit van de zorg. En omdat de hulpvraag van de cliënt leidend is, ben je flexibel inzetbaar. Denk daarbij ook aan avonden en weekenden.

Zo werkt jouw collega Gerard

"Binnen Zeno Ambulant werk ik met kinderen, jongeren, adolescenten en volwassenen, onder wie ook zorgmijders. In mijn begeleiding draait het om structuur, beweging en vertrouwen. Soms betekent dat samen boodschappen doen, soms een wandeling of gewoon even buiten zijn.

Bij zorgmijders begint alles met contact en een proactieve benadering. Zonder vertrouwen komt er geen stap vooruit. Vanuit die basis help ik jongeren vaardigheden ontwikkelen en geef ik ze de tools om zelfstandig verder te kunnen.

Het mooiste aan mijn werk is de groei die ik zie: kleine successen die groot voelen. Wanneer iemand die eerst geen contact wilde, zelf aangeeft wat hij nodig heeft, weet ik dat het werkt."

Gerard, ambulant begeleider bij Zeno

Wat ga je doen?

Onze begeleiding is gericht op herstel van het gewone leven, gebaseerd op de Triple-C methodiek. Jouw werk gebeurt daar waar het leven van je cliënten en gezinnen zich afspeelt: aan de keukentafel, tijdens sport of de dagbesteding. Samen met cliënten en gezinnen werk je aan herstel van dagritme en structuur, en ondersteun je bij het behalen van persoonlijke doelen in het dagelijks leven. Kleine stappen, echte vooruitgang.

Als ambulant begeleider werk je voornamelijk aan de hulpverleningsdoelen. Daarnaast lever je een waardevolle bijdrage met wat je ziet en signaleert in het gezin: dat maak je bespreekbaar bij je trajectbegeleider.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent iemand die rust bewaart als een dag totaal anders loopt dan gepland, en dat gebeurt in dit werk regelmatig. Je bent proactief, flexibel en je maakt makkelijk verbinding met cliënten én hun netwerk. Situaties waarin anderen afhaken, zie jij juist als een uitdaging. En je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt in mogelijkheden en beschikt over zelfreflectie en een gezonde dosis humor.

Daarnaast breng jij het volgende mee:

  • Een relevante mbo-3 of mbo-4 opleiding, zoals MMZ of SPW.

  • Ervaring als (persoonlijk) begeleider in een intramurale of ambulante setting.

  • Gedragsproblematiek en complexe ondersteuningsvragen schrikken jou niet af, daar kom jij juist voor.

  • Bereidheid om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen het ambulante werkveld.

  • Een rijbewijs (de auto regelen wij).

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • 16-36 uur per week.

  • Je start met een tijdelijk contract. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de stap naar een vast contract.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €3.052 tot €4.262 (FWG 45), afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring (cao Gehandicaptenzorg).

  • Een zakelijke auto met tankpas.

  • Een groeiend, ambitieus en betrokken team: collegiaal, informeel en ja, de teamuitjes zijn echt tof.

  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag conform cao.

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 PBL-uren, 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Ruimte om jezelf vakinhoudelijk te ontwikkelen door scholing, intervisie, werkbegeleiding en coaching, en een buddy die je in de eerste periode wegwijs maakt.

Daarom Zeno.

Zeno staat voor Zorg EN Ondersteuning, en die naam is geen toeval: wij geloven dat je samen verder komt dan alleen. Niet protocollen of systemen staan bij ons centraal, maar de mens achter de hulpvraag. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te handelen, initiatief te nemen en écht van betekenis te zijn. En omdat we groeien, groei jij mee: er liggen volop mogelijkheden voor wie ze wil pakken.

De kracht van Zeno is de kracht van verbinding. Collega's met verschillende specialisaties, maar dezelfde gedrevenheid om écht te zorgen. We staan voor elkaar klaar, denken mee en springen bij als een dag anders loopt dan gepland. We werken hard, maar humor en werkplezier verliezen we nooit uit het oog.

Zin om te zorgen?

Ben jij die begeleider die stevig staat, snel schakelt en oog houdt voor de mens achter het gedrag? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Solliciteer direct, of stel eerst vrijblijvend je vragen aan Sarono Peroti, recruiter, via 06-11178820. Bellen of appen mag allebei, en een kop koffie op kantoor kan natuurlijk ook. Na je sollicitatie hoor je binnen een paar dagen van ons. Is er een match, dan nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking bij ons op kantoor in Sliedrecht.

We kijken uit naar je komst bij Zeno!

title: Medical Records Technician (Los Angeles, CA) 6657
description:
Advantmed is hiring enthusiastic Medical Records Technicians! This is a great "foot-in-the-door" position for those looking to be involved in the emerging Healthcare & Technology industry.

At Advantmed, our mission is to improve the healthcare system by ensuring appropriate, quality care, and eliminating unnecessary costs. Advantmed is a privately held company founded in 2005 and composed of over 1,800 seasoned professionals aligned by one common goal: to meet our clients' evolving needs with accuracy, efficiency, and transparency.

We would love to have you join our team of dedicated professionals! We encourage you to visit the details of the role by watching the video available at the following link: Medical Records Technician

Our Medical Records Technicians receive company-provided laptops and portable scanners to travel to various medical facilities and hospitals for scanning patient medical records.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Maintain a record system for patient information and gathering documents.
  • Use electronic systems to properly collect, organize, and manage data.
  • Ensure medical records are organized, accurate, and complete.
  • Create digital copies of paperwork and store records electronically.
  • File paperwork/reports quickly and accurately.
  • Ensure HIPAA standards are met.
  • Follow all confidentiality guidelines, rules, and procedures.
  • Interact with medical staff, healthcare providers, and other medical personnel.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds.

Additional Good-to-Have Qualifications:

  • Previous work experience in a healthcare setting, such as a hospital, clinic, or medical office dealing with medical charts.
  • Proficiency in Electronic Health Records (EHR) / EMR systems such as Epic, Cerner, Meditech, etc.
  • Intermediate knowledge of medical chart structure, content, and medical terminologies.
  • Familiarity with Word, Excel, and Outlook for documentation and communication.
  • Ability to operate and troubleshoot common issues with printers and scanners.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for interacting with healthcare professionals.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications:

  • Valid driver’s license and clean motor vehicle record.
  • Have a car and active insurance in their name (Candidates must provide registration documentation).
  • Willing to drive up to 60-80 miles or more (round-trip).
  • Internet access at home.
  • Basic PC and office equipment skills.
  • Applicants must be available from 08:00 am to 05:00 pm respective time zone to visit required facilities.

Pay Rate:

  • $18-$22 per hour or $3 per record, whichever is higher
  • Paid semi-monthly based on total hours worked or total records retrieved during the work period (whichever is higher).
  • Paid mileage, reimbursement for some travel expenses, paid $50 (daily) Food Allowance, when traveling out of state & paid Flight + Hotel + Rental (if required).

This is a part-time, seasonal position, with the potential for extension based on project requirements and needs

title: Staff Software Engineer, Customer Channel, Data & AI
description:
Staff Software Engineer, Customer Channel, Data & AI

Business Banking Technology

*Multiple roles*

*Sydney or Melbourne locations*

  • Shape the future of digital customer and colleague experiences across Business Banking.
  • Influence architecture, engineering standards and technical direction across modern cloud, data and AI-enabled platforms.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges across customer channels, data and AI at enterprise scale

Do work that matters

At CommBank, we're building the future of customer channels and data-led experiences for Australian businesses.

We're investing heavily in the next generation of customer channel, data and AI-enabled platforms that simplify how customers and colleagues engage with the bank. Our teams are creating modern, scalable technology that helps customers access insights, complete critical banking journeys and connect with the right banking services more easily.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll join one of several engineering crews across our Customer Channel & Data domain. Depending on your experience and interests, you may contribute to customer-facing channels, banker and CRM experiences, data-driven services, AI-enabled engagement platforms or core platform capabilities. You'll help shape products used across Business Banking while influencing engineering direction across a rapidly growing technology organisation.

This is an opportunity to work on platforms undergoing significant transformation, modernising how customer and colleague experiences are delivered through contemporary cloud, data and software engineering practices.

See yourself in our team

Business Banking Technology executes the Technology Strategy across Business Banking through the world-leading application of technology and operations. We partner closely with the business to solve real-world problems using data and AI-driven insights, resilient platforms and modern engineering practices, delivering customer value at speed and scale.

You'll join a growing engineering organisation responsible for critical capabilities including:

  • Customer and colleague digital experiences
  • CRM and banker platform capabilities
  • Data-driven insights and decisioning services
  • AI-enabled customer engagement experiences
  • Shared platform services supporting Business Banking journeys

Working closely with engineers, product managers, architects, data specialists and business stakeholders, you'll help solve complex technical challenges while mentoring engineers and contributing to engineering excellence across the domain.

What you'll do

  • Lead the design and delivery of scalable, resilient software solutions across customer channel and data platforms.
  • Build and evolve applications, APIs, services and platform capabilities that support critical Business Banking experiences.
  • Contribute across the technology stack, including backend services, cloud platforms, customer experiences and data-enabled solutions.
  • Drive architectural decisions and influence engineering direction within and across squads.
  • Champion modern software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability and DevSecOps.
  • Partner closely with product, business and architecture stakeholders to deliver meaningful customer outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers and help grow technical capability across the broader organisation.
  • Support platforms in production and drive continuous improvement through automation, monitoring and operational excellence.

We're interested in hearing from people who have

  • Proven experience designing and delivering complex software solutions within large-scale or distributed environments.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering capability and a passion for solving challenging technical problems.
  • Experience building cloud-native applications, APIs, platforms or data-driven services.
  • The ability to balance strategic technical thinking with hands-on delivery.
  • Experience influencing technical direction, architecture and engineering standards.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and uplifting capability across teams.

Experience in customer channels, digital platforms, CRM, data services, AI-enabled products or financial services is highly regarded, but not essential. We're looking for exceptional engineers who can learn quickly, apply sound judgement and make an impact across a variety of product areas.

Technical skills

We value strong engineering fundamentals over expertise in any single language or framework. Our teams use a range of technologies across customer channels, platform services, data and AI-enabled experiences. Experience with some of the following will help you succeed.

Engineering Craft

  • Python, Java, .NET, TypeScript, Go or similar modern software development languages
  • Designing and building APIs, services and distributed systems
  • Microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Modern application design patterns including Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • Experience working across backend, frontend and integration capabilities
  • Safe and effective use of AI-powered engineering tools to improve development productivity and quality
  • Cloud & Platform: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation)
  • Engineering Excellence: CI/CD pipelines, Automated testing, Observability and monitoring, DevSecOps practices, Agile software delivery

Working with us

At CommBank, we're committed to creating an accessible, inclusive and respectful workplace. If you require support or adjustments, please let us know.

Vi tror att du är serviceinriktad och intresserad av försäljning. Som person är du relationsskapande och kommunikativ, och drivs av att arbeta mot mål. Att söka jobbet är enkelt och går snabbt, du behöver bara besvara några urvalsfrågor direkt i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot CV eller personligt brev, eftersom vi är mer intresserade av vem du är och vad du kan bidra med, än vad du gjort tidigare.

title: Senior MDM-specialist
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Du kommer in i en tekniskt viktig roll där fokus ligger på att vidareutveckla och förbättra en befintlig MDM-miljö i en offentlig verksamhet. Här får du arbeta nära erfarna tekniker och bidra med djup specialistkunskap för att säkerställa att plattformen är rätt konfigurerad, stabil och anpassad efter verksamhetens behov.

Rollen passar dig som trivs när din expertis gör konkret skillnad i en komplex miljö. Du får kombinera hands-on konfigurering med rådgivning kring hur lösningen bäst optimeras, särskilt inom Apple-ekosystemet och XenMobile On-Premise. Det här är en intressant möjlighet för dig som vill använda din spetskompetens i ett uppdrag där kvalitet och teknisk höjd är avgörande.

  • Du analyserar verksamhetens behov och omsätter dem till fungerande lösningar i MDM-plattformen.
  • Du bidrar med specialistkunskap inom Apple Profile Manager, Apple Configurator och XenMobile On-Premise.
  • Du identifierar förbättringsområden och driver tekniska justeringar som stärker funktion, stabilitet och användbarhet.
  • Du fungerar som ett kvalificerat stöd i frågor som rör implementation, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av MDM-lösningen.
Krav
  • Du har minst 10 års erfarenhet av MDM-lösningar.
  • Du har minst 10 års erfarenhet av Apple Profile Manager och Apple Configurator.
  • Du har erfarenhet av XenMobile On-Premise-installationer.
  • Du är certifierad inom CCPM.
  • Du är certifierad inom Apple Support Professional.
  • Du har mycket hög kompetens inom MDM och är van att arbeta i komplexa tekniska miljöer.
Meriterande
  • Du har arbetat med MDM-lösningar inom statliga myndigheter.
  • Du är certifierad inom Designing, Deploying and Managing Citrix XenMobile Solutions.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Workday Integrations
description:
• You are passionate about modernising the HR ecosystem through strategic and secure use of cloud infrastructure and services
  • We are undergoing one of Australia’s largest digital transformations and establishing an Engineering function within HR.
  • Together we bring an engineering culture and passion for DevSecOps and GitOps within the cloud

Do work that matters

CommBank is recognized as leading the industry in IT and operations with its world-class platforms and processes, agile IT infrastructure, and innovation in everything from our customer facing technology to our internal services and solutions.

The HR Technology team owns and supports the groups People Technology capabilities. You will play a key role in being part of the Application engineering DevOps team.

During projects, this role will work with the Project Delivery squad which includes Technical Consultants, Business Analysts and Solution architects across the multiple platforms such as DHP, CDAO, HR Platforms etc.

See yourself in our team

The HR Technology function in CBA is responsible for designing and leading technical skills build across the organization to prepare their people to be skills-ready for today and tomorrow. This includes reskilling and talent development to support the business’ aim to be the number 1 digital bank. The HR Technology function is also focused on creating a better day at work for their people through HR innovation across platforms, processes, and channels, delivering easy-to-use solutions that help their people and support the Group meet their regulatory obligations.

Our application portfolio comprises state-of-the-art ERP systems such as Workday and specialised business solutions like BEAR Risk Management. In collaboration with our colleagues in Group Technology, we are modernising the Finance function by leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as SaaS, Cloud, AI, next-gen BI, and low/no code. Our data and architecture-led approach aims to streamline the financial data supply chain, delivering seamless and efficient solutions.

  • Workday closely with our HR Stakeholders to lead as an owner to solve our customers problems
  • Resolve Workday integrations and Extend defects as per CBA Incident Process in line with SLAs.

  • Support Execution – delivery of squad backlog that requires Workday technology (Integrations and Extend)
  • Execution – delivery of squad backlog as per Aptitude Technical Delivery Lead’s guidance
  • Design, Build & Test as per HR backlog requirements.

  • Connect with CBA Cloud communities such as OneCloud, PCCS, Engineering Group
  • Facilitate change management process and represent in Pre-CAB
  • Coordinate with deployment team and facilitate STG and production deployment.
  • Undertake any other tasks assigned by your manager/scrum master that you have the capability to perform safely in line with relevant internal Group policies and external regulatory requirements.
  • Adhere to the Code of Conduct. The Code of Conduct sets the standards of behaviour, actions, and decisions we expect from our people.


We’re interested in hearing from people who:

  • Have experience with Workday Extend and Workday Integrations
  • Have sound technical understanding of software development & testing practices and life cycle
  • Have sound technical understanding of production defect management.
  • Have the ability to analyse complex technical requirements, review architecture documents and solution design, and determine appropriate test approach and best engineering practices based on technical design.
  • Can work with multi-location teams

​

Technical Skills:

We use a broad range of tools, languages, and frameworks. We don’t expect you to know them all but experience or exposure with some of these (or equivalents) will set you up for success in this team;

  • Good experience as a Workday Engineer – extensive collaboration across agile and waterfall teams
  • Expertise in Workday Integrations, Workday Orchestrate, PECI, WECI, Studio, EIB, Reports, Core Connectors, XSLT and XML and Workday Extend
  • Demonstrable ability to analyse complex technical requirements, review architecture documents and solution design, and determine appropriate test automation approach and best engineering practices based on technical design.
  • Defect Management process – creation and tracking.
  • Experienced with JIRA and git
  • Continuous Integration (CI), Continuous Delivery (CD) and DevSecOps exp is desirable
  • Cloud technologies and experience building cloud-based applications exp is desirable

Working with us:

Whether you’re passionate about customer service, driven by data, or called by creativity, a career with CommBank is for you.

Our people bring their diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives to build a respectful, inclusive, and flexible workplace. One where we’re driven by our values, and supported to share ideas, initiatives, and energy. One where making a positive impact for customers, communities and each other is part of our every day.

Here, you’ll thrive. You’ll be supported when faced with challenges and empowered to tackle new opportunities. We’re hiring technologists from across all of Australia and have opened technology hubs in Melbourne and Perth. We really love working here, and we think you will too.

We support our people with the flexibility to balance where work is done with at least half their time each month connecting in office. We also have many other flexible working options available including changing start and finish times, part-time arrangements and job share to name a few. Talk to us about how these arrangements might work in the role you’re interested in.

If this sounds like the role for you then we would love to hear from you. Apply today!

Build and maintain executive reporting frameworks that explicitly measure and report cost savings generated by AI and automation initiatives.
