title: Responsabil depozit in magazin  Târgu Jiu
description:
Esti pregatit pentru provocarea de a gestiona sarcinile si rutinele zilnice pentru a avea un depozit organizat? Vrei sa fii responsabil pentru una dintre cele mai importante zone dintr-un magazin JYSK si, în acelasi timp, sa oferi un serviciu excelent clientilor? Iti place sa ai o activitate dinamica?

Atunci tu poti fi Responsabilul de depozitul din magazin (f/m) pe care il cautam!

CE ITI OFERIM

Ai posibilitatea sa te alaturi unei companii de retail care isi doreste sa fie prima alegere a angajatilor in retail. Noi avem un mediu dinamic unde ideile tale sunt ascultate si esti implicat. Noi consideram dezvoltarea ta ca fiind extrem de importanta.

In plus, ca Ambasador JYSK vei avea parte de urmatoarele:

  • Oportunitati pentru propria dezvoltare si responsabilitate – ne propunem sa promovam intern 80% dintre manageri. Afla mai multe aici.
  • Concursuri interne intre magazine si bonusuri pe masura
  • Iesiri bianuale impreuna cu echipa
  • Bonus competitiv care rasplateste vanzarile si rezultatele extraordinare
  • Un program de lucru flexibil
  • 20% reducere la produsele JYSK si la produsele din grupul Lars Larsen
  • Tichete de masa, tichete de vacanta acordate in functie de vechime, asigurare medicala, bonus aniversar, petrecere anuala pentru toti angajatii
  • Zile de concediu in plus: dupa 3 ani - 23 zile, dupa 5 ani - 25 de zile, dupa 7 ani - 27 de zile

CE VEI FACE LA NOUL TAU JOB

  • Esti responsabil de activitatea depozitului din magazin si de produsele din acesta
  • Participi la receptia, despachetarea,depozitarea si incasarea produselor, atat in depozit cat si in magazin, deci nu trebuie sa fii descurajat de activitatea fizica
  • Ii inveti pe colegii tai sa foloseasca si sa respecte regulile de siguranta si protectie in depozit
  • Identifici nevoile clientilor pe suprafata de vanzare si te ocupi de comenzile acestora
  • Participi la activitatile din magazin pentru a-l face atractiv pentru clienti (aprovizionarea rafturilor, inventare, consilierea clientilor, incasarea produselor, etc)
  • Esti Manager de Zi atunci cand Directorul de Magazin nu este prezent

Cunoaste un Responsabil depozit in magazin si afla mai multe despre cum suntem noi ca angajator aici.

CE CAUTAM LA TINE

  • Esti capabil sa coordonezi colegii si sa le delegi sarcini daca este necesar
  • Esti organizat si iti place sa atingi obiectivele tale dar si cele in cadrul echipei
  • Iti place sa faci parte dintr-o echipa si sa vorbesti cu clientii, dar lucrezi foarte bine si independent
  • Esti flexibil, deschis la schimbare si faci fata unei zile de lucru aglomerata

ESTE ACEST JOB O OPORTUNITATE PENTRU TINE? Aplica acum!

Procesul de recrutare in Romania:

Toate aplicatiile sunt procesate de catre echipa de recrutare sau de catre manageri. Vei primi feedback despre procesul de recrutare pe adresa de e-mail sau la numarul de telefon cu care ai aplicat.

DESPRE NOI

Credem ca angajatii nostri sunt cheia succesului nostru. De aceea, ne straduim sa oferim oportunitati de dezvoltare, crestere si noi provocari in cadrul JYSK. Inca de cand fondatorul nostru, Lars Larsen, a deschis primul magazin in Danemarca, in 1979, JYSK si-a extins prezenta globala prin magazine fizice si online in intreaga lume.

Cele trei valori fundamentale ale JYSK – Bun Comerciant, Bun Coleg si Spirit Corporatist – exprima comportamentul si atitudinea la care ne asteptam sa le avem unii fata de altii. Avem incredere unii in altii si credem ca in JYSK ai parte de sustinere si incredere, dar si de libertate cu responsabilitate.

De asemenea, suntem mandri sa recompensam implicarea si efortul deosebit al angajatilor nostri. Cu atitudinea potrivita, oportunitatile sunt nelimitate in JYSK.

JYSK accepta pe toata lumea, indiferent de varsta, identitate de gen, rasa, orientare sexuala, etnie si experienta. Impreuna, ne asiguram ca avem o cultura incluziva care incurajeaza, sprijina si celebreaza vocile diverse ale angajatilor nostri. Pentru ca mai multe talente si personalitati unice ne ajuta sa formam o echipa mai puternica.

Pentru mai multe informatii, te rog sa intri pe pagina noastra de cariere.

Pentru a ne ajuta sa evaluam aplicatiile in mod corect si eficient, folosim un sistem automatizat care verifica si decide cat de bine se potriveste fiecare aplicatie cu rolul disponibil.
Acest sistem analizeaza raspunsurile oferite de tine la cateva intrebari pe care le folosim pentru a evalua aplicatia ta. Aceste intrebari au fost create de sistem si revizuite de echipa Talent Acquisition JYSK, iar fiecare intrebare si raspuns are o anumita valoare. Pe baza raspunsurilor tale, sistemul face o clasificare a candidatilor pentru a putea vedea cat de bine se potriveste profilul tau cu jobul nostru disponibil.
Acest lucru ne ajuta sa gestionam toate aplicatiile si sa ne asiguram ca toata lumea este tratata in mod egal. Rezultatul generat de sistem stabileste daca aplicatia ta trece la urmatoarea etapa. Dar nu iti face griji — decizia finala este intotdeauna luata de o persoana.

Daca doresti sa afli mai multe despre modul in care procesam datele tale personale si despre drepturile tale, te rugam sa consulti Politica de confidentialitate.

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Summary/Objective
The mission of The maintenance In-Charge(MIC) is to oversee all plant maintenance activity to ensure policies and procedures are followed. They develop processes that will maximize stewardship, safety, quality and productivity. plan, track, monitor and enhance cylinder filling station maintenance activities as per Preventative Maintenance Plan. Oversee adherence to company Standards, safety and statutory guidelines with the objective of running smooth and efficient operations of CFS. In addition, He shall be representative for the Site Safety.

Key Responsibility Roles & Responsibilities

Health Safety & Environment

  • Report all deviations, unsafe behaviors, unsafe situations, near misses, and accidents, incidents in the defined incident report format to AL India Safety.

  • To ensure Zero Fatality & Zero accident at site.

  • To support CFS Manager in plant Safety permanence in line with Safety Score card & required actions for Improvement.

  • Record all Act-In cards, Unsafe acts & conditions, incidents & accidents pertaining to plant in Incident Tracker.

  • To help CFS Manager in Investigation of RCA required incidents/accidents & closer of identified actions in time pertaining to the site with follow up concerned person In-charge.

  • To conduct Hazop study, JHA as per company requirement as & when required incoordination with CFS Manager & HSE.

  • To conduct /coordinate for all plant staff Annual Fire Fighting, Hydrant System, First Aid & Safety training, etc.

  • To maintain Site Emergency Response & Action Plan is reviewed & updated always incoordination with CFS Manager, PIC & HSE.

  • To lead Weekly safety Talk, monthly Safety meeting & weekly Incident tracker meeting & to take ownership to keep all meeting records & tracker files updated for the facility.

Plant Maintenance Management

  • Responsible for CFS Maintenance process is effectively implemented in line with GP-09, including:

    • Establish a maintenance strategy, covering notably the maintenance approach, organization and spare parts management,

    • Plan and execute maintenance tasks,

    • Manage critical spare parts,

    • Implement a process to allow the industrial operations to keep assets in a safe and environmentally compliant condition, aligned with business expectations.

  • Plant Maintenance Management inclusive of all plant equipments, lifting tools tackles including plant trucks.

  • To refer & follow all Maintenance Guidelines & Standards and SOP’s & WI are being updated, reviewed & get approved from CFS Manager time to time. Also to ensure all SOP, SSOP’s , WI’s & applicable JHA actions being followed on day to day activities from Operations reporting staff with respect to, MOC, Safety Compliances & applicable regulatory compliances.

  • To ensure all plant equipments Specifications, OEM manuals, OEM guidelines pertaining to maintenance are available, correct & updated from time to time.

  • To ensure Preventative Maintenance plan is available & updated always

  • To ensure all plant EIS’s are covered under PM plan. All EIS’s are marked as per company guidelines.To ensure EIS bypass & closer of EIS bypass in time, to avoid unsafe conditions during plant operation.

  • To ensure preventative maintenance of all equipments planned uniformly throughout the year.

  • To ensure fulfilment of all KPI reports, monthly reports, SAIL & Technical meeting trackers updation & compliance of identified actions under his / her responsibilities.

  • Coordinate with the test shop team for maintenance related activities, in case of any issues.

  • Review daily maintenance reports from the team and take corrective actions to resolve any issues. Review the maintenance plan and guide team to prioritise maintenance activity depending on criticality from Production & Distribution point of view

  • Analyse gaps and identify areas of improvement in maintenance processes. Drive process improvement initiatives to improve productivity, minimise cost and equipment maintenance.

  • To take care of plant “Safe Work Permit” process by maintaining SWP station well equipped ,raising the SWP as & when required .To maintain all required checklists for SWP & updations of required checklist & SWP for as & when required

  • To ensure review of at least 10% of SWP’s to be reviewed by CFS Managar & based on the review report, communicate to all SWP issuers for continuous improvement in SWP process.

  • To ensure available truck cranes, tail lifts & column lifts are covered under the PM plan in line with Regulatory requirements & their maintenance in time to be done cautiously.

  • To plan all plant & truck maintenance related activities well in advance with prior notice to PIC & DIC.

  • To take care of Maintenance Technician staff by monthly attendance reporting & leave management.

  • To ensure availability of all required plant related spares are maintained properly. Reorder of all such items with PR-PO process in coordination with plant Store Incharge & Procurement.

  • To have capability to handle & overcome all plant maintenance related issues.

  • To monitor plant maintenance costs, it should be in line with annual plant budget.

  • To drive cost saving , GAP savings & Time management initiatives at site.

  • To provide support to conduct CSR activities at site driven by Organisation.

  • To arrange motivational programs for plant staff in coordination with CFS Manager.

  • Close monitoring of plant Maintenance Over time. Target - ZERO OVER TIME.

Team Management

  • Report manpower requirement to CFS Manager in advance, if any.

  • Conduct goal setting and performance review for the team. Drive team development, engagement and reward initiatives.

  • Coach and mentor team members as required. Resolve people issues, if any.

  • Proper coordination with maintenance technician.

___________________

Are you a MATCH?

Competencies

  • Diploma/Bachelor of Engineering with 5 years of experience in CFS or any industry with experience in managing plant maintenance activities

  • Technical skills: Operational Excellence, Production, Quality and Safety Management

  • Behavioural skills: Process Orientation, Execution Focus, Customer Orientation, Analytical Skills, People Management

  • Coordination and controlling skills

  • Good communication & presentation skills

  • Statistical knowledge having experience of planning.

  • Good command on computer functions especially Excel ,Power point & Pivot table use & application

Our Differences make our Performance


At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

title: Bedrijfsleider
description:
Ben jij een ambitieuze Bedrijfsleider die energie krijgt van teamontwikkeling en het behalen van targets? 💪

Als Bedrijfsleider bij JYSK ben jij de motor achter het succes van onze winkel. Jij zorgt ervoor dat je team presteert op topniveau, de klant de beste winkelervaring krijgt en alles in de winkel op rolletjes loopt. 🎯 We bieden een informele werksfeer, toffe trainingen en volop kansen om door te groeien tot bijvoorbeeld District Manager. Kun jij de leiding nemen en het team naar succes leiden? Solliciteer dan als Bedrijfsleider bij JYSK! 🙌

Wat wij jou bieden: Werken bij JYSK is meer dan een baan – het is jouw kans om te groeien, leren en impact te maken! Je werkt in een energieke omgeving met een team dat samen successen boekt. 🎉 Bij JYSK kun je jezelf zijn; we zijn open, eerlijk en recht door zee. Je krijgt de kans om je mening te geven en je kunt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen. Fouten maken? Geen probleem – zolang je er maar van leert. Het is de perfecte plek voor wie op zoek is naar een afwisselende, flexibele baan met volop kansen voor de toekomst.

Verder bieden we:

  • Een bruto startsalaris tussen de €2.570,- en €3.830,- per maand afhankelijk van jouw ervaring 💸
  • Aantrekkelijke bonussen tot wel 4 extra maandsalarissen per jaar 💰
  • Successen vieren we met jaarlijkse personeelsfeesten, teamuitjes en wedstrijden met mooie prijzen, zoals een citytrip! ✈️🌍
  • Flexibele roosters: we werken minimaal een dag in het weekend en daarnaast wanneer het jouw het beste uitkomt (evt. koopavonden) we zorgen samen voor een goede werk-privébalans
  • 20% personeelskorting bij JYSK, Bolia en Sofacompany en extra kortingen bij o.a. bol.com, Zalando en HEMA via Benefits@work
  • Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 km woon/werk 🚗

Wat ga je doen:

  • Elke dag een nieuwe uitdaging: Als Bedrijfsleider speel jij een cruciale rol in het runnen van de winkel. Geen dag is hetzelfde!
  • Veel verantwoordelijkheid: Jij hebt de vrijheid om verbeteringen door te voeren en invloed uit te oefenen om het winkelproces te optimaliseren zodat de klant een topervaring heeft! Je start iedere dag met een kort team overleg waarna iedereen zijn eigen verantwoordelijkheden oppakt.
  • Teamwork & good vibes: Jij leidt, coacht en motiveert je team naar topprestaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat iedereen zijn of haar verantwoordelijkheden pakt, en jij coacht waar nodig om het team constant te verbeteren.
  • Klanten blij maken: Jij bent het gezicht van JYSK voor onze klanten en zorgt voor een geweldige winkelervaring, van het adviseren van klanten tot ervoor zorgen dat ze met een glimlach de winkel uitlopen. 😁
  • Innovatie en fun: Bij JYSK houden we van verandering! Jij zorgt ervoor dat het team altijd up-to-date is met de nieuwste tools en technologieën. Jij bedenkt nieuwe ideeën om de klant nog beter van dienst te zijn en draagt bij aan een leuke en innovatieve werkomgeving. 🚀

Wat jij meebrengt:

  • Je hebt MBO werk/denkniveau 🎓
  • Minimaal 1 jaar werkervaring in de retail, bij voorkeur met leidinggeven 🛒
  • Ervaring met leidinggeven? Top! Of het nu gaat om het coachen van collega’s of voeren van gesprekken over bijvoorbeeld verzuim en performance, jij weet hoe je dit aanpakt
  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en hebt enige kennis van de Engelse taal.
  • Flexibiliteit is key voor jou

We nemen snel contact met je op en gebruiken twee testen om een beter beeld van jou te krijgen. Daarna volgt bij geschiktheid een sollicitatiegesprek in de winkel.

Privacyverklaring
Lees hoe we jouw data verwerken in onze Privacyverklaring.

Wij zijn trots erkend te worden als Top Employer. Wij bieden een positieve werkomgeving met mogelijkheden voor groei, ontwikkeling en een sterk teamgevoel.

JYSK wil iedereen betrekken, ongeacht leeftijd, genderidentiteit, seksuele geaardheid, fysieke of mentale capaciteiten, etniciteit en ervaring. Wil je meer weten kijken dan op onze website.

title: Avonova Hälsa söker Företagssköterska till Lund
description:
Vi leder vägen till ett hållbart arbetsliv – varje dag

Avonova är Nordens ledande aktör inom företagshälsa och ledarutveckling. Med bred kunskap och stort engagemang hjälper Avonova organisationer och dess medarbetare att bli mer hållbara, kommunicera effektivare och må bättre. Hälsa och arbetsmiljö är avgörande faktorer för att skapa långsiktigt framgångsrika organisationer. Våra 1300 medarbetare på 170 orter levererar varje dag hälsotjänster över hela Norden. Våra kunder finns inom såväl offentlig som privat sektor.

Tjänsten

Som företagssköterska/sjuksköterska på Avonova är du utifrån din profession ett stöd åt såväl företagsledningar, chefer, kontaktpersoner och medarbetare. Du agerar stöd och rådgivare i hälso- och arbetsmiljöfrågor till chefer och anställda i våra kundföretag med ansvar för planering och genomförande av insatser hos våra kunder.

Du ingår i ett team av professionella konsulter med medicinsk, teknisk, psykosocial, organisatorisk och administrativ kompetens och du ska samtidigt tycka om att arbeta självständigt. Din arbetsplats har sin utgångspunkt på vårt hälsocenter i Lund men du arbetar även vid behov på våra andra orter i område Syd och ibland ute hos våra kunder.

Arbetsuppgifterna omfattas bland annat av:

  • Hälsoundersökningar - Lagstadgade och allmänna
  • Vaccinationer
  • Företagsmottagning
  • Rehabiliteringsarbete och utbildningsinsatser
  • Kundansvar för vissa kundföretag

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska, gärna med vidareutbildning till företagssköterska. Erfarenhet av arbete på företagshälsa och rehabkoordinering är meriterande, men inget krav. Du har ett affärsmässigt och konsultativt förhållningssätt med fokus kundvärde och kundnöjdhet i en säljande organisation. Vidare har du ett hälsofrämjande synsätt och ett genuint intresse för människor, deras hälsa och arbetsmiljö. Du som vill arbeta och utvecklas med oss ska tycka om att arbeta konsultativ och ha lätt för att skapa relationer. Du är trygg, stabil och självgående samt tycker om att samarbeta i team med andra yrkeskategorier såsom läkare, fysioterapeuter/ergonomer, beteendevetare, psykologer, arbetsmiljöingenjörer och administratörer. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vi ser gärna att du är bekväm med att arbeta i privat verksamhet och har ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt i din professionella roll. Du är strukturerad och har god IT-kunskap. Erfarenhet av Office-paketet är en förutsättning för att kunna arbeta hos oss. Körkort och tillgång till egen bil är nödvändigt då det förekommer resor i tjänsten.

Vi erbjuder ett omväxlande och stimulerande arbete i ett företag med stor förändringsvilja och potential. Hos oss får du vara med och påverka, och göra skillnad i människors liv. Du får frihet, stöd och möjlighet till utveckling. Självklart omfattas din anställning hos Avonova av kollektivavtal, försäkringar och tjänstepension. Vi vill att du ska må bra och trivas och erbjuder därför bland annat friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård. Tycker du detta låter intressant är du välkommen med din ansökan, skicka in ditt CV och personliga brev så snart som möjligt, intervjuer sker löpande.

Vi är medlemmar i Almega Vårdföretagarna med kollektivavtal med Vårdförbundet, Akademikerförbundet, Läkarförbundet och Vision. Utdrag ur belastningsregister samt drogtest kommer att ske i samband med anställning. Vill du veta mer kontakta hälsocenterchef Agnetha Meurling, agnetha.meurling@avonova.se

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
The New York City Department of Correction (DOC) is an integral part of the City’s evolving criminal justice system, participating in reform initiatives and strategies aimed to move the City towards a smaller jail system without compromising public safety. The DOC is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our employees, visitors, volunteers and people in our custody. Importantly, safe jails enable DOC to provide people in custody with the tools and opportunities they need to successfully re-enter their communities. The DOC operates facilities and court commands across the five boroughs with more than 7,500 diverse professionals and knowledgeable experts.

The IT Division needs a Full Stack Developer to design, build and maintain enterprise web and mobile applications to help move DOC into a mobile-first agency. This role spans the entire stack: Native and React-Native on mobile for iOS and Android, ReactJS, and Java/Spring Boot backends.

Preferred Skills:

- Proficiency in ReactJS and modern JavaScript/TypeScript for web front-end development, with working
knowledge of component libraries, state management, and form validation patterns.
- Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for building and maintaining backend services and enterprise
applications.
- Experience developing cross-platform mobile applications with React Native, including the bare
workflow where native modules and platform APIs are required.
- Experience with native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C, Xcode) and native Android development
(Kotlin/Java, Android Studio), including platform-specific UI, lifecycle management, and background
execution.
- Ability to implement responsive, accessible mobile UIs that perform reliably on managed enterprise
devices under intermittent or no network connectivity.
- Familiarity with offline-first data flows, including local persistence with SQLite, sync/outbox queues,
conflict resolution, and encryption at rest.
- Working knowledge of DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, security scanning, and
deployment.

title: Staff Engineer Chapter Lead – Generative AI
description:
• We’re launching an AI powered transformation, reimagining our software and data ecosystem through the scaled adoption of Generative AI.

  • You have deep expertise across software and/or data engineering, with a strong focus on MLOps and Generative AI services and the ability to lead, influence, and grow high performing engineering teams.

  • Together we build tomorrow’s bank today, setting the benchmark through world‑class engineering, bold technology choices, and relentless innovation.

Do work that matters:

Help build tomorrow’s bank today by delivering cutting-edge Generative AI that transforms how millions of customers and colleagues experience financial services. As a Staff Software Engineer – Chapter Lead – Generative AI, you’ll drive the AI and strategic technology roadmap, shaping how GenAI is applied at scale across CommSec. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll build production-grade capabilities, support groups and functions in unlocking AI value, and lead a team of highly specialised senior engineers through CommSec’s Generative AI journey.

You’ll set enterprise standards with strong foundations in MLOps, evaluation, observability, and security, while fostering a culture of inclusion, ownership, and technical excellence. The impact is real, accelerating your career while delivering meaningful innovation, improving customer outcomes, and helping shape Australia’s future economy.

This role is for a technical leader who is hands‑on in the code, builds real solutions, solves complex problems, and leads a high‑performing team of senior engineers.

See yourself in our team:

Within CommSec, the CommSec Technology Platform Crew sits within the broader CommSec Technology division, part of the Business Banking Technology domain, operating at the intersection of trading, data, and advanced AI. The team builds intelligent systems that directly shape how Australians invest and manage wealth, delivering production-grade AI, Generative AI, and agentic solutions that are deeply embedded into the CommSec ecosystem.

Their work spans across Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and real-time integrations with trading and customer platforms. They apply machine learning, NLP, and advanced analytics to solve complex, real-world problems, from generating market insights to automating sophisticated workflows.

With a strong engineering discipline, the team drives CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and security-first practices to ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and production-ready, shaping how Generative AI is applied in a high-impact, regulated environment.

We’re interested in hearing from people who:

  • Build and scale production-grade GenAI platforms (LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows) by creating reusable frameworks and integrating them into existing enterprise systems, while leading engineers to make pragmatic architecture decisions and align delivery with real-world business problems

  • Translate advanced ML and NLP capabilities into deployable solutions by guiding teams through design trade-offs (latency, cost, accuracy), ensuring engineers understand both the underlying models and how they operate in production environments

  • Establish end-to-end AI quality and safety practices (evaluation frameworks, LLM observability, bias/risk controls) and lead teams to adopt data-driven validation approaches, embedding accountability and engineering rigor in day-to-day development

  • Drive strong DevSecOps maturity (CI/CD, IaC, automated testing, monitoring, cost optimisation) by setting engineering standards, enabling teams to ship reliably at scale, and coaching them on production ownership including on-call and incident response

  • Champion automation-first engineering culture across the AI lifecycle, reducing manual overhead while empowering teams to focus on higher-value problem solving and continuous improvement

  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing engineering teams by fostering autonomy, psychological safety, and constructive challenge, ensuring individuals build deep expertise in both AI technologies and scalable system design

  • Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders by translating complex AI concepts into clear trade-offs, guiding teams to balance innovation with risk, and aligning technical execution with strategic business outcomes

Tech skills

We don't expect you to know everything, but experience in several of the following will set you up for success:

  • Programming Language: Python

  • AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen

  • Generative AI: Agentic frameworks, RAG, Model Evaluation

  • Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Opensearch

  • ML Engineering: Model Training/Inference Pipeline/Orchestration development

  • MLOps: Model lifecycle management, Model Serving/Performance Observability

  • Cloud Platform: AWS services

  • Infrastructure as Code: CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform

  • Containerisation: Docker, Kubernetes

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins

  • AI Evaluation: Evaluation frameworks from traditional Machine Learning model to GenAI workflow/objects

  • Monitoring: Evidently AI, Datadog

  • Observability & Reliability Engineering: Observe, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty, CloudWatch

  • Security: AI/ML system security

  • Governance: AI governance frameworks

title: Verkoopmedewerker (Zelfbedieningsmagazijn), IKEA Delft Store, 24 uur per week
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een baan voor 24 uur in de week, heb je een grote interesse in woninginrichting en heb je goed commercieel inzicht? Kom dan solliciteren bij IKEA Delft!

Over de baan
De afdeling sales bij IKEA Delft bestaat uit Furniture Sales / Showroom (1e verdieping) en Market Hall Sales (begane grond). Op dit moment zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe collega voor 24 uur per week, op de afdeling Zelfbedieningsmagazijn.

Wat ga je doen?
Als medewerker Sales ben je een van de belangrijkste IKEA contactpersonen voor onze klanten. Je ziet klanten al voordat ze jou zien, je helpt ze vriendelijk en adviseert hen in passende woonoplossingen.

Op weg naar de uitgang van IKEA kom je vanzelf langs het zelfbedieningsmagazijn. Hier halen de klanten de producten op die zij in de showroom hebben gezien. Alle producten zitten in platte pakketten en dienen zelf gemonteerd te worden. Door de klanten zelf te betrekken in het proces kunnen wij de prijzen laag houden.

Het grootste verschil met de andere verkoopmedewerker vacatures is dat in het Zelfbedieningsmagazijn het werk fysiek uitdagender is. Zo moeten er meer producten verplaatst worden of stellingen worden aangepast. Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Onze klanten informeren over producten en productvoordelen, uitleggen van verkoopprocedures.
  • Het verkoopgebied als nieuw houden en het verzorgen van de dagelijkse presentatie van de afdeling.
  • Procedures voor voorraadbeheer in acht nemen.

Beschikbaarheid
Wij zijn op zoek naar medewerkers die 24 uur per week willen werken. Je wordt ingepland in shifts doordeweeks tussen 08.00 en 21.30 uur ’s avonds, op zaterdag tussen 08.00 - 21.30 uur en op zondag tussen 08.00 - 18.30 uur. We zijn op zoek naar medewerkers die in de avonden en weekenden beschikbaar zijn. Je mag 1 vaste dag opgeven tussen maandag en vrijdag waarop je nooit ingepland kunt worden en je krijgt 4 weken van te voren je rooster.

Wie ben jij?
Als medewerker Sales bij IKEA moet je kunnen werken in een drukke en hectische omgeving waar je altijd klanten en collega’s om je heen hebt. Elke dag is anders. Daarnaast ben je:

  • Klantgericht: je hebt een open en vriendelijke uitstraling en voelt goed aan hoe een klant benaderd moet worden.
  • In voor een fysiek uitdagende baan (tillen en verplaatsen van producten en stellingen).
  • Een verkooptalent met commercieel inzicht.
  • Proactief, een echte aanpakker en teamplayer.
  • Vloeiend in het Nederlands en kun je je ook goed redden in het Engels.
  • Initiatiefrijk, zelfstandig en in staat om de juiste prioriteiten te stellen.
  • Computervaardig, we werken binnen IKEA met verschillende systemen voor o.a. het aanmaken van verkooporders.

Wat kun je van IKEA Delft verwachten?
Een kleine greep uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Contractduur van 1 jaar met de mogelijkheid tot verlenging en uitzicht op vast dienstverband
  • Uurloon van 16,18 EUR bruto
  • Extra toeslagen voor zon- en feestdagen én een 13e maand
  • 27 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime dienstverband) en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Pensioen regeling
  • 15% korting op je winkel aankopen, zodat je thuis ook het gevoel van een IKEA showroom kunt creëren.
  • Een aanvullende zorgverzekering, die bovenop je eigen basis- en aanvullende zorgverzekering komt.

Over IKEA
IKEA is wereldleider op het gebied van woninginrichting en is trots op haar waarden en Zweedse cultuur. Bij IKEA geloven we in de kracht van velen. We zijn samen beter en sterker. Wie we ook zijn, we creëren als één team, waarbij iedereen een gelijkwaardige rol speelt. Het is een plek waar elk individu wordt verwelkomd. Waar we elkaar ondersteunen om nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan, te leren en het goede voorbeeld te geven. Zodat we samen het beste uit ons werk kunnen halen.

Ontdek samen met ons de mogelijkheden voor een loopbaan in een inspirerende werkomgeving binnen een internationale context. Een plek waar ondernemende mensen de ruimte krijgen om te doen waar ze het beste in zijn. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden om samen te groeien.

Bij IKEA Delft werken zo’n 950 enthousiaste medewerkers die elke dag hard samenwerken om onze klanten te inspireren en goede wooninrichting oplossingen te bieden.

Geïnteresseerd?
Leuk! Solliciteer met motivatiebrief en cv via deze site. De eerstvolgende startdatum is 1 oktober

Wil je meer weten over deze vacature? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Linda: 06 50 15 75 94

title: Ambulant Hulpverlener Jeugd & Gezin
description:
Rotterdam en omgeving | 24-36 uur | €3.296 - €4.705 (FWG 50) | Zakelijke auto

"Met één been in het gezin, met het andere op de regie."

Je kent het dilemma: wil je een stap verder in je vak, dan lijkt dat te betekenen dat je de praktijk loslaat. Bij Zeno Ambulant hoeft dat niet. Als ambulant hulpverlener werk je zelf mee in het gezin, samen met onze ambulant begeleiders, én voer jij de regie over het traject. Overzicht en verantwoordelijkheid erbij, zonder de keukentafel te verlaten.

We begeleiden gezinnen en jongeren met complexe zorgvragen. Daarbij kijken we niet naar gedrag, maar naar de mens erachter. We staan naast het gezin en zoeken samen naar wat wél werkt. En jij bent daarin de vaste schakel tussen het gezin en Zeno.

Klinkt dit als jouw manier van werken? Lees dan verder.

Zo ziet jouw werk eruit

Je werkt binnen complexe zorgtrajecten voor gezinnen en jongeren, vanuit de Jeugdwet. Jij zorgt dat de juiste ondersteuning op het juiste moment wordt ingezet, ook als het overzicht niet vanzelfsprekend is.

Een deel van je week sta je zelf in het gezin. Samen met onze ambulant begeleiders werk je aan structuur, stabiliteit en perspectief, en je ziet met eigen ogen wat werkt en wat niet. Dat maakt jouw regie sterker: je bewaakt geen traject vanuit een dossier, maar vanuit de keukentafel. Je werkt zelfstandig en met een groot oplossend vermogen, want een dag loopt in dit werk zelden zoals gepland. Maar je staat er niet alleen voor: een team dat samen verantwoordelijkheid draagt, een orthopedagoog die inhoudelijk meekijkt en een manager met korte lijnen.

Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Sliedrecht en bent veel onderweg in Rotterdam en omgeving, met een zakelijke auto tot je beschikking. En omdat de hulpvraag van het gezin leidend is, ben je flexibel inzetbaar. Avonden en weekenden kunnen voorkomen.

Wat ga je doen?

Jij coördineert en bewaakt complexe zorgtrajecten en voert de regie over het inhoudelijke zorgproces. Je zorgt voor passende inzet van begeleiding, van overbruggingszorg tot langdurige trajecten, en je werkt daarin zelf mee: samen met de ambulant begeleiders sta je in het gezin en zie je wat er speelt. Je stemt de zorg af met cliënten, gezinnen en betrokken professionals, en je signaleert veranderingen in de leefsituatie en speelt daarop in.

Daarnaast houd jij het traject op orde. Je zorgt voor de evaluaties en verlengingen, levert de inhoudelijke verslaglegging en verantwoording aan en stemt het rooster van het team af met de backoffice. Zo weet iedereen, van gezin tot Zeno, waar het traject staat.

Verder zorg je voor:

  • Contact met opdrachtgevers en ketenpartners, zodat de lijnen kort blijven.

  • Signalen naar het team en de orthopedagoog als een traject om meer of andere inzet vraagt

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent de begeleider die stevig staat als het ingewikkeld wordt. Je houdt overzicht waar anderen het kwijtraken, neemt besluiten als de situatie daarom vraagt en schakelt snel als een dag anders loopt dan gepland, en dat gebeurt in dit werk regelmatig. Je denkt in oplossingen en kijkt naar wat wél kan, ook als een gezin al veel achter de rug heeft. En je werkt zelfstandig, maar weet precies wanneer je het team of de orthopedagoog erbij haalt.

Daarnaast breng jij het volgende mee:

  • Een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Social Work, SPH of vergelijkbaar.

  • Een SKJ-registratie.

  • Minimaal twee jaar relevante werkervaring, in een intramurale setting of als ambulant begeleider, zodat complexe casuïstiek je niet vreemd is.

  • Ervaring met complexe (jeugd)casuïstiek en gezinsdynamieken.

  • Een rijbewijs (de auto regelen wij).

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • 24-36 uur per week.

  • Je start met een tijdelijk contract. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de stap naar een vast contract.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €3.296 - €4.705 (FWG 50), afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring (cao Gehandicaptenzorg).

  • Een zakelijke auto met tankpas.

  • Een groeiend, ambitieus en betrokken team: collegiaal, informeel en ja, de teamuitjes zijn echt tof.

  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag conform cao.

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 PBL-uren, 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Ruimte om jezelf vakinhoudelijk te ontwikkelen door scholing, intervisie, werkbegeleiding en coaching, en een buddy die je in de eerste periode wegwijs maakt.

Daarom Zeno.

Zeno staat voor Zorg EN Ondersteuning, en die naam is geen toeval: wij geloven dat je samen verder komt dan alleen. Niet protocollen of systemen staan bij ons centraal, maar de mens achter de hulpvraag. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te handelen, initiatief te nemen en écht van betekenis te zijn. En omdat we groeien, groei jij mee: er liggen volop mogelijkheden voor wie ze wil pakken.

De kracht van Zeno is de kracht van verbinding. Collega's met verschillende specialisaties, maar dezelfde gedrevenheid om écht te zorgen. We staan voor elkaar klaar, denken mee en springen bij als een dag anders loopt dan gepland. We werken hard, maar humor en werkplezier verliezen we nooit uit het oog.

Zin om te zorgen?

Ben jij die ambulant hulpverlener die overzicht houdt in complexe zorgtrajecten én met beide voeten in het gezin blijft staan? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Solliciteer direct, of stel eerst vrijblijvend je vragen aan Sarono Peroti, recruiter, via 06-11178820. Bellen of appen mag allebei, en een kop koffie op kantoor kan natuurlijk ook. Na je sollicitatie hoor je binnen een paar dagen van ons. Is er een match, dan nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking bij ons op kantoor in Sliedrecht.

We kijken uit naar je komst bij Zeno!

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Join the Legacy of Innovation with FCI-CCM:

FCI is a leader in Customer Communication Management (CCM), empowering enterprises to deliver hyper-personalized, omnichannel, and data-driven customer experiences through its flagship platform VARTA. With a legacy dating back to 1959, FCI combines decades of communication expertise with modern technology to help clients across banking, insurance, telecom, utilities, and healthcare transform their customer engagement into a strategic growth engine.

Broad Function:
​
We are seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer with 6–8 years of hands-on experience in software testing, primarily in manual and integration testing, to support the Varta SaaS customer communication platform. The candidate should have strong expertise in end-to-end QA validation across multi-channel communication systems (email, SMS, print, WhatsApp, push), complex workflows, and enterprise integrations. This role requires strong analytical ability, ownership mindset, and the capability to lead QA efforts across releases you will be responsible in ensuring high-quality, secure, and compliant communication delivery across banking and enterprise clients.


Requirements

Roles and Responsibilities (not limited to):

Primary Responsibilities:

Requirements Review & Validation - Review and validate business requirements, functional specifications, and technical design documents to ensure clarity, completeness, and testability of Varta features and enhancements.
Test Strategy & Planning - Develop comprehensive test strategies, detailed test plans, and test cases covering complex workflows, orchestration logic, batch processing, and multi-channel communication scenarios.
Functional & End-to-End Testing - Execute functional, integration, end-to-end (E2E), regression, and data validation testing across SaaS deployments to ensure system stability and accuracy.
Multi-Channel Communication Validation - Validate end-to-end communication journeys across multiple channels including email, SMS, print, WhatsApp, and push notifications.
API & Interface Testing - Perform API and interface testing to validate data exchange and integrations with upstream systems and downstream communication gateways.
Test Analysis & Quality Improvement - Analyze test results, identify defects or process gaps, and recommend improvements to enhance product quality and testing efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration- Collaborate with development, product, and DevOps teams for defect triage, root cause analysis, and validation of fixes to ensure timely resolution.
QA Ownership & Release Management - Take ownership of QA deliverables for assigned modules or releases and ensure milestone-based quality sign-off before deployment, Mentor junior and associate QA engineers, review their test artifacts, and guide them in maintaining quality standards.
UAT & Production Readiness Support- Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), client validation cycles, and production release readiness activities.
Reporting & Metrics Management - Drive QA reporting through dashboards, traceability matrices, and quality metrics to provide visibility into testing progress and outcomes.
Process & Standards Enhancement- Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards, documentation practices, and reusable test assets.

CULTURAL TRAITS (Critical Fit Requirements):

We are looking for someone who:

  • Execution-Driven & Delivery Focused
  • Structured & Process-Oriented Working Style
  • Strong Governance & Compliance Mindset
  • High Accountability with Minimal Supervision
  • Business-Aligned and Client-Sensitive Approach
  • Practical Problem-Solving Orientation

Desired Qualifications & Experience:

  • 6–8 years of hands-on experience in Software Quality Assurance with strong expertise in manual, web application, and integration/API testing.
  • Strong working knowledge and hands-on experience in JMeter for performance testing.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments; exposure to SaaS or enterprise workflow-based platforms preferred.
  • Strong expertise in end-to-end scenario validation, complex workflow testing, and data reconciliation.
  • Solid understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), testing methodologies, and defect management processes.
  • Experience in client-facing QA discussions, requirement clarifications, and release validation cycles.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple releases within tight timelines with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, defect reporting, and escalation management skills.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; prior mentoring experience preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as JIRA, Defect Management Tools, JMeter, and BrowserStack or Playwright.

  • Accidental insurance coverage
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Retirement benefits including Provident Fund (PF) and Gratuity

  • Company-paid transportation
  • Sodexo benefits for income tax savings
  • Paternity & Maternity Leave Benefit
  • National Pension Saving
  • EL encashment
  • Sick Leave

title: Chief Resilience Officer
description:
The NYC Department of Environmental Protection’s (DEP) mission is to protect public health and the environment by supplying the highest-quality drinking water; treating and recovering valuable resources from wastewater to protect New York City’s waterways; minimizing exposure to air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution; and constructing dependable infrastructure to foster a more resilient New York City for generations to come. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with more than 5,500 employees. DEP's water supply system is comprised of 19 reservoirs and 3 controlled lakes throughout the system's 2,000 square mile watershed that extends 125 miles north and west of the City. DEP annually collects $4.8B in revenues, primarily through customer billing. These funds support DEP’s operations and its $33 Billion Ten-Year Capital Construction Plan.

New York City faces increasing risks from more frequent and severe storm events, coastal flooding, sea level rise, extreme heat, and drought. DEP plays a central role in preparing the City for these challenges through the operation and protection of critical water and wastewater infrastructure, construction of stormwater management projects, implementation of major coastal resilience initiatives, and long-term planning for a changing climate. At the same time, DEP operates some of the City’s most energy-intensive facilities and has significant opportunities to advance decarbonization through energy efficiency and expanded beneficial use of biogas and other byproducts. DEP also plays a critical role in protecting public health and the environment through its air quality, noise, and hazardous materials regulatory programs. As both a climate resilience leader and a major infrastructure operator, DEP is uniquely positioned to help achieve the City’s climate goals in an equitable manner while ensuring the continued reliability of essential public services.

To advance this work, DEP is seeking an experienced and strategic leader to serve as Chief Resilience Officer (CRO). Reporting directly to the Commissioner, the CRO will lead agency-wide coordination on climate policy, climate commitments, and interagency initiatives, ensuring that climate considerations are integrated across DEP’s operations, capital program, and regulatory functions. The CRO will serve as the Commissioner’s principal advisor on climate-related policy and strategy, working closely with senior leadership across DEP, City Hall, and partner agencies to advance the City’s climate goals and strengthen the resilience of critical infrastructure systems. The CRO will also ensure that climate and environmental justice considerations are integrated into agency decision-making, with a focus on advancing equitable environmental and public health outcomes for communities disproportionately burdened by pollution and climate risks.

Key Responsibilities:

- Coordinate agency-wide implementation of climate-related initiatives, commitments, and strategic priorities, ensuring alignment across DEP bureaus and offices.

- Lead DEP’s engagement in citywide climate and environmental justice initiatives and represent the agency in interagency working groups, task forces, and external forums.

- Serve as DEP’s primary point of coordination with City Hall, other City agencies, State and Federal partners, utilities, and external stakeholders on climate policy and strategy.

- Work with DEP bureaus to integrate climate resilience, greenhouse gas reduction, and sustainability considerations into agency planning, operations, and capital investments.

- Support the development of strategic initiatives related to climate adaptation, decarbonization, environmental justice, energy, and resilience.

- Lead agency-wide coordination on environmental justice priorities, ensuring that DEP policies, programs, capital investments, and regulatory activities advance equitable outcomes and meaningfully engage communities disproportionately affected by environmental burdens and climate impacts.

- Foster relationships with external stakeholders, including advocacy organizations, community organizations, industry groups, and peer utilities to advance DEP’s climate agenda.

EXECUTIVE PROGRAM SPECIALIST ( - 13393

1. Bachelor's degree from an accredited college and 7 years of satisfactory experience of a nature to qualify for the duties and responsibilities of the position, at least 18 months of which must have been in an administrative, managerial, consultative or executive capacity or supervising personnel performing activities related to the duties of the position; or

2. A combination of education and/or experience equivalent to "1" above. However, all candidates must have the 18 months of administrative, managerial, executive, consultative or supervisory experience described in "1" above.

title: Konsult inom produktutveckling
description:

I rollen som produktutvecklare/mekanikkonstruktör kommer du att få möjligheten att medverka i kvalificerade och utmanande uppdrag som innefattar hela eller delar av produktutvecklingskedjan. Du kommer att arbeta med spännande projekt, både internt och externt, där du har möjlighet att bredda din erfarenhet och kunskapsbank då uppdragen varierar över tid. Projekten bedrivs korsfunktionellt där du kommer arbeta parallellt med både mjukvaruutvecklare och elektronikkonstruktörer.

Om oss:

Vi levererar lösningar till många olika branscher, exempelvis medicinteknik, konsumentprodukter och verkstadsindustri (och till både stora och små företag). Vårt team arbetar med produktutveckling där merparten av konsulterna fokuserar på mekanikkonstruktion, men vi tar oss även an uppdrag inom test och verifiering, systemdesign och teknisk projektledning.

Du blir en del av ett vasst gäng som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap och löser problem tillsammans. Att ha roligt både på och utanför jobbet värderar vi högt och vi är måna om att skapa en bra balans mellan jobb och fritid. Tillsammans står vi för en kunskap med både bredd och djup, där ingen av våra konkurrenter slår oss på fingrarna!

Så här beskriver sektionschefen Simon Haque sitt team och sitt ledarskap:

När du börjar hos oss kommer du bli del av ett team med en bra mix av arbetslivserfarenhet, teknisk kompetens och kunnande från olika branscher. Vi är ett välkomnande och varmt gäng som gärna delar med oss av våra kunskaper för att du ska utvecklas som konsult.

Som chef ser jag det som min främsta uppgift att stötta dig och röja undan eventuella hinder för att du ska kunna utföra ett så bra jobb som möjligt. Jag vill hjälpa dig att nå dina personliga mål samtidigt som du genom ditt arbete bidrar till vårt resultat och lönsamhet.

Vem är du?

  • Du är utbildad ingenjör inom relevant område: maskinteknik, farkostteknik, design & produktframtagning, eller liknande
  • Du har minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom konstruktion
  • Du har erfarenhet av CAD-verktyg såsom Creo, SolidWorks, NX och/eller Catia
  • Du har goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska
  • Vi ser gärna att du även har viss erfarenhet av test
  • Du kan arbeta självständigt och tar egna intiativ

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

  • Individuell kompetensutvecklingsplan inom ditt spetsområde
  • Konkurrenskraftiga förmåner gällande pension, friskvård och föräldraledighet reglerade i vårt kollektivavtal
  • Företagsrabatter med externa partners genom vår förmånsportal: Benify
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 4500 sek/år
  • Ett enormt nätverk av tekniska experter

På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. title: Specialist, Logistics (LTL)
description:
Accelerate your career at RXO
RXO is a leading provider of transportation solutions. With cutting-edge technology at the center, we're revolutionizing the industry with our massive network and commitment to finding solutions for every challenge. We create more efficient ways for shippers and carriers to transport goods across North America.

Compensation for this role is $22/hour The role may also be eligible for bonus or commission pay. Actual compensation may vary due to factors such as experience and skill set.

As a Logistic Specialist, you'll manage daily operations for our dedicated LTL accounts, including coordinating and tracking shipments, handling freight classification and pricing for quotes, and building relationships with carriers and customer contacts. You'll ensure profitability by selecting optimal carriers and service levels, resolving shipment issues, while upholding our high level of service.

What your day-to-day will look like:

title: Barnvakt sökes i Brålanda - sporadiskt
description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!


Om uppdraget / About the assignment

En familj i Brålanda söker en barnvakt för sporadiska tillfällen, främst helger men eventuellt upphämtning från skolan vid 15/16. De har två barn, en snart 8-åring och 4-åring. Det yngre barnet har astma och det är viktigt att barnvakten känner sig trygg med att följa hennes medicineringsrutiner noggrant. En liten hund finns i hemmet.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

  • Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
  • Kurs i barn-HLR
  • Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
  • Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
  • Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
  • Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
  • Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen


Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Salary: $120,000 – $150,000 per year + Super

About the role

This role owns the Rust codebase that devices communicate through. Brake controllers, a handheld dial, and new products in development all communicate with each other and with a mobile app over a protocol library built and maintained in-house. The firmware is Rust on ESP32-C6; the same library compiles into the phone app through FFI. You would be taking over a mature codebase from a remote engineer who has been its primary author, with a handover period and their support while you come up to speed. Some products are shipping, some are close, and a lot of what remains is integration - making the pieces we have built actually work together, on real hardware, every time.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the in-house Rust protocol library: the schema DSL and macros that generate typed BLE APIs from a single device definition, the embedded and desktop/mobile backends behind them, and its releases to the private registry.

  • Own the device firmware: brake controller and dial run Rust on ESP32-C6 under ESP-IDF, covering BLE services, over-the-air update, on-device logging and persistent configuration.

  • Own the Rust-to-mobile boundary - the FFI layer that puts the same library inside the React Native app - along with the desktop and diagnostic tooling the team uses daily.

  • Version the protocol so that it stays compatible. Firmware in the field and an app already installed have to keep working when the schema moves.

  • Take new products from definition to shipping, and finish the ones already in progress. Most of the remaining work across the range is integration.

  • Set the engineering standard: architecture decisions, code review, test coverage, and the build and release tooling everyone else depends on.

  • Debug against physical hardware, including hardware-in-the-loop testing and BLE behaviour across iOS and Android.

About you

  • Experience with professional software development, at a level where you have owned a substantial codebase and been accountable for its direction.

  • A systems programming background - C, C++, Zig or similar - with a real understanding of memory, concurrency and the cost of an abstraction.

  • Embedded experience: firmware on a microcontroller, debugged against physical hardware.

  • Rust is what the codebase is written in. Prior Rust experience is a significant advantage, but genuine interest in working in it daily is what is required.

  • The judgement to work on a codebase you did not write: reading before rewriting, and knowing which of the two a given problem calls for.

  • Willingness to review and mentor. You would be the most senior software engineer in the room.

  • Nice to have: Rust in production, particularly async, trait design, and procedural macros.

  • Nice to have: BLE at protocol level: GATT, pairing and bonding, MTU negotiation, connection intervals.

  • Nice to have: ESP-IDF, or another embedded RTOS.

  • Nice to have: Cross-language bindings or FFI work, particularly into mobile.

About us

Aston Dynamics builds brake-by-wire systems for trailers and autonomous vehicles. The electric-over-hydraulic (EoH) platform replaces conventional pneumatic and mechanical trailer braking with electronically controlled hydraulic actuation, giving faster, more precise, independently controllable braking. The team is small and growing with R&D focus. The firmware, electronics and mechanical engineers who build the hardware sit in the same office, and control systems work is owned in-house.

title: Primary Year Coordinator
location: Marsden Park, New South Wales, Australia
description:
About ACC

Australian Christian College (ACC) is a protestant non-denominational, Christian Education Organisation, whose mission is to develop each and every student to be equipped spiritually, academically, socially and physically to flourish into their full potential, and be a positive influence on the world around them. ACC is wholeheartedly committed to excellence in education so that students are 'well known, well loved, and well taught" by dedicated trained Christian staff.

ACC is part of Christian Education Ministries, with 17 schools in 5 states, and is also the largest non-government Distance Education provider in Australia.

About ACC Marsden Park

ACC Marsden Park is a K-12, co-educational, Christian School, located in the thriving North West corridor of Sydney, in a semi-rural setting which is experiencing sustained growth and is targeted for fast-tracked development.

We currently have over 1500 students learning with us on-campus and over 1100 students learning via our Distance Education program.

About our Culture

ACC Marsden Park has a College-Wide Teaching and Learning framework that is built around three "Signature Pedagogies". We prioritise Explicit Direct Instruction, Specific Targeted Feedback, and Thinking Through Writing as pedagogical approaches that develop deep learning.

Our pedagogical approach has been informed by Cognitive Load Theory and has been influenced by the thinking of Hollingsworth and Ybarra in "Explicit Direct Instruction," Lemov in "Teach Like a Champion," and Hochman and Wexler in "The Writing Revolution." We also draw inspiration from Michaela Community School in London.

Our staff are supported by an in-house pedagogical coaching team, and with an open professional learning culture where staff learn with and from each other by dropping-in to each other's classes, and by offering and receiving feedback. The College invests in creating a technology-infused educational ecosystem to support effective learning of students and teachers.

We are praying for the right people to come and join our team and encourage you to learn more about our College to see if you might be a good fit for our vision and culture.

Requirements

About the Role

The Primary Year Coordinator ensures that every student in their Year Group is well taught and well cared for. They will inspire, lead and manage the implementation of teaching and learning using the College’s Signature Pedagogies to produce quality learning outcomes. They will ensure that every student in the Year Group is safe, supported and will develop the good character of students. They will liaise with classroom teachers, specialist staff, Primary Leadership and parents to meet the learning and pastoral care needs of students.

This full-time role will commence Term 1 2027.

About You

You will:

  • Actively build College culture, beliefs and values.
  • Be an excellent teacher using the College’s Signature Pedagogies.
  • Be an exemplary practitioner of student behaviour and supporting wellbeing.
  • Be a demonstrated culture keeper and reflect the common attributes of humble, hungry, and people smarts.
  • Care about other people as people and as professionals.
  • Uphold the core values of ACC when liaising with other staff.
  • Have a deep faith and personal relationship with Jesus and show it through their actions.
  • Have a suitable qualification and NESA accreditation (or be eligible).
  • Be able to demonstrate excellent teaching as described by the Australian Professional Standards for Teachers.
  • Hold a current Employee Working With Children Check.

Benefits

  • Coordinator allowance in addition to base salary.
  • Work with an authentic dedicated Christian team.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) available.
  • Fitness Passport, WHEREFIT fitness and wellbeing benefits available.
  • Be part of a faith community that shares regular devotions and prayer.
  • Grow in your faith, skills and experience.
  • Canteen & Cafe.
  • On-Site Staff Parking.
  • Salary Packaging available.

title: Heavy Duty City Park Worker
description:
The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) protects public health and the environment by supplying clean drinking water, collecting and treating wastewater, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP delivers more than 1.1 billion gallons per day of the highest quality drinking water to 8.5 million NYC residents and more than 1 million people in Upstate New York and has a wastewater conveyance and treatment system capable of processing over 1.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day to protect the environment and the city’s surrounding waterways.

DEP is in partnership with various City agencies to construct distributed stormwater management practices, or “green infrastructure”, within the City’s public streets and sidewalks to manage stormwater runoff and improve water quality in NYC waterbodies. These engineered practices include rain gardens, infiltration basins and porous pavements, and use a combination of techniques to increase stormwater storage capacity and infiltration of stormwater into underlying natural soils. The operations and maintenance of right-of-way green infrastructure is largely managed by DEP’s in-house Green Infrastructure Maintenance Unit within the Bureau of Environmental Planning & Analysis in the Bureau of Sustainability at DEP. To date there are over 12,000 green infrastructure practices in maintenance by this unit across Queens, Brooklyn, and the Bronx. More information on the NYC Green Infrastructure Program and locations of green infrastructure practices can be found online: https://www.nyc.gov/site/dep/water/green-infrastructure.page

Through this posting DEP seeks to hire two City Park Workers to join its team of green stormwater maintenance crews. The primary focus of this job will be driving motorized equipment for the purpose of maintaining porous pavement constructed within parking lanes on NYC streets. This work will require coordination with other green infrastructure operations and maintenance staff on responding to work orders and routing guidance.

As City Park Workers, the selected candidates will assist in: general maintenance work, including edging seeding, snow removal, cultivating, fertilizing, trimming, sweeping, removal of sediments and raking of litter; clean and maintain facilities including drainage structures; perform minor repair work including but not limited to plumbing, masonry, carpentry, metal work and vehicle and equipment repair; drive vehicles and operate certain other motorized equipment; perform safety checks on facilities and equipment; and may move furniture, climb and perform other physical activities as required in the performance of assigned duties.

CITY PARK WORKER - 90641

Qualification Requirements
1. There are no formal education or experience requirements for this position.

2. A Motor Vehicle Driver's License valid in the State of New York is required.

3. Ability to read and to understand and obey orders is required.

4. There are certain medical and physical requirements.

The Vendor Management team is a powerful contributor to LanguageWire objectives and our customers’ satisfaction by working closely with other internal teams, especially Operations and Commercial, to ensure our supplier pool is engaged and meeting our customer needs and expectations.

You will also represent LanguageWire to our suppliers through recruitment, interactions, communications, onboarding and training of our suppliers.

You will monitor the service and the quality performance of all our vendors, ensuring compliance with ISO-quality requirements.

You will expand our network of suppliers representing new content service areas or specific capabilities, to assist our product team to deliver new commercial solutions, to contribute to prospective deals, to assist our operational team with specific resource challenges, and to support LanguageWire objectives.

If you have good communication skills coupled with an analytical mindset and are eager to learn more about supplier procurement and management, we’d love to meet you!

The team you’ll be a part of

The Vendor Management team is an international team with people located in our Valencia, Lille, and Aarhus offices.

We act as the facilitators of supplier expertise within the company and contribute to reaching LanguageWire objectives, using a data-driven approach where collaboration and continuous improvement are a part of everyday work.

What you’ll do:

  • Maintain vendor database to increase reliability of data
  • Communication with vendors and internal stakeholders to support in resolving issues or challenges
  • Supporting vendor recruitment and onboarding
  • Creation and maintenance of vendor-facing documents
  • Review vendor evaluations and vendor performance
  • Create and send vendor communications
  • Compile and analyze data
  • Help translate data into clear insights the team can act on
  • Support in team reporting
  • Contribute ideas that make our vendor management team more effective
  • Anchoring LanguageWire technology and services with our vendor pool

In one year, you’ll know you were successful if…

  • You are able to communicate with internal stakeholders and our vendors effectively.
  • You're seen as a trusted member of the Vendor Management team who takes ownership and gets things done.
  • You help keep the quality delivered by our vendors aligned with our customer expectations.
  • You confidently can compile data and provide insights for reports and team actions.
  • You've introduced smarter ways of working that save time and improve quality.

Desired experience and competencies

What you’ll need to bring:

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and orally
  • Negotiation skills with a human approach
  • Enthusiasm with a collaborative spirit, while being comfortable with autonomy and repetitive tasks
  • Analytical approach
  • You’re comfortable learning new tools
  • You’re curious, proactive and excited to learn

This will make you stand out:

  • Solution oriented
  • Analytical mindset
  • Understanding the full picture and showing proactivity
  • Good Excel skills
  • Good organizational skills and an eye for detail
  • Interest in procurement and/or the language sector

Our perks

  • Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas
  • International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Valbonne, Munich, Hamburg, Zurich, Atlanta, Helsinki, Turku and Valencia
  • We enjoy meeting in person and working face to face, but we are also flexible (depending on the team/ assigned tasks) and are normally happy to arrange a personalized home vs office schedule.
  • We take care of our people and initiate many social get-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!
  • 150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments
  • Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square
  • Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities
  • A dog friendly atmosphere
  • Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.

About LanguageWire

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customers’ lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.

Our values drive our behavior

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don’t understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We are caring and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.

Yes, to diversity, equity & inclusion

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.

LanguageWire’s recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.

Want to know more?

We can’t wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!

title: Director, Sprint Team
description:
DISCLAIMER: Only candidates who are permanent Administrative City Planners, those reachable on the civil service list, or New York City Employees serving permanently in comparable civil service titles are invited to apply.

THE AGENCY
The Department of City Planning (DCP) plans for the future of New York City, working to create thriving and dynamic neighborhoods with access to housing and jobs, resilient infrastructure, and a vibrant public realm. The Department engages communities to develop inclusive plans, expands housing access and economic opportunity, and plans for long-term sustainability.

DCP supports the City Planning Commission in its annual review of hundreds of land use applications. The Department also advises on citywide strategic and capital planning, analyzes data, conducts policy analysis, and creates open data and civic engagement tools.

The Department of City Planning offers staff meaningful opportunities to help shape the future of New York City and address some of its most pressing challenges. The Department values public service, collaboration, and creativity, and supports professional development.

THE DIVISION
Established to carry out the functions outlined in the SPEED Report, the Sprint Team is a new, dedicated project management team established to advance the Mamdani Administration's mandate to deliver affordable housing faster through streamlining the review of land use applications to reduce DCP pre-certification timelines for eligible projects from approximately two years to six months. The team will focus specifically on moving applications quickly, predictably, and transparently into public review while preserving the integrity of technical, zoning, and public review requirements. The land use application is the building block upon which the public discussion about the future of our city rests. The Division is responsible for the timely review of applications to ensure that decision-makers have the information necessary to make informed decisions about their communities.

Working closely with DCP Borough Offices, the Technical Review Division, Environmental Assessment and Review, Pipeline and Commission Operations, Counsel, Capital Planning and Support, Strategic Planning, and the Mayor’s Office, the Sprint Team will identify eligible projects, establish clear review pathways, resolve critical path issues, track milestones, maintain high-quality data in DCP’s Zoning Applications Portal and related systems, and ensure that applicants and reviewers have clear expectations and guidance.

The Sprint Team's primary responsibility is the direct management and review of complex land use applications progressing through pre-certification. Staff within the division will serve as lead project managers responsible for driving projects through the establishment of interdivisional guidance, identifying and escalating risks to schedule, coordinating guidance and comments to applicants and the City Planning Commission, maintaining accountability to milestone commitments, ensuring that applicants receive timely and actionable direction throughout the process, and providing transparency to the pre-certification pipeline through accurate reporting in DCP’s Zoning Application Portal.

The Sprint Team will operate in a highly deadline-driven environment requiring strong judgment, collaboration, technical and planning knowledge, focus on creating and maintaining agency best practices, and a public service dedication. The Director's work will directly support the City's housing production goals by leading a solutions-focused team to reduce avoidable delays while balancing the need to provide thoughtful and accurate guidance on technical and zoning requirements and public review recommendations and strengthening DCP’s accountability to support the city’s goals for affordable housing production.

THE ROLE
The Director of the Sprint Team will oversee the City's expedited pre-certification application review and lead a team responsible for managing high-priority housing and land use applications through DCP review. The Director will be responsible for the administration and success of DCP’s expedited pre-cert protocols for eligible projects and establish operational best practices, performance standards, escalation procedures, and interdivisional coordination practices to ensure that eligible applications advance accordingly to meet the program’s requirements.

The Director will work closely with executive leadership, borough offices, strategic and advisory divisions, and external stakeholders to identify systemic process constraints, allocate staffing resources, monitor project pipelines, and ensure accountability to agencywide SPEED objectives. The Director will supervise the Deputy Director, Team Leaders, and application review staff, oversee reporting structures and metrics, coordinate with Counsel and Pipeline and Commission Operations on procedural matters, and support strategic process improvements in collaboration with the executive office and Capital Planning and Support related to application review and milestone management.

DCP MANAGERIAL RESPONSIBILITIES
A well-organized workplace leads to a productive and happy workforce. DCP leaders are responsible for setting the tone and ensuring everyone works together towards a common goal, which includes, but is not limited to, developing staff and teams and advancing division and agency work plans.

Developing staff and teams:
- Building strong and cohesive teams, including integrating new staff into division and team structure
- Supervising and tracking the progress of staff projects and assignments and ensuring that employees are meeting their work goals and objectives
- Providing guidance and constructive criticism to employees and helping them develop as professionals, including but not limited to completing mid-year and year-end performance appraisals within designated timeframes
- Ensuring that staff are following citywide and agency policies
Advancing division and agency work plans:
- Managing and outlining the work program for teams and staff
- Overseeing internal and external stakeholder engagement and outreach
- Supporting internal and external communications
- Providing strategic and policy direction
- Planning through the use of robust analytics, research and analysis

Please visit: https://www1.nyc.gov/jobs/ and follow the steps below:
